The math is simple:
➜ It costs around $3 to register a new voter
➜ That means for every $30,000 we raise, we can register 10,000 new voters
➜ In a close election, these new voters would make all the difference
Not to mention that the more people who vote, the more our government looks like us and not the privileged powerful .
Will you chip in $24 or more right now to help register 8 new voters? Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**
**[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $10 between my campaign and Adam Frisch's today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat and win in Colorado. Anything you can give makes a difference.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93098715/499354412/417329036?refcode=em20240918pm2-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=0fc0c01c-1a76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZmMwYzAxYy0xYTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MqsKmTntLqM0SZZKuexYj2a-mlQd10Cr-yXkTY-2ZKI=)**

body:

---
As you might know, Peter, one of our final FEC fundraising deadlines of the campaign is right around the corner. It's a big one, and Vice President Harris needs your help. Because the truth is, we have a lot of critical spending decisions to make when it ends -- and our ability to fund a winning campaign will determine the outcome of this election. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1948%2E135344%2Ebhm7tR)

Friend --
You may have already seen the headlines: yesterday, Senate Republicans, led by Ted Cruz, loudly proclaimed their support for protecting IVF -- and then promptly blocked the Right to IVF Act in the Senate.
The bill he blocked would have simply said individuals have a right to “receive fertility treatment from a health care provider” and “make decisions and arrangements regarding the donation, testing, use, storage, or disposition of reproductive genetic material,” like sperm, eggs, and embryos. But he couldn’t even bring himself to vote for it.
Beyond Cruz’s sheer shamelessness, something caught our eye: our opponent, Mike Rogers, came out to celebrate Ted Cruz’s fight to “protect” IVF.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240918-4-900&t=2&akid=1948%2E135344%2Ebhm7tR)
Rogers’ support for IVF runs just about as deep as Ted Cruz’s. All you need to do is look at the actual voting record: Between 2005 and 2013, Rogers co-sponsored 4 (!) bills that defined embryos as persons from the moment of conception, just as the Alabama legislation that shut down IVF. Before that, Rogers supported a nationwide ban on abortion that could have also made IVF nearly impossible. In fact, Rogers and Cruz have essentially the same voting record on the issue of choice and IVF.
So here’s the thing: either Rogers didn’t understand what he was doing when he signed on to all these bills, or he simply didn’t care what would happen to women, to families, and to our communities should his bills have become law.
Michigan doesn’t need another Ted Cruz in the U.S. Senate. (Heck, Texas doesn’t even need the Ted Cruz they’ve got in the Senate!) And we certainly don’t need someone who has voted against women and families for two decades, then tries to swindle you into believing he’ll change and support your rights if elected to the Senate. Michiganders just don’t buy it.
[**So we’re asking: will you chip in $3 to make sure that Michigan’s next Senator isn’t a Ted Cruz 2.0?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240918-4-900&t=3&akid=1948%2E135344%2Ebhm7tR)

| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven't read the book, you know the name. It's _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we're working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America 's greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, "****Mark Twain: **_**Tom Sawyer**_**, **_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** "](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c9882418acc94494922c7e18a87cc983&_e=otlVgby0Dxv22I8sWvubqH8FjkH2ScTJnQyMT4BzO59Gq7HPM0Xrbp5eqKxMEKe4y8QUQS5eRwG8knStg7AJyk65UXn7y_y2ogpeEp1FY1xnJzztta1nhp6BLeR1pUAxOUCT3zV010kXcdj07EPUFxWF1oCA7_PBzsbYPUBiePWib9bOwFabsfC_52noX0dQj7tTnNlJQ0k1fs7oL3UUHCSDWjdC2H7WWVblg-6A_su40ov354ehMM8QCocCqcbc6vEv__DSKQ67RZxEViNVpoMXKi77sG6jzWG80jhzdELGmXjjWCTZdEd1-AHTIsWrmxyi0gc986jJ3og7YYNeDITcsWe8ER0FEPPmuhOjPeZEKLO51Dd2P3XL45xtpWw2KK9-hMn7kC9XlFA7Ey9cCBBA_TQmklZt9efCwShyUPtd8liwAv7kENwINHaYlmVj) Twain's realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. | | Yesterday, Democrats tried – again – to pass legislation to create ironclad protections for the right to start a family through IVF. **And once again, every single Republican voted against the bill.** If you're wondering why it's even necessary to pass this bill, you're not alone. Unfortunately, this is the position Republicans put us in after they gutted protections for our reproductive freedoms when they overturned _Roe v. Wade._ Since then, every facet of reproductive health care has been called into question, and IVF is no different. Earlier this year, the state Supreme Court in Alabama effectively banned the use of IVF in the state, leaving countless couples wondering if and how they would be able to become parents. At the time, we saw a lot of feigned surprise and furrowed brows from Senate Republicans over how this ruling could have possibly happened – **right before they turned around and voted against IVF protections.** In my view, starting a family through IVF shouldn't even be up for debate. But Republicans are hellbent on going after the rights of women and families to make their most intimate decisions free from government intrusion. **They have enabled extremists who won't rest until there's a politician in every bedroom and exam room in America.** And where was JD Vance – who always seems eager to share his thoughts about how women should raise their children – for this vote you might ask? He was a no-show, just like he was earlier this year when we voted on my bill to extend the child tax credit and help 16 million kids. Republicans talk a big game about being "pro-family." Give me a break. These guys are phonies, through and through. Today is just another sobering reminder of why it's so critical to protect and expand our Democratic majority in the Senate this November. clean_body: | | | | Yesterday, Democrats tried – again – to pass legislation to create ironclad protections for the right to start a family through IVF. And once again, every single Republican voted against the bill. If you're wondering why it's even necessary to pass this bill, you're not alone. Unfortunately, this is the position Republicans put us in after they gutted protections for our reproductive freedoms when they overturned Roe v. Wade. Since then, every facet of reproductive health care has been called into question, and IVF is no different. Earlier this year, the state Supreme Court in Alabama effectively banned the use of IVF in the state, leaving countless couples wondering if and how they would be able to become parents. At the time, we saw a lot of feigned surprise and furrowed brows from Senate Republicans over how this ruling could have possibly happened – right before they turned around and voted against IVF protections. In my view, starting a family through IVF shouldn't even be up for debate. But Republicans are hellbent on going after the rights of women and families to make their most intimate decisions free from government intrusion. They have enabled extremists who won't rest until there's a politician in every bedroom and exam room in America. And where was JD Vance – who always seems eager to share his thoughts about how women should raise their children – for this vote you might ask? He was a no-show, just like he was earlier this year when we voted on my bill to extend the child tax credit and help 16 million kids. Republicans talk a big game about being "pro-family." Give me a break. These guys are phonies, through and through. Today is just another sobering reminder of why it's so critical to protect and expand our Democratic majority in the Senate this November. = If Trump and Republicans take control of Congress and the White House, they are sure to keep rolling back the clock on our fundamental rights and freedoms. Peter, Did you hear what President Obama said about fair maps? He was talking about the 2022 midterms and explaining why the “red wave” never crashed. If you remember, heading into the 2022 midterms, the media narrative suggested that Trump’s MAGA allies up and down the ballot were going to sweep state and local offices — and even potentially secure control of both the House _and_ the Senate. But Republicans failed to clinch the Senate and only won back control of the House with a narrow majority. **President Obama said, “What a lot of people didn’t mention (after the election) was because of the work that [Attorney General] Eric [Holder] and NDRC and others had done, we just had a better map. That’s part of the reason that we did not see a red wave. Their work is not glitzy — and the work you’re doing to help elect them can be unseen and pretty thankless. (So in case you haven’t heard today: _Thank you so much_.)

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: so this is our fault?
body:
Dear Peter,

A Georgia woman died after taking Chemical Abortion Pills to kill her preborn twins, and it’s pro-lifers’ fault?

That’s what Kamala Harris and her puppeteers in the pro-abortion press want you and me to believe.

You see, Georgia has a Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law to stop these kinds of tragedies — to protect both mothers and babies.

But this mother decided to ignore the law and travel out of state for a surgical abortion... but was late for her appointment.

So, abortionists sold her some Chemical Abortion Pills instead and sent her on her way.

She developed an infection and died — just as 33 other women (whom we know of) have died after ingesting these pills.

And Kamala Harris and her pals in the press says the solution is to... ensure more women take these pills?

What kind of insane nation are we living in?

Peter, this woman would still be alive today had she not decided her children should die.

But abortionists tell people abortion is their only option — and that Chemical Abortion Pills are safe.

But the truth is, Chemical Abortion Pills:

>>> Now account for 63% (nearly 2/3) of all abortions – equaling hundreds of thousands of deaths per year;

>>> Are being flooded into states across the country by pro-abortion radicals – even illegally, in states with pro-life laws;

>>> Can cause infertility in mothers with certain blood types if they’re not immediately seen and treated by a real doctor;

>>> Have caused the deaths of at least 33 women (whom we know of) after they took these pills; and

>>> Are poisoning our country’s water supply as the bodies of the little babies are flushed down the toilet – and water treatment plants don’t test for OR treat for trace abortion chemicals or human remains.

Pro-life laws don’t kill people.

Abortionists do.

Pro-Life laws save lives.

I will not stand by silently as elites force-feed Americans this misinformation.

You're going to hear this story paraded around a lot by abortion supporters in advance of the election — especially in states where they're looking to pass radical abortion ballot measures.

Check out
this new Students for Life article
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/sIkdjCzUPP40CJE-5LcjWQ~~/AAVkMwA~-hutmH6wrP1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~
to learn more about the story and help my team and I continue setting the facts of this tragedy straight.

The outcome of the November election depends on our constant work to ensure the truth is heard.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Teamsters Leadership Panics, Says Union Won’t Endorse Presidential Candidate After Internal Poll Shows Members Prefer Trump in a Landslide (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/teamsters-leadership-panics-says-union-wont-endorse-presidential-candidate-after-internal-poll-shows-members-prefer-trump-in-a-landslide.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d6144ca498-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The Teamsters' headquarters is seen in Washington, DC, on November 28, 2023. (Carlos Kosienski/Sipa)
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, the Teamsters leadership team were in panic mode after an internal poll amongst its members showed former President Donald Trump dominating Vice President Kamala Harris in a presidential matchup – leading the powerful union to announce that they would not be making an endorsement in this upcoming election – the first time in 30 years, as support for Trump among the working class continues to grow.

The internal polling results, which were released Wednesday afternoon, show Teamsters supporting Trump over Harris 58% – 31% in a phone poll and 59.6% – 34% in an electronic member poll.

Shortly after the results were released, the union’s General Executive Board released a statement saying,

“After reviewing six months of nationwide member polling and wrapping up nearly a year of rank-and-file roundtable interviews with all major candidates for the presidency, the union was left with few commitments on top Teamsters issues from either former President Donald Trump or Vice President Kamala Harris – and found no definitive support among members for either party’s nominee.”

body:
This FL Senator is responsible for one of the largest Medicare fraud scandals in U.S. history. >>>
| | |
---
Hi friend,
I want to take a moment to share why protecting Medicare is so important:
Medicare is a vital government program that provides millions of Floridians access to affordable health care coverage — but each year, it loses roughly $60 billion due to fraud, errors, and abuse.
The system we have in place is not perfect, friend — I know that firsthand. As my mom's primary caretaker, I know how complicated it can be to navigate the Medicare system. It makes ensuring my mom can age with dignity and comfort that much more challenging.

**But I also know the critical role it plays in my mom's life and in the lives of our seniors across the country. **
That's the thing, friend: **We need to _invest in_ these vital government programs, not cut them down or take advantage of them. And if Rick Scott had it his way, that's exactly what he'd do (or continue doing). **
Rick Scott is a scammer and a thief who's responsible for one of the largest Medicare fraud scandals in U.S. history. To add insult to injury, he then went on to write the plan to DEFUND Medicare — _a plan that would put the lives of millions at risk._

It's devastating and, frankly, disgusting how someone would put their own profit and personal gain above the lives of real people. I've spent my career fighting to expand health care access for Americans and to protect our seniors, and I am sick and tired of seeing politicians like Rick Scott make these selfish decisions.
Expanding access to Medicare is one of my highest priorities, friend — and I plan on protecting it when I defeat Rick Scott in November. There are too many Floridians who rely on Medicare for us to let a guy who led one of the largest Medicare-related fraud scandal gut it.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Endorsing a fighter and electorally locking in / Apoyando a un luchador y encerrándose electoralmente
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
All in for Allred
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Colin%20Allred%20TOP%20endorsement.jpg]
When MAGA extremists like Ted Cruz continue to push their vile agenda intended to divide, diminish, and dehumanize working Black and Latino Texans, TOP members and supporters just don’t sit on the sidelines. We mobilize, vote, and fight back. Since his election in 2012, working Texans have seen for themselves how out-of-touch Ted Cruz is with the needs of everyday people. He's too busy being a Trump lackey, and will say and do anything to gain 'respect' in the eyes of the far-right fringe.
Meanwhile, through his work in Congress and in the community, Colin Allred [https://colinallred.com/] has demonstrated he's a listener, leader, and humble public servant who truly believes in a Texas for all. That's why TOP is proud to endorse Colin, as he's an accomplished civil rights attorney who has shown he's committed to championing issues important to our communities — such as good-paying jobs, quality public schools, legal system reform, and the expansion of healthcare access.
Along with millions of others across the country, TOP is ready to turn the page on unhinged Donald Trump and his MAGA loyalist ‘Cancun Cruz.’ Texans can trust Colin Allred to defend our rights and improve our quality of life.
Demanding a humane re-write of the infamous 1994 Crime Bill
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20LaquitaGarciaTOPatCapitol.jpeg]
TOP Statewide Right2Justice Policy Coordinator Laquita Garcia joined board president Dr. Doshie Piper and Dallas board member Julie Alonzo-Rivera in Washington D.C. for a nationwide convening against the 1994 Crime Bill this past week. The days of action were hosted by the People’s Coalition of Safety and Freedom, which TOP is a proud partner of.
Dozens of legal reform advocates, community organizers, and formerly-incarcerated leaders from across the country gathered to emphasize the destructive, harmful impact that the "tough on crime" legislation has had on U.S. families -- especially Black and Latino families -- in the decades since its implementation. Attendees also marched, rallied, and held a press conference outside the Capitol building to demand progressive, community-driven solutions be codified in new legislation that will keep our communities safe while ensuring everyone's basic rights are respected and upheld -- no matter our race, age, nationality, or background.
Learn more about the People’s Coalition of Safety and Freedom and our collective mission to pass smart, humane policy to undo damage from the 1994 Crime Bill. [https://safetyandfreedom.org/the-peoples-bill-for-safety-and-freedom/]
For more information, contact Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Living out our values in recognizing National Hispanic Heritage Month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20NHHM.jpeg]
The following statement is from Michelle Tremillo, TOP Co-Executive Director , on our observance of National Hispanic Heritage Month this year:
“We can't stand idly by at a time when morally bankrupt politicians are spewing vitriol and lies about migrants, particularly our Haitian Afro-Latino brothers and sisters, who are the latest target of Republican racist conspiracies intended to divide us. We show solidarity, speak out, and electorally send a strong message at the ballot box.
“ Honoring National Hispanic Heritage Month means acknowledging the full humanity of ALL who make up and elevate our Latino communities — no matter the color of our skin, the language we speak, or what country we call home. It also means recognizing the growing cultural and political impact we Latinos are having in Texas and across the United States. TOP vehemently rejects this bigotry being spread against migrants and is responding by ramping up our organizing rooted in racial and economic justice, while mobilizing Black and Latino Texas voters to participate in what will be one of the most consequential elections of our lifetime.”
Andrea Osorio, TOP Education Fund board member, added: “As a mother and proud Latina in Texas, I see firsthand the contributions our communities make, as working Latino families like mine are key to fueling the economic engine of our state. Yet, year after year, our increasingly-authoritarian state Republican leaders seek to diminish and divide us through hateful words and policy.
“Texans are worth more. And I am one of millions of Latinos in this state who is ready to build a future where housing is more affordable, healthcare is more accessible, public education is better supported, and our judicial system is more humane. At TOP, we choose to celebrate National Hispanic Heritage Month by remaining committed to manifesting an inclusive vision that gets us closer to our collective liberation.”
In celebration, TOP's Dallas CLT members invite you to a performance from the Aztec dance group Mitotiliztli Yaoyollhti on Thursday, September 19 at 6 p.m. at the Dallas TOP office. [https://www.facebook.com/events/423513990231534/]
TOP Tip: Double-check your name is still on the voter rolls
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Voter%20hands.jpeg]
In typical Abbott fashion, our MAGA-loving governor took to social media last month to tout a voter roll purge of roughly a million people since he signed voting restriction bill SB1 into law in 2021. While he brags about taking action to halt imaginary widespread voter fraud, ordinary working Texans know better and are sick of his political stunts. If you're a Texas voter, double-check you weren't impacted by Abbott's foolishness. [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/09/16/texas-voter-registration-check/]
Español
Todos estamos para Allred
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Colin%20Allred%20TOP%20endorsement.jpg]
Cuando los extremistas de MAGA como Ted Cruz siguen impulsando su vil agenda destinada a dividir, disminuir y deshumanizar a los trabajadores negros y latinos de Texas, los miembros y seguidores de TOP no se quedan de brazos cruzados. Nos movilizamos, votamos y luchamos. Desde su elección en 2012, los trabajadores de Texas han visto por sí mismos lo desconectado que está Ted Cruz de las necesidades de la gente común. Está demasiado ocupado siendo un lacayo de Trump y dirá y hará cualquier cosa para ganarse el "respeto" a los ojos de la extrema derecha.
Mientras tanto, a través de su trabajo en el Congreso y en la comunidad, Colin Allred [https://colinallred.com/] ha demostrado ser un oyente, líder y servidor público humilde que realmente cree en un Texas para todos. Es por eso que TOP se enorgullece de respaldar a Colin, ya que es un abogado de derechos civiles con logros que ha demostrado su compromiso en defender temas importantes para nuestras comunidades, como empleos bien remunerados, escuelas públicas de calidad, la reforma del sistema legal y la expansión del acceso a la atención médica.
Junto con millones de personas más en todo el país, TOP está listo para pasar página y acabar con el desquiciado Donald Trump y su partidario de MAGA, “Cancún Cruz”. Los tejanos pueden confiar en Colin Allred para defender nuestros derechos y mejorar nuestra calidad de vida.
Exigimos que se reescriba de forma humana la infame Ley contra el Delito de 1994
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20LaquitaGarciaTOPatCapitol.jpeg]
La coordinadora de políticas de Right2Justice a nivel estatal de TOP, Laquita García, se unió a la presidenta de la junta, la Dra. Doshie Piper, y a la miembro de la junta de Dallas, Julie Alonzo-Rivera, en Washington D.C. para una reunión nacional contra la Ley contra el Crimen de 1994 la semana pasada. Los días de acción fueron organizados por la Coalición Popular de Seguridad y Libertad, de la que TOP es un orgulloso socio.
Docenas de defensores de la reforma legal, organizadores comunitarios y líderes anteriormente encarcelados de todo el país se reunieron para enfatizar el impacto destructivo y dañino que la legislación de "mano dura contra el crimen" ha tenido en las familias estadounidenses, especialmente en las familias negras y latinas, en las décadas desde su implementación. Los asistentes también marcharon, se manifestaron y realizaron una conferencia de prensa frente al edificio del Capitolio para exigir que se codifiquen en nueva legislación soluciones progresistas y dirigidas por la comunidad que mantengan seguras a nuestras comunidades, mientras se garantiza que se respeten y defiendan los derechos básicos de todas las personas, sin importar su raza, edad, nacionalidad u origen.
Obtenga más información sobre la Coalición Popular por la Seguridad y la Libertad y nuestra misión colectiva de aprobar políticas inteligentes y humanas para reparar el daño causado por la Ley contra el Delito de 1994. [https://safetyandfreedom.org/the-peoples-bill-for-safety-and-freedom/]
Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Laquita en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Vivimos nuestros valores mientras celebramos el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20NHHM.jpeg]
La siguiente declaración es de Michelle Tremillo, codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, sobre nuestra celebración del Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana este año:
“No podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados en un momento en que políticos moralmente corruptos están lanzando odio y mentiras sobre los migrantes, particularmente nuestros hermanos y hermanas haitianos afrolatinos, quienes son el último blanco de las conspiraciones racistas republicanas destinadas a dividirnos. Mostramos solidaridad, alzamos la voz y enviamos un fuerte mensaje en las urnas electorales.”
“Honrar el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana significa reconocer la humanidad plena de TODOS los que conforman y elevan a nuestras comunidades latinas, sin importar el color de nuestra piel, el idioma que hablamos o el país al que llamamos hogar. También significa reconocer el creciente impacto cultural y político que los latinos estamos teniendo en Texas y en todo Estados Unidos. TOP rechaza vehementemente este odio que se está propagando contra los migrantes y está respondiendo intensificando nuestra organización basada en la justicia racial y económica, mientras movilizamos a votantes negros y latinos de Texas para que participen en lo que será una de las elecciones más importantes de nuestra vida.”
Andrea Osorio, miembro de la Junta Directiva del Fondo Educativo TOP, agregó:
“Como madre y orgullosa latina en Texas, veo de primera mano las contribuciones que hacen nuestras comunidades, ya que las familias latinas trabajadoras como la mía son clave para impulsar el motor económico de nuestro estado. Sin embargo, año tras año, nuestros líderes republicanos estatales, cada vez más autoritarios, buscan disminuirnos y dividirnos a través de palabras y políticas de odio.
"Los tejanos valen más. Y soy uno de los millones de latinos en este estado que está listo para construir un futuro donde la vivienda sea más asequible, la atención médica más accesible, la educación pública mejor respaldada y nuestro sistema judicial más humano. En TOP, elegimos celebrar el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana manteniéndonos comprometidos a manifestar una visión inclusiva que nos acerque a nuestra liberación colectiva."
Para celebrar, los miembros del CLT de TOP en Dallas te invitan a una presentación del grupo de danza azteca Mitotiliztli Yaoyollhti el jueves 19 de septiembre a las 6 p. m. en la oficina de TOP en Dallas. [http://www.facebook.com/events/423513990231534/]
Consejos de TOP: Comprueba que todavía eres elegible para votar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Voter%20hands.jpeg]
En su típico estilo, nuestro gobernador amante de MAGA, Abbott, recurrió a las redes sociales el mes pasado para alardear de una purga de aproximadamente un millón de votantes desde que firmó la ley SB1 de restricción del voto en 2021. Mientras se jacta de tomar medidas para detener un fraude electoral generalizado e inexistente, los tejanos trabajadores comunes saben mejor y están hartos de sus trucos políticos. Si eres votante en Texas, verifica que no hayas sido afectado por las tonterías de Abbott. [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/09/16/texas-voter-registration-check/]

TOP vehemently rejects this bigotry being spread against migrants and is responding by ramping up our organizing rooted in racial and economic justice, while mobilizing Black and Latino Texas voters to participate in what will be one of the most consequential elections of our lifetime.” Andrea Osorio, TOP Education Fund board member, added: “As a mother and proud Latina in Texas, I see firsthand the contributions our communities make, as working Latino families like mine are key to fueling the economic engine of our state. Yet, year after year, our increasingly-authoritarian state Republican leaders seek to diminish and divide us through hateful words and policy. “Texans are worth more. And I am one of millions of Latinos in this state who is ready to build a future where housing is more affordable, healthcare is more accessible, public education is better supported, and our judicial system is more humane. At TOP, we choose to celebrate National Hispanic Heritage Month by remaining committed to manifesting an inclusive vision that gets us closer to our collective liberation.” In celebration, TOP's Dallas CLT members invite you to a performance from the Aztec dance group Mitotiliztli Yaoyollhti on Thursday, September 19 at 6 p.m. at the Dallas TOP office. [] TOP Tip: Double-check your name is still on the voter rolls [] In typical Abbott fashion, our MAGA-loving governor took to social media last month to tout a voter roll purge of roughly a million people since he signed voting restriction bill SB1 into law in 2021. While he brags about taking action to halt imaginary widespread voter fraud, ordinary working Texans know better and are sick of his political stunts. If you're a Texas voter, double-check you weren't impacted by Abbott's foolishness. [] Español Todos estamos para Allred [] Cuando los extremistas de MAGA como Ted Cruz siguen impulsando su vil agenda destinada a dividir, disminuir y deshumanizar a los trabajadores negros y latinos de Texas, los miembros y seguidores de TOP no se quedan de brazos cruzados. Nos movilizamos, votamos y luchamos. Desde su elección en 2012, los trabajadores de Texas han visto por sí mismos lo desconectado que está Ted Cruz de las necesidades de la gente común. Está demasiado ocupado siendo un lacayo de Trump y dirá y hará cualquier cosa para ganarse el "respeto" a los ojos de la extrema derecha. Mientras tanto, a través de su trabajo en el Congreso y en la comunidad, Colin Allred [] ha demostrado ser un oyente, líder y servidor público humilde que realmente cree en un Texas para todos. Es por eso que TOP se enorgullece de respaldar a Colin, ya que es un abogado de derechos civiles con logros que ha demostrado su compromiso en defender temas importantes para nuestras comunidades, como empleos bien remunerados, escuelas públicas de calidad, la reforma del sistema legal y la expansión del acceso a la atención médica. Junto con millones de personas más en todo el país, TOP está listo para pasar página y acabar con el desquiciado Donald Trump y su partidario de MAGA, “Cancún Cruz”. Los tejanos pueden confiar en Colin Allred para defender nuestros derechos y mejorar nuestra calidad de vida. Exigimos que se reescriba de forma humana la infame Ley contra el Delito de 1994 [] La coordinadora de políticas de Right2Justice a nivel estatal de TOP, Laquita García, se unió a la presidenta de la junta, la Dra. Doshie Piper, y a la miembro de la junta de Dallas, Julie Alonzo-Rivera, en Washington D.C. para una reunión nacional contra la Ley contra el Crimen de 1994 la semana pasada. Los días de acción fueron organizados por la Coalición Popular de Seguridad y Libertad, de la que TOP es un orgulloso socio. Docenas de defensores de la reforma legal, organizadores comunitarios y líderes anteriormente encarcelados de todo el país se reunieron para enfatizar el impacto destructivo y dañino que la legislación de "mano dura contra el crimen" ha tenido en las familias estadounidenses, especialmente en las familias negras y latinas, en las décadas desde su implementación. Los asistentes también marcharon, se manifestaron y realizaron una conferencia de prensa frente al edificio del Capitolio para exigir que se codifiquen en nueva legislación soluciones progresistas y dirigidas por la comunidad que mantengan seguras a nuestras comunidades, mientras se garantiza que se respeten y defiendan los derechos básicos de todas las personas, sin importar su raza, edad, nacionalidad u origen. Obtenga más información sobre la Coalición Popular por la Seguridad y la Libertad y nuestra misión colectiva de aprobar políticas inteligentes y humanas para reparar el daño causado por la Ley contra el Delito de 1994. [] Para obtener más información, comuníquese con Laquita en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . Vivimos nuestros valores mientras celebramos el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana [] La siguiente declaración es de Michelle Tremillo, codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, sobre nuestra celebración del Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana este año: “No podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados en un momento en que políticos moralmente corruptos están lanzando odio y mentiras sobre los migrantes, particularmente nuestros hermanos y hermanas haitianos afrolatinos, quienes son el último blanco de las conspiraciones racistas republicanas destinadas a dividirnos. Mostramos solidaridad, alzamos la voz y enviamos un fuerte mensaje en las urnas electorales.” “Honrar el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana significa reconocer la humanidad plena de TODOS los que conforman y elevan a nuestras comunidades latinas, sin importar el color de nuestra piel, el idioma que hablamos o el país al que llamamos hogar. También significa reconocer el creciente impacto cultural y político que los latinos estamos teniendo en Texas y en todo Estados Unidos. TOP rechaza vehementemente este odio que se está propagando contra los migrantes y está respondiendo intensificando nuestra organización basada en la justicia racial y económica, mientras movilizamos a votantes negros y latinos de Texas para que participen en lo que será una de las elecciones más importantes de nuestra vida.” Andrea Osorio, miembro de la Junta Directiva del Fondo Educativo TOP, agregó: “Como madre y orgullosa latina en Texas, veo de primera mano las contribuciones que hacen nuestras comunidades, ya que las familias latinas trabajadoras como la mía son clave para impulsar el motor económico de nuestro estado. Sin embargo, año tras año, nuestros líderes republicanos estatales, cada vez más autoritarios, buscan disminuirnos y dividirnos a través de palabras y políticas de odio. "Los tejanos valen más. Y soy uno de los millones de latinos en este estado que está listo para construir un futuro donde la vivienda sea más asequible, la atención médica más accesible, la educación pública mejor respaldada y nuestro sistema judicial más humano. En TOP, elegimos celebrar el Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana manteniéndonos comprometidos a manifestar una visión inclusiva que nos acerque a nuestra liberación colectiva." Para celebrar, los miembros del CLT de TOP en Dallas te invitan a una presentación del grupo de danza azteca Mitotiliztli Yaoyollhti el jueves 19 de septiembre a las 6 p. m. en la oficina de TOP en Dallas. [] Consejos de TOP: Comprueba que todavía eres elegible para votar [] En su típico estilo, nuestro gobernador amante de MAGA, Abbott, recurrió a las redes sociales el mes pasado para alardear de una purga de aproximadamente un millón de votantes desde que firmó la ley SB1 de restricción del voto en 2021. Mientras se jacta de tomar medidas para detener un fraude electoral generalizado e inexistente, los tejanos trabajadores comunes saben mejor y están hartos de sus trucos políticos. Si eres votante en Texas, verifica que no hayas sido afectado por las tonterías de Abbott. [] Copyright (C) 2024 Texas Organizing Project. All rights reserved. Texas Organizing Project 700 S. Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeevkq133r352epbicpjice9ia0hqjk1q63bfh3g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm0o36chh2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: Free speech is no joke
body:
When Elon Musk bought Twitter

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2za4455hlh6ou5o1plsaevd4gb22tbcjlb7662cjo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)
---
|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9sbjgt4ro2a78sh9s3ld1jcevn2oekasnvbiduo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2znd6d4j8rr7utugad0s09ob3mukf4ic56sd4hnug_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4s6bi2j8ebbt3fs9b92m2en81i4j7ukad6t6sb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9cacju1csskrik4grqp8o9mmlqkce0phgh5g5t8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkfhd2qcasi0hsimlf40fap600g09r3cgp9i2v28_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgm8o71c9h2bs)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.
---
Seth Dillon

The first day of in-person early voting takes place tomorrow, Friday, September 20. You can vote at your local registrar's office or other satellite locations in your county. Click [here](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001u9vGUZlgMm-0J48_06Q-AUFxqBab-ATNpRWCzDHvWA3aTKocyOfDW84i29YIn6bAAPJZ0-mBZ-clEBF-qtIaD8ZKTvwPppbG6hSrSBXxTmgYjr3GGKPbIRxefCzfo8DRMyF4pUpdDTdGUVjE0--OERsEuViQqdxB30rQ-S4aLMI=&c=4eX1uW3gVAWOCK92xm9LKhzK3cAUuSrjoB2azwhUrui15bp46U6XGQ==&ch=LTryw1GNilCAGmuhZM0IL6H0y2Qdxk68WTsD_iRpA7eNAcNy8QGbnw==) for more details.
While our primary focus right now is winning this November, we still need to be aware that there will most likely be a Republican Mass Meeting in early December, with a Special Election this coming January 7, 2025 to fill the State Senate Seat currently held by John McGuire.
So many of you will vote in November, December and again in January. The location and exact date will be determined once the Governor calls for the Special Election.
I'm told by Republican leadership that no preparation can be done until Governor Youngkin calls for a Special Election, and then within 5 days the Republican Party will have to have a candidate. So please stay tuned.
We need a senator-elect, who has an 8 year proven voting record that you can trust and will hit the ground running on day one. There will be no learning curve for the winner, as the Special Election will take place the day before session begins.
I've served in the senate for 8 years from 2016-2023 and I'm ready to put my experience to work for the people of Virginia once again. We need a senator who can hit the ground running on day one.
You can trust my conservative 8 year voting record.
100% Family Foundation 100% Virginia Federation of Independent Business 100% VCDL A rating NRA
I'm ready to serve and I humbly ask for your support. If you live in the district, I ask for your vote.
If you don't live in the district, please donate. You may not be able to vote for me but I can vote for you.
Signs, bumper stickers and yard signs are available at all GOP meetings.
Can't make it to a GOP meeting?Reply to this email and we'll be sure to get them to you.
Please email me back with any questions or comments. I will personally reply.

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.

We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.

We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.

We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.

We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.

It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie

Turning

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjhuc7iu4l24al0pgj6uu2a99etn7l8vs1j2kuco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs)

| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zq7jfa54s5hrell2blqovfengfomc56f9gnugf7g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi4oc8lg9nu27gcrv6hh16t0b0m9fm0s2lnmqjsg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg51qgjc045ujkjd6hf897dgv0dl72u7tlcka9b0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zngsi98vqourbripql71kufe8s347uc7l2e34r70_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zprl130772i1fm4vhep5ganfivmi8ahv2cddbpgg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0gnvbtjhpigfpsgu203u12ndpbfcc416arg5568_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdkqtghqa2m2iamrshp5n8jsehak7bsvhm70bj80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctgmeoj1chh2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

# Army Combat Veteran Running for Congress in Nevada
---
LAS VEGAS (April 10, 2024)--Retired Army Colonel Mark Robertson is running for U.S. Congress in Nevada's First Congressional District. Robertson enlisted in the Army as a Private, then rose through the ranks to eventually retire as a Colonel. He was deployed to ten foreign countries, including Afghanistan, Iraq, Kuwait, and Syria combat zones.
Nevada's First Congressional District includes Boulder City, most of Henderson, and the parts of Las Vegas and Clark County east of Interstate 15. Robertson raised his family in this district and has strong ties to the community.
Robertson joined the Army at age 17, just after graduating high school. He completed basic training at Fort Jackson, SC. Many years later, Robertson returned to Ft. Jackson and commanded the same company to which he was assigned as a Private. His son would later join the Army and was assigned to the same training battalion.
Robertson and his son, Sergeant Steve Robertson, deployed to Iraq at the same time in 2010-2011. Robertson says, "It was an honor to serve with my son, but it was terrifying for my wife. She flew a flag with two blue stars outside our house for the year we were deployed." In recognition of his service in Iraq, Robertson received the Bronze Star.
Having served in the enlisted and officer ranks, Robertson is uniquely qualified to represent the Veterans in his district. He comes from a military family where both his parents served in the Navy. His dad was a Corpsman attached to the Marine Corps. Robertson understands the issues facing veterans. "I have a lot of respect and love for the men and women who sacrificed to serve our Nation," Robertson says.
When asked why he is running for Congress, Robertson said, "This is not something I ever thought I would do, but I don't like the direction of our country and want to help things get better." In addition to his 30 years of military service, Robertson owned a small business in Henderson. He has a degree in finance from BYU and an MBA. He taught finance at UNLV. "I know how the economy works and how to balance a budget," he said.
Robertson has experience in Washington, D.C. He served in the Pentagon, was on the faculty of the National Defense University, and was a delegate to the Global Coalition Against ISIS. His military awards include the Legion of Merit, Defense Meritorious Service Medal, Airborne Badge, and Good Conduct Medal.
People can learn more about Robertson at his campaign website, [www.RobertsonForCongress.com](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjAVNxrJYJ20q_SbHoQ8znvtHA0fFYUllUet2DZuWXEHcrAmHbcZxph8qwU8SoDXk6YXysON9RxrX0sIGlh-rbO9QJ0TcPannmfEip1FNm8BurCsIQehRQ_innaMaBGCJMwTXsNn5Vv2apHHxveOo6NSqJFnvCpiHnQwJCf4Nyw=&c=dBE4fOqCr_ZEu-ZCbUamBmkH5KPqnrpLMsX_Kt0sWHWamedTpjJmDQ==&ch=nHOwQbt9-H08ciJuig_FOk_8l7nUUu9_NwTeTl8QIWChxBbZFFCPww==)
Please forward this email to your friends and neighbors and encourage them to support Mark Robertson in his fight to take back our country.

*******

---
Earlier this year, the Las Vegas Review Journal asked Mark three questions that they were going to include in their Voter Guide publication. Below, are Mark's replies to two of the questions. Q. How will you appeal to Nevada's nonpartisan voters? A. For the past 32 years, I have worked, played, served, and worshipped with the people in my district regardless of any party affiliation. They know me, and I know them. Through my work with nonprofit organizations such as Opportunity Village, the Salvation Army, and Veteran groups, I have formed friendships with people of all races, religions, national origins, and economic statuses. As a Certified Financial Planner, I worked with teachers, first responders, hotel service workers, blue-collar workers, and people from all walks of life. As a Congressman, I will be loyal to the Constitution and the people of my district. Q. What would be your top three priorities, if elected, and what specific actions will you take to get them done? A. 1. Sponsor legislation to secure our border to stop the flow of guns, gangs, and drugs into our communities, followed by immigration reform that only allows people into our country with the skills we need and who will not require government assistance. 2. Fight to return regular order to our budgeting process, thus controlling spending on our way to a balanced budget. 3. Introduce legislation to protect parents' right to choose which school is best for their child while reducing or eliminating the federal government's role in education. Education funds should follow the child.

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd46ew_gDBd9jZW3V4s_s3smN4wr-8FTbsjGEYCo-GT2YTcglKkOr1eV_ufl6DXZ74wdGIzpfxH0Gj3ttLrR28MTcQt08JQmM-nnA_J35qqq6iqadMAtCr1Omg0PfvorK_JUANfvshDABNO7P-o_com8%3D) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd1CRrEqoyOeyAcc5SI5t8AcT7VJT6p36VssWRsxdlr9c2A70ZCaOljbb6LhM8FJzroy2f98YBt1j4qyDrgHGKZzWPVEJzrHfDMf7H2WSiwn2WJ4B_UuAnY4Crg3PgdicLctMTiOZFVSWU7Vric2CKSs%3D) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[ Check if you qualify ](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd3lOo6A8-YBsoviZoOOCFUk7nPnS3eydQ1L82nAo1UPP6I3D-nlXNPwJJI0V0-Bv1Y4vj9e6sYlPFfYQuloCp29Vv396dYsy2IBWGe5gk5e4pftSCEeeJuapwjN7jMW7YmundyzQShUPS2r9IbD3_aA%3D)
[ ](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd-3Ao9-54nws5NDRklbVNNKkScW7EYmo-ZROKvy3HZJTP5OCsiUXjdwjEnfmcgknJhOBAcHCYp02n44XAzNOXVuOGA7wd-xy99RmZEhGJSD4bqVbEmqON_422MwMSE0bW3hMqR8KteY3iJ6bXAvYoY0%3D)
What makes [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd6Zq-gL4ILsnnQiuMkjcg49q-NQsK4wkkE_DsEBmsT1veQ6MoBGR65irc1LFzy_tCvu7Vn8N3R99Fg84c1H6tHwzuYHbtG0vgDD4SZH2NtSJJo1kByYjAS8o_G--zWt9ZQrP28moqTyemnLSu8pB9-k%3D) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd6weLXuV__Bi7RRr4lU7g3k163rNJACwaJQgkAd3l7--6O7FHEEx3F9J9M0GfCIK_T5B9q5E8HkDJR7DI_QMgLeo06ZbzhzNOrXqbO5YlsMBsbINef-22eICfXUI4RbzIc-YOSfCn_ZyFs7AkHRJZ0w%3D) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d0357b956a0443cc934744de1723a971&_e=wpHhOVCqyuQ7j0WiOc7dlewsAqP4Ezugwd4NZcnWbizYKaFxQMCMz3AEdz3c4KPg7F7bZl_BDrrYuRipRbzF1JogtUa39bdV4l-shvdo5U4lsZl9D2-xTCint3OlWZF9dwrcZFtQCk2MFHKJNX0SwKpjNmOeZJWbJbzMPEs7aJaCvqwZCW83X6bDICP7fxbd4zUwNQMum57Eh8Z0lnQeJqR3yt9vYFKaYTYbGupAob4z5Bzqqq9iUO-pXuM-y0PN2EMsy4gjeM8OMWhkEzpRLOZ0CugyggMKn9Hl-HU3uUKzBZE6KBPGrhVPG57Xk0-7MaIOpCnTuPesrrDahunSd6SYSayeGKbMesF1X4LqhLhS5XN-AaVCqeQOrOiKF1Xy50X2P2AFjmsKV1HSight-nNO9UWfL8zh2IG4y5hsrYdTBdyznop_gAkevzBdCfmMRImYizcFaONU_glO7OhP7fUSsc1FY9Te6FUpLggDvZo%3D) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

clean_body: Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts | | Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result. The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does. But now, a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry, and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade. It's new IX hearing aid. And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations. It’s no wonder IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America. What makes IX hearing aid so special? It’s one of the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing. This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small. The result? An unprecedented amount of power and clarity. This means that IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for unparalleled, crystal clear sound. “It's not just about volume,” explains founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.” In other words: with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design! Limited no-risk trials now available Click below to check if you qualify for a 45-day no-risk trial. As the Germans always say: "there's never been a better time." # THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19, 2024
---|---

body:

| | |
---
| Hi there,

I wanted to make sure you saw Jessica's email about the Polluters Pay Climate Fund. Nearly 11,000 activists have already added their name to our petition to Congress, and our goal is to submit **15,000 signatures** this month. **Can you help get us there?
**
Having to pay to pollute isn't popular with fossil fuel companies, but local governments shouldn't have to pick up the bill for climate destruction. [**This is your chance to speak out against this injustice and #MakePollutersPay.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873563/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873564/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thanks for all you do,

Eva Piatek
Email Production Manager
Evergreen Action

\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Jessica Hamilton, Evergreen Action
Date: Thur, Sept 12, 2024
Subject: Here's how to #MakePollutersPay |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873565/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi—

**It's time to hold fossil fuel companies accountable.**

If you've lived through this summer of record heat waves, droughts, and floods, then you know that the impacts of climate change are getting worse.

So here's a simple idea: **The corporations most responsible for climate change should pay to address those climate impacts.**

Thankfully, that's just what a new groundbreaking bill in Congress aims to do. [**Will you add your name in support of this commonsense legislation today?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873566/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873567/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Just today, Senator Chris Van Hollen and Congressman Jerry Nadler introduced the Polluters Pay Climate Fund Act, which would require top-polluting fossil fuel companies to pay $1 trillion _(with a "t")_ to a fund dedicated to addressing the impacts of climate change while building a better future.

**This bill would #MakePollutersPay for things like:**
* Rebuilding and upgrading infrastructure
* Cleaning up pollution in frontline communities
* Providing climate-related disaster assistance
* Prioritizing at least 40% of investments for environmental justice communities

|
---
| For over 60 years, fossil fuel companies have known that their business practices are harming our climate and putting all of us in danger, but they lobbied to protect their profits and stall climate action.

**It's past time for Big Polluters to pay their fair share.**

It's time for them to stop leaving it to local governments to pay for addressing the problems that they created.

There's no time to waste. [**You can help now by telling Congress to support the Polluters Pay Climate Fund.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873568/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[MAKE POLLUTERS PAY](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2873569/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Thanks for all you do, |
---

---

## Abilene University To Get Nuclear Reactor
Abilene Christian University has [received federal approval](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQhJ8Gd1iwxiYUFGnc5aSrrrQ2Zp0gYfABtpN7-lPS_9WMNMV8-v7cphv64OPjF65k62tJE87VHzQZLg0HNanG2btwRjZkpYZBq0snVfO0Gs0dlAYy2PUXoUEPwt11b_pBLEq7xlsQoISRRop-6FRLysyXDt0ih85JXJgS5HxNua1PqvTCsoR3Oii3c1qbYJ-1boV1VwYjg_E8z3Yt8bMxGCnyvTAYI52f-PYU-Yzrthce9zkQZp4J55oyx23L6SDHl5T5Hv1Bufj65j7y7y-DETO_XuXf27_fR5Ot204fgi-DZko8VvThy1R_UHRY-B8AAP__ZJlqig) to build a small nuclear research reactor, the first of its kind approved in over 40 years. The reactor, developed in partnership with Abilene-based Natura Resources, will test [molten-salt cooling technology](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOozAQANCvgc7IY3wEFy6uocu1V6KJPQZLBkfjScj-_Urb7x88vf_39Y655HP7hwd5-aS6YpD8ptUpcMrY1fbRP3R00JOHm5ludh7B9rt_AM520inO1oxhhjRBQGcsAGhnQ-qzN9pY7cCB_jONdiDrwjxiTDCNETB1VlPMUnmQnYQ-2FL5qm_iIdSjL34XebZu_NuZpTPLdV3DVblEdb5CIWR10tWGyltnFmTJoVDrzBLq2YRfQXI91ZP4yKI2xlMoqlRZHbUInaphEcXUCDnsigmDVO7Zx-eVS8ltunVWbwfm8qORX3Le3nwHAAD__xV-aug) for use in larger-scale reactors. The University of Texas at Austin and Texas A&M University also have on-campus nuclear reactors. Last year, Gov. Greg Abbott [established a task force](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAQQL9GOwyMrEpBcY3dXnulGWFUEhQDs-7u31-yV1_9XvHyfu7THUMMx_qNO1l-LWlCx-GiyQhlBOhJ197O0htVk1U9dL0eWqXrzbbKyMENNwPoAWYcOumUv7nBK9MTQR0sSNDSKKPkrWt1Q9q4oUW_qK71CpdKS_KBU254I6YXliW-00W5cWmvo92Yz1K1XxWMFYxrupqP1KzpqmA86FkqGM9U-I9SPlIWOM-JWXB6cBHHw0XCLOigvL6Fp4tiOnc6WCCLB4slZCrBk3Abcp2tP58hxlC6vtJy3THETwv_s-ay8BsAAP__GVtptA) within the Public Utility Commission to examine the feasibility of nuclear power to supply the state's growing energy needs.
## Travis County Sues Paxton
Travis County sued Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton and Secretary of State Jane Nelson, accusing them of [violating the National Voter Registration Act](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDEPmzAQRn-N2Yxs4xgYPHRhS9eO6IKP5FTHRvYFyL-v6Fip46dveE_v132-A0VKz5_wRs_nmmdYmHacR6lHaexsm-AfKoy6Qa9743o7dNo2L9-5wazQj2huGnurbi6o_uGUWdCtdsCGvFHGqlGPWt1cZ1u04zJ0EFbtuqBhFVZhIM6l5RcynlDX-M07lnbJ7yb6F_NWRfdDmEmY6TiO9vcJ6TqFmRIeVZgp5gWiMBMX2KnKJX8Sf__dMiIELFVyllvJOwWUny0Ao8xJbnByTjLCUT_E8hKQe2YssuCTKhdgyklSIia42lzcpviwHRQjVdcLq55voPjXm_-TcffmTwAAAP__8SF6UQ) by trying to prevent the county from mailing unsolicited voter registration applications to unregistered voters. Paxton claimed the program could cause ineligible voters to be added to the state rolls, while county officials say they're obligated to [encourage voter participation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDEPmzAQRn-N2Yxs4xgYPHRhS9eO6IKP5FTHRvYFyL-v6Fip46dveE_v132-A0VKz5_wRs_nmmdYmHacR6lHaexsm-AfKoy6Qa9743o7dNo2L9-5wazQj2huGnurbi6o_uGUWdCtdsCGvFHGqlGPWt1cZ1u04zJ0EFbtuqBhFVZhIM6l5RcynlDX-M07lnbJ7yb6F_NWRfdDmEmY6TiO9vcJ6TqFmRIeVZgp5gWiMBMX2KnKJX8Sf__dMiIELFVyllvJOwWUny0Ao8xJbnByTjLCUT_E8hKQe2YssuCTKhdgyklSIia42lzcpviwHRQjVdcLq55voPjXm_-TcffmTwAAAP__8SF6UQ) under federal and state laws. Earlier this month, Paxton sued to block taxpayer-funded initiatives to register voters in Travis and Bexar counties.

On Monday, a judge [denied Paxton's request](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OrCAUAOCnwQ7D36AUFLexm9tuaVAOejYOTOCM47z9JtvvE3zJ93Wf7wEPzNv_8ABPVypzWAlPmB2Xjiszmy76RUQnO_ByUHYwo5am2_046mhBDlIkY1cxxkUncMtNBKetXYcOvRLKCCedFDerTQ_GraMOMUmrowyJGQERqdSediC4QkvHp5xQ-7U8usPvRM_G9D-mJqamFnLIVDKWCs9SqS91Y2r6fsUNeMMIjb-Rdr7AFSpfyyvTh5-FoPIKGzaqgbBkDimVSkxNXfXx-cbjwGYHZsT2CHj80vTHxOnVTwAAAP__jMVj8g) for a restraining order against Bexar County because the voter registration applications had already been mailed.
## Study: Texans' Car-Cleaning Habits
Over 15% of Texas car owners--around 3.2 million people--[rarely deep clean their cars](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z72O6yAQQOGnwR0WPxNsCorbuMttt7QmZjBIBCLDxsnbrzb99kf6dL6u6xVTTmX_j3dy_RXqiltPT1otl5YrWGHw7ia8lQM5OSkzwawlDNHNIswXDaQUgg1hBj1ZY_xkUBBqIYbklFAgrLRSXIyGkcBus0YfpNFeYmAgyKdej7FH6vTCFvK7PukYt3ofsou9PxrT_5hamFrO8xwfWDzG79tvwNRyy3VnaumReOvYidfANzx4fO-JCvEtE5acCrXGU-EfYjicf5wp59TMxEDsd0z5A_Y__p9O_QQAAP__yR1epg), according to a study by Panda Hub, a website that lets users schedule car wash and detailing services. The study claims that car seats can carry high levels of bacteria and are a [prime vector in spreading sickness](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuhDAQBb_GdEbexTbnwkUaukubEhnvclgx-AQWXP4-uvSpn95oNF_38R5STtvjM6zs62suY4g1nTw6CU6iHnVDflLkoGEPPdpe3zrQzeINOdBRBXKd6wOYGW0PdiI1swND0CSPCrVy4EAZ2-mWtYu3LtAMtiMIs9CKKdWyt3Xhyq9wzPmnnLy3saxN9kutz0N0HwIHgcN1Xe13Sqme71ngEPaaYmaBw8bXIXDIJYYscFjLUeWbtx2SitxKlcT8lDFz2GRdOO0yhv19MaqTZNCiUVqigV7qoFlO2oGcAGMfrYsGqNk9Pa-UczpsL7R6rCHlP836T7XT428AAAD__78ObMc). The survey of 400 Texas car owners also found that 46% of drivers regularly eat or drink in their car, and over 55% have performed a sexual act in a car at some point.

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsk94FiWNC

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes?

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osk94FiWNC

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn
asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take
our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your
input.

If so,
here is a link to the survey:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63565887:sk94FiWNC:m:3:2627245898:0683E7B34FC02D30293482543B737722:r

Sincerely,

Hillsdale
College

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From:
Larry P. Arnn
Subject:
Survey on an urgent matter

Friend,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63565887:sk94FiWNC:m:3:2627245898:0683E7B34FC02D30293482543B737722:r

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as ";Constitution 101" and ";The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63565887:sk94FiWNC:m:3:2627245898:0683E7B34FC02D30293482543B737722:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been ";pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
