name: Dan Osborn
subject: why I was fired
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Adam for Colorado
body:
As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93109353/499405917/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTEyNjBhZS03ZTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sMEGczJg7Cfr2DlVuu7vRAqbB0wzPceHzpFwFvPrjds=&emci=abf5e70d-ac74-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fe1260ae-7e76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93109357/499405920/92586991?refcode=em20240919am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=fe1260ae-7e76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTEyNjBhZS03ZTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sMEGczJg7Cfr2DlVuu7vRAqbB0wzPceHzpFwFvPrjds=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93109358/499405927/92586991?refcode=em20240919am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=fe1260ae-7e76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTEyNjBhZS03ZTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sMEGczJg7Cfr2DlVuu7vRAqbB0wzPceHzpFwFvPrjds=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
FIVE polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am even LEADING her by 2 points.
**I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**
**[Please, will you make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate right now – whatever you can afford – to help me defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93109359/499405928/92586991?refcode=em20240919am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=fe1260ae-7e76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZTEyNjBhZS03ZTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sMEGczJg7Cfr2DlVuu7vRAqbB0wzPceHzpFwFvPrjds=)**

clean_body: As president of our local union, I led the strike. Hey there, In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years. I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family. When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after. But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers. So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. = It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class. After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone. It was one of the proudest moments of my life. = Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block. It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me. Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her. FIVE polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am even LEADING her by 2 points. I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. I’m counting on your support to win. Thank you, Dan Osborn ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. Friend

This weekend I had the opportunity to celebrate my grandfather Duffy Daugherty's legacy at Michigan State while his 1965 and 1966 teams were honored with a place in the school hall of fame!
With that in mind, I wanted to share a little more about his life. He served our country in New Guinea in World War II, and then came home and won two national championships as the head football coach at Michigan State. Even more important for my family's legacy, he led the way on integrating college football during the 1950s and '60s, welcoming black players from the deep south and forming the first truly integrated teams anywhere in the nation.
I had the great privilege recently of reading all of my grandfather's letters home during the war. What struck me was that it was his experience with military service that shaped his worldview and planted the seeds for the great things to come in his life. One letter in particular jumped out at me. On May 12, 1943, from the jungles of New Guinea, he wrote to his mom and dad:
"I've learned a lot from the war . . . I know that I'll try never to be narrow-minded about anyone or anything again. Every time I look at the soldiers around me, all nationalities, all different religions and all different races yet we are all here with the same purpose, with the same ideals, working under the same conditions, there just aren't any distinctions or prejudices over here."

| Just a decade later, this enlisted Army Private from coal-mining country in Western Pennsylvania, who finished the war a Major, was the head football coach at Michigan State. He went on to win back-to-back national championships with a black starting quarterback in 1966 and a fully integrated team that included 20 black players, many from the deep south who had no other opportunities to play major college football due to the prejudices of the day.
Reading my grandfather's war letters showed me that it was his service experience that paved the way for these historic accomplishments. War is the great equalizer, and in the jungles of New Guinea in the midst of a brutal fight, my grandfather saw the basic human dignity and equality in all of us. I hope his legacy inspires you this week as it has inspired me throughout my life.

Doctors let Amber suffer in pain for 20 hours before they finally intervened – by then, it was too late. Candi was too fearful to even enter a hospital. We are working to unseat each and every legislator who passed abortion bans – in every single abortion ban state across the country. That is why we are reaching out today – to tell you about our endorsed candidate in TN, who has a story of her own. We’ll start with a powerful excerpt from a recent article about her in NPR: “The path to Tennessee politics for Allie Phillips began last year in her doctor's office. She was 19 weeks pregnant when she got the devastating news about her unborn daughter: only two of the four chambers in her heart were formed.” Following the diagnosis, Doctors warned that continuing the pregnancy would endanger Allie’s life. But, as you may know by now, the Tennessee state legislature, which is 85% male, passed a near-total ban on abortion in 2022. Fellow American,

Are you ready to make history? Let me tell you about the #1 sleeper race in the country.

**Kamala Harris: Could She Be The New Threat to Your Wealth?** Many Americans believed that Joe Biden’s presidency was a low point for the nation, with increasing taxes, rising inflation, and a faltering economy. However, the prospect of **Kamala Harris taking the reins has left many questioning if things could get even worse**. For the middle class, retirees, and anyone invested in 401Ks, Harris' policies may pose an even greater risk to financial stability.

**The Threat to Middle-Class Wealth and Retirement**

Kamala Harris' tax plan has been a point of concern for many. If implemented, it could significantly impact middle-class Americans, particularly those who are relying on their 401Ks and retirement savings. Harris has proposed higher taxes on wealth, which would hit not only the rich but also those who have diligently saved for retirement. The increase in taxes could mean that the[ **hard-earned savings of millions of Americans will be eroded** ,](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=1wc3bbt3ry5jfcfumct5xjaz6nubadxuhnwdthuhyzbgqzstj6y0maq27e8sces6sp0u7z96pvcpf36xkugwkf0e6x75odsmwo0wz38z6e6a6lqk8x0n2xmdrm85luo16wa233gvikw16zcnpn0lm7my3wimhrp4w3cbp9sas2iw6v0fvn7vqxvklc58i6rx47h0dqimhprh05fg9vnt76imt1rp5tfzkpwgg7uiwx7po8hbvd9gk8316&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sk2ao4&__onlt=h) leaving them with less money to live on in their retirement years. Moreover, Harris' proposal to tax **unrealized gains raises significant concerns for investors and the broader economy.** By taxing gains that have not yet been realized, the policy could force individuals to pay taxes on investments that might decrease in value the following year, potentially resulting in financial strain if the market turns bearish. This could devastate retirees who rely on their 401Ks, as they might be forced to liquidate assets prematurely to cover these taxes,[**significantly reducing their retirement nest egg.**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=1wc3bbt3ry5jfcfumct5xjaz6nubadxuhndd9780t6h54rsw5ly86ge8omc7jsyvysfafd3pmujhbqtcq72cw5d6soyg0u8fw0ft55vg3cwqrr4hr8tncqzkx70p6icke2s2z007xxq9ddx8232x4i5zwlvvr8gc94g2k2scdbggfnxvh67z5j78a3o3segq26id640ckzl205ulhpj0p2y7n1l1elbhhtsvnsg381vff6g7fmsaxpsfb&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sk2ao4&__onlt=h)

Additionally, Harris's plan to increase the corporate **tax rate could prompt businesses to offset higher taxes by cutting costs,** often through layoffs, which could lead to higher unemployment. This combination of policies risks creating a challenging economic environment, where both individual and corporate financial stability are threatened, potentially stifling economic growth and increasing economic inequality. **The Weakening Dollar and Economic Instability**

Under Harris’s potential presidency, the dollar is likely to face significant pressure. The Fed is already torn between keeping interest rates high, which could lead to bank failures and increased unemployment, or cutting interest rates, which would fuel inflation and further weaken the dollar. The dollar's weakening isn't just a hypothetical scenario. **The rise of BRICS nations (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa)** has already started to challenge the dominance of the U.S. dollar as the world's reserve currency. If the dollar loses its status, we could see a significant devaluation, leading to higher costs for imports, everyday goods, and services—stretching the budgets of[ **American families even thinner**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=1wc3bbt3ry5jfcfumct5xjaz6nubadxuhnkd0uj5nc0rg7syqeys316qsf7l44eiewyhrgjw7u5pxbegfhmi5utwc42ua91ovbypz7h10ak4zggexhkoq815d3ewqn5ipw836i5hm88uohs4ch46lx0b2q6dl2onk5jsuhsf3of5s46m717cj8guosuk1r9705ktwf571ku90585t8uvuko452ucsty3exo7ec59htimm4ec2fzu8ugxw&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sk2ao4&__onlt=h). [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=1wc3bbt3ry5jfcfumct5xjaz6nubadxuho5cdgym695cvlsazxyzl7wwxnbcmel9kas21kdd4tohu13l9vv1ch7klhu7nlfhvqrm5m67jzngimwbevrp21qoj0wdxbwfl203cenukh2cjln1rz5eg9hcveg0uhfjz70g3ashqlds2id0ui7gawte0fbey1zlk507lu9z591s04jn3342ag20l32r3lunbb7i9lssuk8cd2d8oognha8pt&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sk2ao4&__onlt=h) **What a Kamala Harris Presidency Could Mean for You** If Kamala Harris wins, the middle class could face **higher taxes, diminished retirement accounts, and a weaker dollar** —all contributing to a more challenging financial landscape. Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Teamsters Leadership Panics, Says Union Won’t Endorse Presidential Candidate After Internal Poll Shows Members Prefer Trump in a Landslide (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/teamsters-leadership-panics-says-union-wont-endorse-presidential-candidate-after-internal-poll-shows-members-prefer-trump-in-a-landslide.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=e9ab5f4dbf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The Teamsters' headquarters is seen in Washington, DC, on November 28, 2023. (Carlos Kosienski/Sipa)
By Illinois Review

On Wednesday, the Teamsters leadership team were in panic mode after an internal poll amongst its members showed former President Donald Trump dominating Vice President Kamala Harris in a presidential matchup – leading the powerful union to announce that they would not be making an endorsement in this upcoming election – the first time in 30 years, as support for Trump among the working class continues to grow.

The internal polling results, which were released Wednesday afternoon, show Teamsters supporting Trump over Harris 58% – 31% in a phone poll and 59.6% – 34% in an electronic member poll.

Shortly after the results were released, the union’s General Executive Board released a statement saying,

“After reviewing six months of nationwide member polling and wrapping up nearly a year of rank-and-file roundtable interviews with all major candidates for the presidency, the union was left with few commitments on top Teamsters issues from either former President Donald Trump or Vice President Kamala Harris – and found no definitive support among members for either party’s nominee.”

clean_body: In a shocking move not made since 1988, dominant labor union Teamsters declines to endorse the Democrat presidential candidate, citing Trump support. view in browser () | update preferences () | unsubscribe () This IR e-Blast Powered By: Dear Peter, We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump. Teamsters Leadership Panics, Says Union Won’t Endorse Presidential Candidate After Internal Poll Shows Members Prefer Trump in a Landslide () The Teamsters' headquarters is seen in Washington, DC, on November 28, 2023. (Carlos Kosienski/Sipa) By Illinois Review On Wednesday, the Teamsters leadership team were in panic mode after an internal poll amongst its members showed former President Donald Trump dominating Vice President Kamala Harris in a presidential matchup – leading the powerful union to announce that they would not be making an endorsement in this upcoming election – the first time in 30 years, as support for Trump among the working class continues to grow. The internal polling results, which were released Wednesday afternoon, show Teamsters supporting Trump over Harris 58% – 31% in a phone poll and 59.6% – 34% in an electronic member poll. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Shortly after the results were released, the union’s General Executive Board released a statement saying, “After reviewing six months of nationwide member polling and wrapping up nearly a year of rank-and-file roundtable interviews with all major candidates for the presidency, the union was left with few commitments on top Teamsters issues from either former President Donald Trump or Vice President Kamala Harris – and found no definitive support among members for either party’s nominee.” Teamsters President Sean O’Brien speaks during the RNC in July. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1949%2E135344%2ENwvzXn)

Over the past few weeks, you have probably seen an Election Day countdown. You may have read an email warning you that there are “just 60 days left to make a difference,” or something similar.
And that’s all true.
But I want to reframe things a little bit, because here in Michigan, as with many states, voting does not just happen on Election Day.
Starting September 26th, just one week from today(!), absentee ballots will go out in the mail and voters will begin casting their ballots in this election.
So instead of 47 days, I hope you will think of 7 days until voting day. In 2022, over 1.9 million voters voted via absentee ballot, a full 42% of voters. So 7 days is how much time we have to reach the voters before they get busy making their choices and casting their ballots.
My experience with past campaigns has taught me that a lot of people choose to chip in — either for the first time or a repeat donation — with just 5 or 10 days left before the November election.
But because of Michigan’s extended window for voting, we cannot afford to wait until October 26th or November 1st to see that wave of support, and use it productively to engage voters. By then, voters will have been casting their ballots for over a month, and hundreds of thousands of Michiganders will have made up their mind.
In a race that could be decided by tens of thousands of votes, getting in front of these voters early — before they cast their ballots — is critical.
[**So with one week until the start of voting in Michigan, I am asking you to chip in $3 directly to my campaign for Senate in Michigan. I would not ask if I was not confident your contribution could make a difference.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240919-1-900&t=2&akid=1949%2E135344%2ENwvzXn)

Team — you can hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in their increasingly desperate attacks.
As they frantically search for something, _**anything**_ they can tether to a coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they picked a familiar target — yours truly.
“**Shifty Schiff** has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the most **despicable** and **disgusting** elected officials in Congress.”
All because I called Trump out on _CNN_ for flip-flopping on the fundamental right to abortion — no less than 4 times in _48 hours_. **His willingness to change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral compass or values at all. # Make your voice heard
Stand With Crypto was founded to give the crypto community a voice in major policy debates. As policymakers in DC discuss the future of crypto in America, they need to hear from you!

Luckily, SWC makes it easy to get active. We have simple and easy tools that allow you to email your member of Congress or call their office and let them know that you care about crypto. All you need to do is enter your address and we’ll make sure your email or call is routed correctly.

body:
Package addressed to secretary of state, containing white powder substance, under investigation
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,

We can take action now to register voters and Chase Ballots into the ballot box. We have 48 more days to make a difference in this election. We have candidates across Colorado who need your help. Go to []()[rtrdash.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and volunteer to contact your fellow conservatives.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, September 19, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Package addressed to secretary of state, containing white powder substance, under investigation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A package containing white powder addressed to the Colorado Secretary of State’s office has been intercepted at a state mail facility.
The package included a return address of “U.S. Traitor Elimination Army.” Similar packages have been received by several secretaries of state, first reported Tuesday, Sept. 17, the Colorado Secretary of State’s office noted in a press release.
Investigations by the FBI, U.S. Postal Inspection Service and Colorado State Patrol preliminarily indicate the powder included in the package is harmless. Often, investigations of such packages are found to be gypsum, a harmless white mineral common to chalk, drywall and plaster.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘We have reached the end of our rope’: Business owners call on city leaders to solve vagrancy in rural town](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Residents of Fort Morgan, Colorado, are expressing strong concerns about increasing vagrancy and related disturbances such as public drug use and trespassing, with business owners reporting significant impacts on their operations and safety.
* The Fort Morgan City Council and local police are actively engaging with the community through public meetings to address the vagrancy issue, although efforts are hindered by state laws that limit enforcement actions.
* Efforts to manage the vagrancy issue persist, with suggestions to use the city’s home rule status for more stringent measures, while the community is encouraged to participate in discussions for a collective resolution.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Candidates rally support at Delta County’s ‘Food and Freedom Forum’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Attendees at the Delta County 'Food and Freedom Forum' expressed deep concerns over the nation's political trajectory, with 2024 seen as pivotal in deciding between advancing socialist policies or preserving republican values.
* Representative Matt Soper praised House Bill 24B-1001 for delivering tangible property tax relief, reflecting conservative victories in Colorado.
* Candidates highlighted adverse impacts of energy policies on rural jobs and emphasized the importance of protecting water rights and local resources.
* The forum stressed the power of individual votes in shaping policies that align with local values rather than broader urban agendas. Candidates urged public engagement in politics to safeguard rural Colorado's lifestyle and manage resources effectively, promoting local over corporate interests.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver’s fur ban initiative has fly-fishers and cowboy hat makers worried too](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver's Initiated Ordinance 308 proposes to ban the manufacture, sale, trade, and display of select fur products, extending its impact beyond fashion to affect fly-fishing shops and custom hat makers who maintain local traditions.
* The ordinance is causing concern among diverse groups, including fly fishers worried about their inventory and hat makers who utilize fur in their products, highlighting the wide-reaching consequences of the ban.
* Despite an exemption in the ordinance allowing Indigenous people from federally recognized tribes to buy fur for cultural uses, critics argue the provision is too narrow and excludes many self-identified Indigenous individuals who aren't officially enrolled.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Experts predict up to 2.7M votes will be cast by illegal immigrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Between 1.5 million and 2.7 million illegal immigrants are expected to vote in the 2024 U.S. elections, influenced by recent high immigration rates and controversial federal policies.
* This potential illegal voting is driven by specific federal laws and local policies that may inadvertently facilitate noncitizen voting, challenging the integrity of the electoral process.
* The House of Representatives has passed the SAVE Act to address these issues by requiring verification of U.S. citizenship for voter registration, although it faces opposition in the Senate.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[MIG REPORTS: Is the Harris campaign crashing?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MIG REPORTS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Post-debate, enthusiasm among Trump supporters increased, while support for Harris waned, reflecting a potential turning point where Trump's voter base shows heightened engagement and Harris's shows signs of disengagement.
* Media narratives and events like the second assassination attempt on Trump have rallied support for him while casting a negative light on Harris and the Democrats, contributing to a surge in Trump’s polling advantage.
* Analysis from MIG Reports suggests Trump's appeal is strong in key demographics and swing states due to his policies on economic growth and border security, while Harris struggles with perceptions of being out of touch and weak on immigration.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Fed opts for bigger interest rate cut in first downward revision since pandemic](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Federal Reserve cut its interest rate target by half a percentage point, the first decrease in over four years, setting the new rate between 4.75% to 5.00%.
* The rate cut indicates the Fed's shift from prioritizing inflation control to addressing concerns about an economic slowdown and potential recession, aiming to sustain labor market strength amid moderated growth.
* Despite the rate cut, challenges persist with rising unemployment predictions and modest GDP growth forecasts, reflecting ongoing economic adjustments and the impact of previous high interest rates on the broader economy.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Hillary Clinton wants to jail Americans for ‘misinformation’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Hillary Clinton proposed on MSNBC that Americans spreading "misinformation" and Russian propaganda should face prosecution, a stance criticized as conflicting with First Amendment rights.
* Clinton herself has been implicated in spreading Russian propaganda through the Trump-Russia collusion narrative, initiated by her campaign's employment of Fusion GPS and Christopher Steele to investigate Trump.
* The article argues that if such prosecutions were to begin, Clinton should be among the first to be charged due to her role in disseminating the debunked Steele dossier, which falsely linked Trump to Russian interests.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Gaines: Progressive press slathers bias on Venezuelan gang story](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CORY GAINES, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I feel sorry for the residents of the Aurora apartment complex dealing that have ended up in the national spotlight as part of the Venezuelan gang story as of late. Besides living in what seems like crappy conditions, they have all unwittingly become a bone to be fought over. I agree with Aurora Mayor Mike Coffman, as he recently told the Colorado Sun, when he says that he feels this whole situation “... has been exploited for political gain.”_
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Devotional: Accountability? The buck really stops with you](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DRAKE HUNTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_When discussing accountability as leaders, we often think about who’s accountable to us. But, hold up a second. What about you? Do you hold yourself accountable to life’s goodness, navigating it with integrity and grace? Or are you on a power trip, unsure of what accountability means?_
_Let’s face it, many people confuse accountability with responsibility, or worse, they think it’s about being in tune with their feelings, intuitions and desires. Well, that’s part of it, but let’s break it down. Accountability is much deeper and is the secret sauce to living a meaningful and peaceful life. Yes, both._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Denver’s Initiative 309 slaughterhouse ban impacts national lamb supply chain](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY LINDY BROWNING | LOCAL | SEPTEMBER 17** _As J Paul Brown of Ignacio, Colo., gets ready to bring his sheep back to the lowlands for the fall roundup, he contemplates the impact of Denver’s Initiative 309, which singles out the largest lamb processing plant in Colorado for closure._
__
**[Optics were more important to Biden-Harris Administration than protecting Afghanistan 13, Rep. Lopez says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | SEPTEMBER 17** _As America paused on 9/11 last week to remember those lost in terrorist attacks on New York City, U.S. Rep. Greg Lopez went to the floor of the U.S. House to address the country’s exit from the resulting war in Afghanistan._
**_[Ganahl: Kamala’s ‘lawful pathways’ program floods U.S. with 1 million-plus migrants, escalates crime in Colorado’s sanctuary cities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY HEIDI GANAHL | STATE | SEPTEMBER 17** _In a staggering development, newly released data from U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) reveals that nearly 530,000 migrants have flown into the United States and been paroled into the country under the Joe Biden-Kamala Harris administration’s controversial CHNV mass parole program._
__

"Socialism states that you owe me something simply because I exist. Capitalism, by contrast, results in a sort of reality-forced altruism: I may not want to help you, I may dislike you, but if I don't give you a product or service you want, I will starve. name: PoliticsPA
subject: PA flips the script on Election 2024
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment dives into Pennsylvania's response to the Trump-Harris debate and highlights the **two key voter demographics****** both campaigns are targeting to secure a win in the Keystone State this November.

Pennsylvania Auditor General **Tim DeFoor** and Top Election Predictor **Dr. Allan Lichtman** shared views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **PA Auditor General Tim DeFoor** reflected on his office's audit of Gov. Wolf's COVID-19 business closure and waiver program, stating, "As far as what happened during COVID – there wasn't any consistency, and there wasn't any transparency with regards to what's going on." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b7c5a56019&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Top Election Predictor Dr. Allan Lichtman** predicted a Kamala Harris win in November, and urged viewers to ignore the "political industrial complex" that generates "huge money from the horse race theory of elections." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=89e8973471&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**_Voices of Reason_ host and former York County Election Director Steve Ulrich** noted potential challenges to election results, stating, "If Pennsylvania is as close as it was in the last two, anything will be fair game," a point highlighted by **CNN's Michael Smerconish**. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2b092c2cf8&e=b7b3eddce2)]

In an interview on **WNYC's Brian Lehrer Show** , Steve Ulrich identified three key counties—Erie, Bucks, and Northampton—which flipped between Trump in 2016 and Biden in 2020. "Those are the bellwethers to keep an eye on in our state when you look at 2024." [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=13eb13b02f&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Elections_
* Tuesday's **debate watchers favored Harris 63% to 37%** , despite being evenly split on expectations beforehand. [[CNN](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d6180dcd2e&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* Post-debate, 96% of Harris supporters and 69% of Trump supporters said their candidate performed better. [[CNN](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a43e4f39f2&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Public Opinion_
* **60% of Pennsylvanians surveyed had a negative view of the state's economy** , while 36% responded with a positive view of the state's economy. [[Common Ground Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=14bfde96bf&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Turnout_
* In the 2024 primary, **25% of early voters were Republicans** , indicating a shift in the party's strategy to encourage early voting, a departure from its 2020 approach. [[L2 Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0c5121ec43&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Undecided PA Voters React to the Trump-Harris Debate**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cd10b4c6c9&e=b7b3eddce2 "Pennsylvania Reacts to Trump-Harris Debate | Voices of Reason Ep. 9")
---
| | Plus, special guests discuss the impact of two key demographics Trump & Harris are targeting in PA: **suburban women and Latino voters**. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5faed514b1&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
|
---
| The Keystone Candidate Forum is a collaborative series hosted by _Voices of Reason_ , sponsored by the PA Chamber of Business & Industry.

Our goal: **everyone gets a fair shake in the Keystone Candidate Forum** with the belief that balanced dialogue provides every candidate an unfettered platform to share their views.

The forum spotlights competitive races across Pennsylvania, including statewide elections and key swing districts that could shift the balance of power in the state legislature.

Airing from September through October, the forum will stream online and be broadcast across the Philadelphia metropolitan area, with detailed recaps featured in the _Voices of Reason_ newsletter.
_In Case You Missed It..._

_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5d9d027aa6&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=65974fd8e3&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=68c8c0b8dd&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=22031eac3f&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5ac43d951c&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Overcoming the odds is nothing new for me,
Peter.

When I first ran for Congress, no one thought I could win. I ended up
winning that race and became the very first woman elected to the House of
Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be the last time our team
would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, grassroots supporters (like you!)
fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us off. You helped me
become the first woman elected to the Senate from our state and the first
openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

When you defy the odds as much as I have, people start to ask: what’s your
secret?

But I’m here to bust their bubble, because there is no “secret sauce.”

My “secret” is showing up all over the state. It’s listening to people.
Hearing their concerns. Then taking those concerns back to inform my work
in Washington.

It’s what separates me from my right-wing opponent who’s trying to buy
this Senate seat — a California megamillionaire who moved back to
Wisconsin when it was politically convenient.

Eric Hovde has a long history of disparaging the Wisconsinites he’s
seeking to represent — from saying farmers just drive around in tractors
to claiming people in nursing homes shouldn’t vote, and a whole lot more I
can’t all fit here...

But what he lacks in experience and understanding, he makes up for with a
personal fortune that’s self-funding his campaign to flip Wisconsin red.
He and his Republican allies have already plastered Wisconsin with $45
million worth of ads, and they’re not done yet.

While I continue to visit Wisconsinites from Milwaukee to Bayfield, I
could really use your support to make sure my campaign has the resources
to fight back against the flood of Republican attacks coming my way.

clean_body: These two core values changed it all Throughout my life, my parents always emphasized two core values: hard work and service to others. I’ve made it my mission to live by those values every day, and now, I need your help to keep going. = | | = I served my community as a pediatrician, and as I listened to my patients and their families struggle with rising costs and limited access to affordable care, I knew I had to do something to give our patients and doctors the tools to keep our families healthy. That’s why I decided to run for office. There, those values led me to force Big Pharma to lower the costs of prescription drugs, expand access to family and sick leave, and pass a first-in-the-nation cap on insulin prices for the Coloradan families. Now, in Congress, I’m continuing to fight for what’s right – affordable healthcare, lower drug prices, and protections for working families. # Has the Government Gone Too Far?
---
| Having faced many challenges growing up as the child of migrant workers, my heart has always gone out to the troubled youth I identified with. In 2014, hoping to make an impact on the lives of these youth, I ran and was elected to the Hollister School Board.
At one of my first school board meetings, we were asked to approve routine agenda items including changing the word **PUPIL** to **STUDENT** in all of the district’s governing documents to “align with the state of California”. This was a slight-of-hand effort by the government to strip parents of their rights. The definition of **PUPIL** is _**a person under a guardian (i.e. parent)**_. The definition of **STUDENT** is _**one who attends classes at school (i.e. no parent permission required)**_.
Erin Friday, a local attorney and parental rights advocate, found how devastating this little terminology change played out when she was summoned to her daughter’s school. Her child had an important announcement. Backed up and encouraged by the school counselors, Erin’s daughter announced that “she” was now a “he” and this was “his” new name. Erin was devastated but was warned that if she tried to transition her child back, the child would commit suicide.
**When they come after our children,****the government has gone too far.**
Because of Erin’s experience, and that of countless other parents, I boldly stand for parental rights. My billboards say, **“When they come after our children, the government has gone too far.”** This wording might seem too strong, but when schools secretly transition children and hide that from parents... they have gone too far.
As a Democrat, Erin first tried to reach out to Democrat legislators to get safeguards in place for children. She was totally rebuffed. It was Republican legislators including State Senator Shannon Grove and Assemblyman Bill Essayli who have tried to help.
Today Erin is part of _Our Duty_ , a worldwide organization fighting on behalf of parents and children. You can read and join her Substack here: [https://tinyurl.com/OurDutySubstack](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=b33cd173ea&e=638e6c2751).
Although still registered as a Democrat, Erin Friday has endorsed me for Congress and is making clear that Democrats need to support Republican candidates to bring an end to this gender turmoil with our kids.
---
[](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=2086d6adfe&e=638e6c2751)
| _"I support Peter Hernandez. He is pro-family and supports transparency in schools. His adversary, Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren, has been in office since 1995. She pretends to care about “ our daughters & granddaughters,” yet she is an advocate for males who believe that they are women and can enter and participate as females in sports and gain entrance into female-only spaces, and calling Gail Heriot of the US Commission on Civil Rights a “bigot” for believing in biologic reality.”_Erin Friday, Esq.
---
| I am proud that activist Democrats like Tribal Chairwoman Charlene Nijmeh, who ran against Zoe Lofgren in the March Primary, and Erin Friday have both endorsed me for Congress.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | I need to put up more billboards with this message which resonates with parents regardless of party affiliation. Can you please donate and help me get the message out. We must stand up for children and parental rights, and my opponent will never support that! Thank you for your support.

Friend, my husband Sam Brown is closer than ever to winning the biggest Toss-Up Senate race in America and flipping the Senate majority for Republicans. We need his leadership and vote in Washington. I know he will always put Duty First and fight for families like ours each and every day. But this campaign has not been easy.Campaign expenses are piling up and we have to dig deeper to go all the way. This isn’t easy, but I’m asking this from the heart... You could be the final donor we need to break through and win this race! You can help Sam serve our country once again and lead our country out of hard times just like he overcame his injuries. ---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=8df0d829121f40b3982e4f72ccb90cc9&_e=XKSldGqvYnSpDCDzU-lHJkmyyUx3d3mgj7zT0bxlSx3pWGhi1Fuoix7bjzdCfqmVkQL9aMH3Dsx2_jdAH9MslcmBZkNVr1IBC_9iElVlAo1o9kObaf9enQdPGEEBN8FdnT8uPwlqwCqtDJH55BOeyi2L3lBY6MKrmGgdxu3gqtrrBQi-P5LcLpXoQOdcgZlngmBKO8VEzuHR_CMoXmrztQi9Z8KqvSmMmDjOvpKsaMhjrQQiZO-l-sFs4WofKTQk4E-nqTiDJNvmhRbOZuy-i-NhTlI6zPTlahkWFaQ6B9wAuSZr_mnvzo7Rgsgu9EUsytORoff053zWUbnJm_Wb5BXj_yTatWAf2mI-lQWAB3yUAfRnsSGpAcWFTymZXlO5)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. These 104 Democracy Defenders are **_critical_** to safeguarding and strengthening democracy:
**In Georgia** , we’re building power for the next decade to combat the extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. These new endorsements add to the twenty-seven state legislature candidates that we had previously endorsed through the Democracy Defenders program.
**In Michigan** , as you already know, we’re already working to elect two phenomenal Supreme Court justices. And now, with this new round of endorsements, we add focus to the state legislature, too, where we’ll help hold the Democratic majority in the House.
If Democrats can keep the House, they’ll also keep their Democratic trifecta, which will protect the state’s redistricting reform and allow for more landmark policies to protect the freedoms of Michiganders state-wide.
**In Minnesota** , we’re also working to protect the Democratic trifecta. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November.
**In New Hampshire** , we’re working to help win majorities across the legislature. Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. _The House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach.
Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment._Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest._
**And in Wisconsin** , where fair legislative maps are _finally_ a reality, we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly — our best shot in a generation.
For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature, and their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. Wisconsin deserves better — and our Democracy Defenders can deliver.

clean_body: These Democracy Defenders will protect democracy and the freedoms that come with it. | Peter, With under 50 days to go until the November election, we’re thrilled to announce our third round of 2024 Democracy Defenders. Today, we’re endorsing 104 candidates running for state-level office across five of our priority states. With this Democracy Defenders program, we do the work to determine which seats could have an outsized impact against Republican anti-democracy agendas across the country — so that you can make sure your dollars have the most impact this election season. | = These 104 Democracy Defenders — from races in Georgia, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin — are dedicated to protecting the fundamental rights of the American people. But with time running out on their campaigns, they need our support today. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = These 104 Democracy Defenders are critical to safeguarding and strengthening democracy: In Georgia , we’re building power for the next decade to combat the extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. These new endorsements add to the twenty-seven state legislature candidates that we had previously endorsed through the Democracy Defenders program. In Michigan , as you already know, we’re already working to elect two phenomenal Supreme Court justices. And now, with this new round of endorsements, we add focus to the state legislature, too, where we’ll help hold the Democratic majority in the House. If Democrats can keep the House, they’ll also keep their Democratic trifecta, which will protect the state’s redistricting reform and allow for more landmark policies to protect the freedoms of Michiganders state-wide. In Minnesota , we’re also working to protect the Democratic trifecta. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. In New Hampshire , we’re working to help win majorities across the legislature. Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. The House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment.Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And in Wisconsin , where fair legislative maps are finally a reality, we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly — our best shot in a generation. For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature, and their reign has been nothing short of disastrous for democracy in the state. subject: I can’t believe this is real. I can’t.

body:
You’d think I’d be used to it by now. But just when you think the News Media can’t sink any lower... they surprise me.

| |

---
| | | I’ve spent more years in Washington than I care to admit.

You’d think I’d be used to it by now. But just when I think the News Media can’t sink any lower... they surprise me.

September 15th was a horrible day for our country. I thanked God Almighty for protecting President Trump a second time. I prayed hard for Trump’s Family and for our country that day. And every day since.

The Media, on the other hand, took a different tone.
_Politico made sure to report “Republicans outraged” over it.

The Washington Post described it as a “golf course episode.”_
_MSNBC even had the gall to suggest Trump was to blame for not “toning down the rhetoric.”_
I’m fuming. Our News Media has fallen so far from grace. It has NEVER been more clear their sole motive is to drag Conservatives through the mud and help Democrats win elections.

**_[That’s why it’s incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them.](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6155663.904.1.d0b08eb9cab9bbc0c91d9d4613f43ace "That’s why it’s incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them. ")_**

That’s also why I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise to raise one million dollars in the next 96 hours. **By my assessment, that’s what it’ll take to help keep our ads on the airwaves, cut through the Media’s appalling coverage, and elect Conservatives up and down the ballot.**
| | [PLEASE: CONTRIBUTE $35 >>](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6155663.905.1.62fcf566b703e26d82133bf9f5f8a0b8 "PLEASE: CONTRIBUTE $35 >>")

---

Look – I’ve made a lot of hay taking on the News Media over several decades (I even went viral for calling out a hostile CNN moderator on stage). But the Media is more partisan and shameless than it’s ever been before.

_They despise President Trump, Republicans, and every last American who thinks like us._

**If we rely on the News Media to tell the truth – and leave their own beliefs at the door – we might as well concede this election to the Democrats now.**

That’s why we DESPERATELY need to get our own message in front of voters. We need to tell our own story of how we’ll save this country. **_[So I have to ask: will you please send in a few bucks to help fund these critical efforts?](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=6155663.909.1.6e13b5a62b0fa4cec7505a1d37105dc9 "So I have to ask: will you please send in a few bucks to help fund these critical efforts? Thanks for all you do. I mean that.

Onward,
Newt Gingrich

body:
Tim and Gwen Walz is what’s wrong with the Black Community |
---

Fellow American,

This is very personal to me. It’s a longer email, but I’m hoping you’ll take a couple of minutes to hear me out.

I often get labeled as misogynistic. But, Tim and Gwen Walz, who is an English teacher, are everything that’s wrong with this country and a plague on the Black Community.

[**Let me explain, but first, will you chip in a small donation to my campaign so I can fire Amy Klobuchar and Flip the Senate?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc43f61eb38b411d8614f290e6210170&_e=3rULq1n4QYEXTNXvfXzOBQHlzsn7QE-WquUHj6rj2Ps5HR2GkQmV7_CFMyWhufzwzuZvFS4hglNo2aey2c0JnvBacUzzYGuNCm6p-Ub0SzbOktt9jjhB0q-VEFqJb1hLB5Mda-AP1PAvs1Z6bAuk2Uf1ukrUFqQYmGOauiipPfuyVIM5G7U9P78aGyJboHXbloaS6vC-pR0CjFkWvfjEbjT_jSdJNwgWs5WB02bmjbsMH4LtiaE6Z961Mbi5hVskJZOhmjRb0d3ldSLGcL4Dz7WzmE4ICy-pVRr7UcBglI1tStnOCDasaguWuK_T1YHzxAOkTd_d9AEFTP91B0igUg%3D%3D)

What does it say that Democrats expect Black men or Black people to vote for a Liberal Candidate, because not doing so will presumably lead to our systematic and cultural demise?

If people regard education as a fundamental necessity and predictor of life quality, then I have to ask these Liberal White Women, like Gwen Walz:

**_Where do you get your b****?_**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc43f61eb38b411d8614f290e6210170&_e=3rULq1n4QYEXTNXvfXzOBQHlzsn7QE-WquUHj6rj2Ps5HR2GkQmV7_CFMyWhufzwzuZvFS4hglNo2aey2c0JnvBacUzzYGuNCm6p-Ub0SzbOktt9jjhB0q-VEFqJb1hLB5Mda-AP1PAvs1Z6bAuk2Uf1ukrUFqQYmGOauiipPfuyVIM5G7U9P78aGyJboHXbYWE4-JLdkPEd48MRSzG7__8Oxh5g102ICSLyECWRHmfL-PBDwpWFJM_mSgOGU8TY3XX_6OO-V2rsFBYBeb0jw94g8bODENkm9UMUuSJkbIjyVAWT2RFmYkFZoAX9W_NdP3jEnChM3VE9ztxMQa-dRg%3D%3D)
Our nation’s educators in elementary schools are predominantly liberal white women who have been responsible for the miseducation of Black children in this country. Now, we have a nationwide crisis of Black children not being able to read or do math at their grade level.

The Industrial Media Complex and the Radical Left will have you believe that the reason for this is not enough Democrats are getting elected.

But, why is this crisis most prominent in cities where Democrats control the budgets, schools, and policies?

I’m not saying it’s ALL their fault, but it is a lot of their fault. Interestingly... Whenever men are in charge and overrepresented in a particular field, they get the blame for all negative outcomes. Like policing, for example, but when it’s women, the fault is with everyone else. Have I aptly exemplified the narcissism of the Liberal women’s movement?

**Is it sexist, misogynist, or chauvinist to say liberal White women are the greatest threat to a young Black mind in America?**

I know my opinions may come off as controversial, but that’s only because the Media has been trying to condition and brainwash us into believing whatever propaganda the Radical Left wants us to see.

**_I am a free-thinking Black Republican._**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc43f61eb38b411d8614f290e6210170&_e=3rULq1n4QYEXTNXvfXzOBQHlzsn7QE-WquUHj6rj2Ps5HR2GkQmV7_CFMyWhufzwzuZvFS4hglNo2aey2c0JnvBacUzzYGuNCm6p-Ub0SzbOktt9jjhB0q-VEFqJb1hLB5Mda-AP1PAvs1Z6bAuk2Uf1ukrUFqQYmGOauiipPfuyVIM5G7U9P78aGyJboHXbPq9GfCvKfPebR1OHnWWJMexPGUuOucxEeZwI89YJFfBd9AOd7g2lMUZIayd_kefIq6HBFkaSvmJ0OD6WCR6b0niDR8FXyl5sy42GEZRNl4AOIgxYYly1Pr70kYx3WYm6uofEKlypxmkawTFSAialvQ%3D%3D)
They tell me the White man is my greatest enemy. Then, they tell me if I don’t vote for them, I’ll lose all of my rights as an American.

**Now that I’ve broken away from their Orwellian brainwashing tactics, they attack me and my campaign.**

I represent a movement that could destroy the entire Democratic Party: Free-thinking Americans who are ready for REAL change, not just accepting their platitudes and threats.

**Now that I’m running for Senate against one of their shining stars, Amy Klobuchar, I’ve been fighting off attack after attack from the Industrial Media Complex and the Radical Left.**

_That’s why I’m emailing you today._

[**I need you to contribute just $10 or more to help me buy TV ads and knock on doors so I can get my unfiltered, uncensored message directly to undecided voters in Minnesota.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=cc43f61eb38b411d8614f290e6210170&_e=3rULq1n4QYEXTNXvfXzOBQHlzsn7QE-WquUHj6rj2Ps5HR2GkQmV7_CFMyWhufzwzuZvFS4hglNo2aey2c0JnvBacUzzYGuNCm6p-Ub0SzbOktt9jjhB0q-VEFqJb1hLB5Mda-AP1PAvs1Z6bAuk2abZNMC8SBHENpwQ9txPsjhLFcgJpXB70Nfd17rkJzy4ZUQIlad7axAgRbXyWXMDE-J4zIBPRuqmXp6XqRh1xC_bAbi7TNFHxYVuVqOKKozORl4k1VYUA25e9GoM2KVvlZkKyVGnWqTG4bKnR2EJYuO8N9qkDp2L7aUS7ivWr7mXpBtm92UZziftEq2MWjiJOw%3D%3D)

I can absolutely win this race, but only with your help.

Talk soon,

subject: I choose "the people" over the PACs
body:
... because no one can serve two masters. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/794f61f07fca/i-choose-the-people-over-the-pacs?e=5d7e9a146c)

## Because no one can serve two masters,
## I choose “the people”

Earlier this week, I had [a little fun at my opponent’s expense](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=69d961d2f9&e=5d7e9a146c), but his being beholden to deep-pocketed PACs and business donors is no laughing matter.
As I was watching the conclusion of the race in Darlington a few Sundays ago, I couldn’t help but marvel at the number of sponsor patches on the drivers’ jumpsuits and thought “it must be pretty comforting to know you have support from businesses invested in you winning.”
The truth is, if running for Congress were like a stock car race, Russell Fry’s “jumpsuit” would be loaded with business and PAC logos. I’m just one candidate and he’s the only moneyed incumbent I aim to unseat, but when I do get to Congress, I’m coming for more bought-off members of the House and Senate.
Jesus warned his followers that “no one can serve two masters,” insisting they’d grow to love one and hate the other. I believe the statement applies here, as well. Time and time again we’ve watched as politicians put the interests of big business and special interests before “the people.”
Heeding that warning, I choose “the people.”
**Because I** _**have**_**no corporate sponsors, I must ask for your help.**[**Can you make a contribution of any size to help my campaign?**](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=910f085703&e=5d7e9a146c)**If elected, I will join the fight that has already begun to ensure that “the people” have the loudest voice.**
Rep. Ro Khanna introduced a political reform package to “unrig Washington” and strengthen our democracy, and I’d be chief among its backers in the House. Here’s what it sets out to do:
* Ban campaign contributions from PACs and lobbyists of any kind
* Ban stock trading by members of Congress and lobbying by retired members
* Set 12-year term limits for members of Congress
* Set 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices, and
* Implement a judicial code of ethics for federal judges and Supreme Court justices

As Rep. Khanna said to his constituents, “Restoring confidence in our democratic institutions requires us to show that we’re putting the American people first, not corporations, or special interests.”
He started the “No PAC Caucus,” and you can best believe I’ll fit right in there.
I choose “the people.”

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b26d92fd57bb435b98cedeaa26d34e71&_e=zxcpEqe-penDzOH2ywW7sbaNvFGt9gYe78pE5BgjdP1n1h8JbyJ87bhA8yqIjAEvOoSuR_I-nOhkQhtR-fremwqUIdlO9lZWturf9TLS0BHrGxKz7Db_nHWWbMK-jLifMpmgCcav-67xR2mHW2nB22Xk7r2yYITlQcmbNK57Y-09YxWSjROul4QzKvh2FSd-5Qn938sbWUQvrr-QX7v57PEv9gt0PonRme_l9wbd4rLJHeS6mjDiOi4C9XUqh5QI_URQNKKMrfuSb8Xh_VAzkVb2oGEu-9uR-HaEQ1xdZjurBy2cXWqQc5PWwZrWD3incVHkIupNvChtJTkR0LP1fZRl5aG15MVaZV2rkPizU1g0eRHt7HOP8DPR0hctIBMRwB-_s_cCw6iLpFucWbKPGjUlzG0CcSffkWQTofr3ejw%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b26d92fd57bb435b98cedeaa26d34e71&_e=zxcpEqe-penDzOH2ywW7sbaNvFGt9gYe78pE5BgjdP1n1h8JbyJ87bhA8yqIjAEvOoSuR_I-nOhkQhtR-fremwqUIdlO9lZWturf9TLS0BHrGxKz7Db_nHWWbMK-jLifMpmgCcav-67xR2mHW2nB22Xk7r2yYITlQcmbNK57Y-09YxWSjROul4QzKvh2FSd-5Qn938sbWUQvrr-QX7v57PEv9gt0PonRme_l9wbd4rLJHeS6mjDiOi4C9XUqh5QIi3FkdGpJr9b5l5ehxX2FeBxmOq42ZGZCL7n8-xd8NFSrpuRY9TV07iSJTyhm87TqJb-kb9KdwL-1Iii7cKBwc_CGZ9vM8G4E50SmdJrmDH7aUITzQhdPLXMjOB367P-JI63M2dmghRzQKHrDB8z9HA0CX-pR0hN-SezTrliPI18%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b26d92fd57bb435b98cedeaa26d34e71&_e=zxcpEqe-penDzOH2ywW7sbaNvFGt9gYe78pE5BgjdP1n1h8JbyJ87bhA8yqIjAEvOoSuR_I-nOhkQhtR-fremwqUIdlO9lZWturf9TLS0BHrGxKz7Db_nHWWbMK-jLifMpmgCcav-67xR2mHW2nB22Xk7r2yYITlQcmbNK57Y-09YxWSjROul4QzKvh2FSd-5Qn938sbWUQvrr-QX7v57PEv9gt0PonRme_l9wbd4rLJHeS6mjDiOi4C9XUqh5QI81jpx1i6iShA1xnV-odDDKSj40nnZ4xF-9SKCzit50DG7WJ2-camNw7KcfZAmc_lZZ62vTrExxNdiHrC_WCDP-pC9lAVwybCC5wDxSMzfsS7nMe3dMpX1TFcYIbQlet2oHY5K-igGmFvve0q-neHel8r0nS_9Vlf4bSnV61q3sU%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. One of the best ways you can show your support is by requesting a yard sign to display proudly. The state will provide replacement funds from existing sources, meaning no loss of services.

**Local governments will keep full control of their budgets, and citizens will no longer be weighed down by property tax bills that grow higher each year. **

_**Tim Walz Made Minnesota A ‘Sanctuary’ For Baby Killers And Child Mutilators**_ By Bobby Jindal and Heidi Overton _Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are willing to endanger women, children, and parents to advance their radical policies._
---
Kamala Harris chose a running mate who is as extreme on children’s health care as she is.

Democrat vice presidential candidate and Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz describes his state of Minnesota as a sanctuary. But a sanctuary for whom, exactly? Not for the children deceived into permanently mutilating their bodies. Not for the parents stripped of custody of their children. And not for the babies born alive after abortion.

Minnesota is not a sanctuary — it’s a health risk to children and a graveyard for parental rights.

Governor Tim Walz was one of 14 governors who signed legislation to make their states “sanctuary states” for children who believe they are transgender. Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091924_1&amount=25]
AP: Mississippi has a history of voter suppression. Many see signs of change as Black voters reengage [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=091924_1&amount=25]
There were a lot of reasons to be excited about last year's election results, Team, but what happened in Mississippi should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide.
Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% .
Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007.
On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots .
Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings.
Mississippi's playbook is clear: Disenfranchise, limit ballot access, obscure legal pathways for justice, rely on Jim Crow laws still on the books, and codify control for decades. Their endgame is power and control , not fairness or freedom.

body:
https://ruby4or.com/ [https://ruby4or.com/]
Hi, folks.
Joe Yetter here, asking you to support Dan Ruby for Congress. Dan needs you right now. And Oregon needs Dan.
I ran for Congress in 2022, for the same seat that Dan Ruby is seeking right now: Oregon's Second Congressional District.
A lot of you receiving this email supported me, and I am forever grateful to you for your support. I met many of you at rallies, in libraries and schools, in public parks, and at county fairs. Some of you opened your homes to me, put me up for the night (or nights), shared some pizza with me, or even put up with my karaoke. To this last group, my apologies; to everyone, my undying gratitude.
Dan Ruby is in a tough fight. Our incumbent, Cliff Bentz is well-funded by special interests. He raised over a million dollars against me, and I have no doubt that he will reap a bunch of dollars this time around too. He consistently votes against the interests of the majority of his constituents.
Cliff Bentz voted to disenfranchise millions of voters. He voted against the PACT Act that provides medical care to veterans harmed by burn pits, Agent Orange, radiation, and other injuries. And Cliff Bentz stands against a woman's right to control over her own body.
I lost. Let's make the outcome different this time. Dan supports common-sense solutions for housing, education, health care, and the freedoms we all value. He'll go to work every day to serve the people of Oregon and all Americans, and not the special interests that seek ever more money and ever more power over the rest of us. He's going to fight for women's rights in Congress, He's the right person to lead us.
I'm supporting Dan in every way I can. I've made phone calls, written op-eds, and donated money to his hard, hard campaign.
I hope you will, too. Dan's being out-raised, and he needs our help. Please donate here to help Dan win in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=joe]
Joe Yetter

name: Ro Khanna
subject: TAKE ACTION: Bring steel manufacturing back to the U.S.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The United States once led the world in manufacturing, an industry that employed one in five Americans in the mid-20th century. In states like Pennsylvania and Michigan, nearly half of all nonfarm workers once created steel and other manufactured goods that shaped our world.

But 40 years of failed economic policy gutted the manufacturing industry, sent good jobs overseas, and hollowed out communities across the country. Manufacturing now employs less than 8 percent of workers.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/103205/images/RK_2024-09_PennManu.jpg] [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=UZkQC2IjKLMfTT13soxJClH81DdKwkulG5x2ugGxaHU2h7C8CR6xJ0kUtv3Y0PUFUQEa1OiVrOcuF8OCc0JBChXvoMrJvx8gfcKs14bphBIpUO510NK5tH4NMAMm+nJ25S5g3dSsFg5phhEWO2UJGg==] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/103205/images/RK_2024-09_MichManu.jpg] [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=UZkQC2IjKLMfTT13soxJClH81DdKwkulG5x2ugGxaHU2h7C8CR6xJ0kUtv3Y0PUFUQEa1OiVrOcuF8OCc0JBChXvoMrJvx8gfcKs14bphBIpUO510NK5tH4NMAMm+nJ25S5g3dSsFg5phhEWO2UJGg==]

We may not be able to double manufacturing jobs nationwide. But smart, place-based industrial policy can restore it in places like PA and MI. We have the workforce and know-how to be a manufacturing superpower again by bringing the steel and aluminum industry back. And we can do it better and cleaner than China.

That’s why I’ve introduced the Steel Modernization Act, which would unite the federal government with steel companies and unions to bring cleaner, better steel manufacturing back to U.S. soil. This bill would:

✅ Establish 3-5 modern steel factories in communities with history and expertise in steel production;
✅ Concentrate on modern, clean steel production, using recycled materials and cleaner energy sources;
✅ Require any new construction and upgrades to use steel manufactured in the U.S.; and
✅ Create thousands of good-paying union jobs.

Tell Congress: Invest in reestablishing the United States as a global leader in steel manufacturing. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=UZkQC2IjKLMfTT13soxJClH81DdKwkulG5x2ugGxaHU2h7C8CR6xJ0kUtv3Y0PUFUQEa1OiVrOcuF8OCc0JBChXvoMrJvx8gfcKs14bphBIpUO510NK5tH4NMAMm+nJ25S5g3dSsFg5phhEWO2UJGg==]

ADD YOUR NAME [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=UZkQC2IjKLMfTT13soxJClH81DdKwkulG5x2ugGxaHU2h7C8CR6xJ0kUtv3Y0PUFUQEa1OiVrOcuF8OCc0JBChXvoMrJvx8gfcKs14bphBIpUO510NK5tH4NMAMm+nJ25S5g3dSsFg5phhEWO2UJGg==]

The future of steel is here in America, and I won’t rest until the Steel Modernization Act is signed into law.

Onward,
Ro

Channel 7 contacted me a couple of days ago to get my thoughts on the Boise City Council's gun grabber resolution (my words).

So, I sent them this exact quote:

As news outlets often do, they took a few lines from my quote, and [this is the small video clip that made the news](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=7a47d1eaf5&e=dea908e0fe "see it"):

Take a look at some of the messages I've got...

All of this (and more) because I stood up for the 2nd Amendment...

_There's no love, inclusion, or tolerance in those messages._

Instead, it's hate, violence, and vitriol—hallmarks of the extreme left. This is precisely why defending the 1st and 2nd Amendments is not just important, but essential. We need people in office who won't bow to the whims of socialism, progressivism, communism, or any other left-leaning "ism." America and Idaho are under heavy attack because the fringe left despises freedom.

Which is why we need elected officials who are committed to preserving the values that made America great. It's crucial to vote for conservatives who are dedicated to actually...**_conserving things_** (e.g. fundamental freedoms like speech, gun rights, religious liberty, and traditional family values come to mind).

We cannot afford to let Idaho become a dystopian nightmare like some of our neighboring states. And we certainly can't hand our country over to global elites like the Blackrock World Economic Forum cabal, who are hell-bent on forcing ESG, CSG, and woke culture down our throats.

Let's work together to keep our community strong and free.

Have a great rest of the week.

Cheers,

Brian

**P.S.**

Have you heard about how bad Prop. 1 is?

It's a socialist's ideal scenario for Idaho that's currently illegal.

If it passes, instead of having the person with the most votes win, we'll have computer algorithms and Dominion voting machines deciding for us. Not to mention a price tag north of $40 million. Say goodbye to paper ballots and free and fair elections if Prop 1 passes.

_It really is that bad!_

Make sure you spread the word—Prop 1 is BAD for Idaho!
