subject: Did You Miss This Breaking News?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Dems Are Suing AGAIN!

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/nh)
---
Peter,
Last week we told you that we were taking the Nevada lawsuit to the U.S. Supreme Court. We have some great news on that front, but first an update that you may have not seen about lawfare in another state. The anti-Democratic Party is attempting to sue Jill and Butch off another ballot. **_This time New Hampshire._** We are sure we can prevail, our lawyers say it’s an easy win, but we will need to raise $20,000 for the battle. In this most recent shenanigans from the anti-Democratic Party in New Hampshire, they assert that the petitioners incorrectly filled in the forms, but New Hampshire law clearly says that you can include your town OR your ward on the petition. Unsurprisingly, the majority of signers gave their town as most voters are unfamiliar with their ward. So what are they trying to use to subvert democracy this time? The failure of petition signers to note their ward! Signers were given a choice and the "democrats" are still trying to deny voter choice by dragging us into yet another frivolous lawsuit that doesn’t hold water but drains Stein/Ware’s time and resources.

There are over one million registered voters in New Hampshire and they deserve to be able to vote for an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency administration this November. [**_So, Peter, can you pitch in today to help us defeat these nefarious undemocratic tactics once more and ensure that people in New Hampshire have Jill and Butch on their ballots?_**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nh?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_nh_email_9_19&n=1)

---
And now the good news on the Nevada SCOTUS lawsuit. In case you missed it, the Nevada Secretary of State, a Democrat, gave the campaign the wrong forms to use to get on the ballot. Then the “democrats” used that technicality to sue us off the ballot - we won in lower courts, only to lose in the Nevada Supreme Court. **_Our lawyers filed a case to take the fight to the highest court in the land: US Supreme Court and the Dems and Nevada SOS have filed a response, which our lawyers inform us is very weak. We are optimistic that we will win this case as well._** Jill is challenging empire on all fronts, from being assaulted by police while standing in solidarity with students, media appearances with hostile hosts, to ballot access battles - and she and Butch will continue to fight for people, planet and peace. But we need your continued support. Donate now to keep their names on the ballot in New Hampshire:

#
Dear Friend,

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Despite the Supreme Court ruling in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Planned Parenthood continues to receive taxpayer funding, effectively subsidizing the intentional killing of preborn children. Since 2000, nearly $10.7 billion of taxpayers' money has funded their life-ending work.

Contrast this with the nearly 3,000 Pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide dedicated to supporting expectant mothers. Planned Parenthood only operates about 600 facilities and primarily offers one service: abortion. Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. Sign our petition before midnight to demand an end to this grave misuse of your taxes. **[https://www.liveaction.org/defund-planned-parenthood-petition/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=d4a3feba9baa45c199d6be3de7330642&_e=B8r1qxxBdWzO2044TkFJwIQY2NYqNu-yxkfzX51giRdg77Amy_Wh-XokJuC4j-jWg8_NnmjQdPuMVhaMrrAgmMqs_GymtFsdZJ3pRh8lrnAtVrno_tcVLI1pUHOJKKwZyXW71lHulbYsY5YjPSSQW7iAwiMcOBZogoZfHmMhZIdxHJiO1OJ1m_mLvr53w8o9kU_eYir2oJQH9yuel530tiW_VyDwa9Rn05e_4U8_Z3mTYDF8OqkbMesnFBvMIlysrsYCq0vlqmb3ghxF6HhytiRtTgOfKaKljZkzpYy08Q2PGtEiiVj2abWNaFZZugaRHtenxhVCWzjLTTRcVMg0CAXgf1VjEenbIHPrOMSoxbQLSZlLjay4IGz0gYb-i87jwrXcJmX7_sqetcwOH9Owmg%3D%3D)**

Thank you for standing with us for the protection of future generations!

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

In Loudoun, he joined local volunteers before they went out to knock doors. Senator Warner talked about the importance of voting early in this year’s election where so much is at stake — Trump has promised to try to repeal the Affordable Care Act, ban abortion nationwide, and plans to raise taxes by thousands of dollars for the middle class.

Then Mark was off to Manassas, where he joined the Latinos con Harris Coalition to share Vice President Harris’ plans to offer a new way forward for our country and stand up against Donald Trump’s incessant hate and division.

body:

_* Sent in support of Rosen for Nevada and Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate *_
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72305?refcode=em20240919-7730&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7730%2E614464%2E9hy2X4)
Hi Peter, it’s Jacky Rosen. The story below is a special one about my faith and how I first got involved in politics. **This one means a lot to me, so I hope you’ll take a moment to read it.** But if you don’t have the time to take a look right now, **[could you still split $10 or more between me and Lucas Kunce to help me keep Nevada and the Senate blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72305?refcode=em20240919-7730&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7730%2E614464%2E9hy2X4)**
---
Peter,
My career in public service began in 2016, when I was recruited to flip a competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting – **because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my work in Congress.**
In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – _to leave the world a better place than how we found it._
I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive change happen. **But I need _your_ help.**
**Right now, polls are showing me locked in a dead heat with my opponent – who just set a major GOP fundraising record in the race that will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly asking:**
**[If you're with me in the fight to continue making progress for the people and communities we love, will you split $10 or more between me and Lucas Kunce to help me defend my seat in Nevada and keep the Senate blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/72305?refcode=em20240919-7730&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7730%2E614464%2E9hy2X4)**

body:
| | | Peter, you probably don’t know me, but my name is Dan. I served over 30 years in the United States Navy, most of my time within the Special Operations Community, retiring as a Master Chief Petty Officer. I’ve served with many outstanding men and women but believe me when I tell you: **CAPT Hung Cao was exceptional**. Hung and I served in Homeland Security together on one of the U.S. Navy’s Regional Bomb Squads responsible for providing EOD coverage to Southern California. Additionally, we trained and augmented local, state and federal law enforcement agencies.

But Hung ALWAYS kept his cool and never wavered from doing whatever it took to keep America safe. There was never a challenge too big or an operation too risky for Hung. He was ready to do ANYTHING for the country he loves - and I know he’ll bring the same attitude as a U.S. Senator. [**I** ’**m proud to support Hung Cao for U.S. Senate because I** ’**ve seen his dedication to our great country firsthand. subject: The film Hollywood doesn’t want you to see
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Fellow American,

This is the movie that Hollywood doesn't want
America's young people to see…

…and that's why I hope YOU will help Turning
Point USA and me bring it directly to 1,000+ young people at
schools across America!

Fellow American, the powerful new film Reagan has just been
released - and Turning Point USA is launching an ambitious plan
to make sure 1,000+ students see this film on their college
campuses or at their high schools.

Will you make a gift of $30 to help sponsor TWO
MORE students to see Reagan … $75 to help FIVE MORE
students see Reagan … or even $150 to help TEN MORE
students see Reagan?

Yes, I'll send a student to see Reagan!

Fellow American, the "Woke" Left still HATES President
Ronald Reagan and his timeless message of FREEDOM and AMERICAN
GREATNESS.

That's why Leftists have spent years focused on
LIES and INDOCTRINATION to convince young people to hate strong
conservative leaders who love our country - just like President
Ronald Reagan!

Above: President RONALD REAGAN's timeless message
of AMERICAN GREATNESS inspires Turning Point USA's 750,000+
student activists in ALL 50 states!

When you help Turning Point USA sponsor 1,000+
patriotic young people to watch Reagan at their schools, you
will:

Help inspire a new wave of PATRIOTISM and belief in
AMERICAN GREATNESS as young people see the inspiring journey of a
true American hero,

Provide the POWERFUL PROOF of the success of the
American Dream through President Ronald Reagan's life - and the
impact of TRUE CONSERVATIVE principles on America's future, and

Equip an ENTIRE GENERATION to stand strong and
fight back against the anti-America lies and indoctrination of
the "Woke" Left!

Will you help TWO MORE students to see Reagan with
a gift of $30 … help FIVE MORE students see Reagan with a
gift of $75 … or even help TEN MORE students see Reagan
with a gift of $150?

Yes, I'll send a student to see Reagan!

As then-Governor Ronald Reagan said, with my
emphasis added:

"Freedom is a fragile thing and it's never more
than one generation away from extinction. It is not ours by way
of inheritance; it must be fought for and defended constantly by
each generation, for it comes only once to a people. And those in
world history who have known freedom and then lost it have never
known it again."

Fellow American, please help me and Turning Point USA pass
the blessing of FREEDOM and AMERICAN GREATNESS to the next
generation.

Let's send 1,000+ kids to see Reagan and understand
a TRUE CONSERVATIVE HERO - and what makes America TRULY GREAT!

Thank you for your incredible support. With your
help, we can ensure that it's always morning again in America.

For America,

Charlie Kirk

Founder & CEO

Turning Point USA

4940 East Beverly Road

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Listen. You’re receiving this message for a reason.

There is a solution, the water crisis is solvable and HAS been solvable. You've just been fed this lie...

Listen. You’re receiving this message for a reason.
It's Nick Jordan and this email is going to be a little different. I'm upset.
I'm upset because we've been lied to.
_You’ve_ been lied to.
You’ve been made to feel like the water crisis isn’t solvable. That it’s an issue far out of our control, but most importantly it doesn’t impact you...
What if I told you **it _is_ solvable**, and it begins with you? With us.
The truth is, the water crisis is solvable. We have _the opportunity, resources, and knowledge_ to solve this crisis.
But it starts with an understanding...
An understanding that we move away from the narrative that there is a water shortage —an unsolvable problem—**[to realizing that there is only a shortage of systems to make water usable, something that Wells of Life has committed to solving.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2p98aj6uh15vr4aehfdobmluh7hu241lcfr1sp8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjmeo72cth2bs)**

* Earth is 70% percent water. There's more than enough water.
* Solutions are available, some just need implementation.
* Most importantly, this isn't a problem that only impacts developing countries, it's a global issue.

---

Because most people feel like they can't make an impact.
We've been fed the narrative that this is an 'unsolvable issue' when in reality it's a matter of taking action.
**The systems are there, they're just waiting to be implemented. They just need the support and resources to make it happen.**
By choosing to support Wells of Life, you choose make the solution possible rather than becoming part of a narrative that perpetuates the notion that the crisis is unsolvable.
Are you ready to be part of the change, or will you settle for a narrative made to keep us unaccountable?
[Will you give generously today to our _**Project to Drill new water wells, Restore broken ones, and Save young lives**_ from preventable waterborne diseases with clean water?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zatu0kqu05osnu33q9l06mee2e4l5v96nv3pgnl0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjmeo72cth2bs)
Best regards,

Nick Jordan
Founder, Wells of Life

P.S. Every 21 seconds, a child dies from a water-related illness. But together, we can change that. Wells of Life is committed to bringing clean water to rural Uganda, and we need your help to do so! Major Trump donor, former RNC finance chair, and current Postmaster General Louis DeJoy is running the Postal Service into the ground — and it could disenfranchise American voters in this election.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/engagement-20240919-dejoy-petition?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240919_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=7588%2E5257348%2ECYWDFq)

DeJoy has a multimillion-dollar investment in a major Postal Service contractor and was Donald Trump’s handpicked choice to fill the post.
As finance chair of the Republican National Committee, he raised and contributed millions to Republican candidates across the country.
He was the subject of an FBI investigation for an alleged straw donor scheme that pressured his company’s employees to donate to Republican candidates in exchange for salary bonus kickbacks.
He banned overtime, cut staff, consolidated power, and decommissioned mail-sorting machines right before the 2020 election.
He has raised prices and reduced service. He even attempted to purchase 90% gasoline-powered vehicles for the Post Office’s new fleet until Congress passed legislation mandating the USPS purchase electric vehicles.
**[A Trump crony who almost derailed the 2020 election cannot be trusted with running the Postal Service again this time around. I am calling for Louis DeJoy’s immediate resignation. body:
|
#
Folks, It’s no secret that our country is facing a serious housing crisis — the impacts are far-reaching, from our largest cities to our smallest towns. That’s why I’m joining Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to create a plan to make renting and owning a home a reality for millions of Americans. When we talk about the “housing crisis,” it’s easy to get lost in jargon and policy specifics, but the reality is as simple as this: this crisis impacts real Americans every day. _**Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Tina Smith: Our Solution to the Housing Crisis**_
**[Link here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93147588/499516520/1149165046?refcode=AU_TSM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240919_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZmRmYmRhYS1hNTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WsGTvDiBI877_gsvWrmQkViIMsArjMr6u-HwkX1JcQY=&emci=47dfbdaa-a576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=4fdfbdaa-a576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=6227932)**
Stop almost anyone on the street today and you’ll hear we’re in a housing crisis. In most American counties, minimum-wage workers can’t afford to rent even a modest one-bedroom apartment. Working families are bidding against the world’s biggest financial firms for homes. On top of it all, people living in public housing complexes across the country are increasingly exposed to inhumane conditions after years of federal neglect and underinvestment.
It’s becoming nearly impossible for working-class people to buy and keep a roof over their heads. Congress must respond with a plan that matches the scale of this crisis.
For generations, the federal government’s approach to housing policy has been primarily focused on encouraging single-family homeownership and private investment in rental housing. The mortgage-interest deduction provides roughly $30 billion in tax write-offs to homeowners annually. In addition to their support of the mortgage market, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac provide up to $150 billion in financial backing to the multifamily rental market every year, but much of it goes to large, corporate landlords. These lucrative loans come with very few tenant protections or labor requirements. And the largest affordable housing incentive our government offers — the low-income housing tax credit — too often ends up in the hands of for-profit developers.
Outsourcing development to the private market leaves affordable housing subject to the boom-and-bust cycle of private investment. What’s more, the federal government relinquishes the oversight needed to protect tenants from abusive landlords and racial discrimination.
The result is a housing market where corporate landlords make record profits while half of America’s 44 million renters struggle to pay rent. For a generation of young people, the idea of home has become loaded with anxiety; too many know they can’t find an affordable, stable place to rent, let alone buy.
Why is this happening? For decades, thanks to restrictive zoning laws and increasing construction costs, we simply haven’t built enough new housing.
There is another way: social housing. Instead of treating real estate as a commodity, we can underwrite the construction of millions of homes and apartments that, by law, must remain affordable. Some would be rental units; others would offer Americans the opportunity to build equity. These models of rent caps and homeownership are already working around the world, such as in Vienna, and in some parts of the United States.
In Congress, the two of us represent very different parts of the country, but New Yorkers and Minnesotans have both benefited from social housing.
The Electchester complex in Queens and Co-op City in the Bronx today house over 50,000 New Yorkers. Co-op City stands as not only one of the largest housing cooperatives in the world — with its own schools and power plant — but also the largest, naturally occurring retirement community in the country, a testament to its financial and social sustainability.
In Minnesota, trusts, such as Saint Paul’s Rondo Community Land Trust, give people the chance at more affordable homeownership, because the homeowners don’t buy the land; instead, it’s held in trust and leased to homeowners on a long-term, renewable basis. The model has expanded across Minnesota, in rural and suburban communities alike.
Because we believe that housing is a human right, like food or health care, we believe that more Americans deserve the option of social housing. That’s why we’re introducing the _Homes Act_ , a plan to establish a new, federally backed development authority to finance and build homes in big cities and small towns across America. These homes would be built to last by union workers and then turned over to entities that agree to manage them for permanent affordability: public and tribal housing authorities, cooperatives, tenant unions, community land trusts, nonprofits and local governments.
Our housing development authority wouldn’t be focused on maximizing profit or returns to shareholders. Rent would be capped at 25 percent of a household’s adjusted annual gross income. Homes would be set aside for lower-income families in mixed-income buildings and communities. And every home would be built to modern, efficient standards, which would cut residents’ utility costs. Renters wouldn’t have to worry about the prospect of a big corporation buying up the building and evicting everyone. Some could even come together to purchase their buildings outright.
To fund social housing construction, our development authority would rely on a combination of congressional spending and Treasury-backed loans, making financing resilient to the volatility of our housing market and the political winds of the annual appropriations process.
Our bill would also invest in public housing and repeal the Faircloth Amendment, which prevents the construction of new public housing. Passed in 1998, with the support of both parties, the amendment helped entrench a cycle of stigmatization and disinvestment. Our legislation would reinvest federal money in local public housing authorities to fund the backlog of much-needed repairs.
We know that housing looks a lot different in Bemidji, Minn., than in the Bronx. It shouldn’t be a one-size-fits-all approach. That’s why our bill would task local governments, unions and established local nonprofits with developing homes that blend seamlessly into the landscape of the town and fit the needs of the people living in them.
Research from New York University, the University of California, Berkeley, and the Climate and Community Institute estimates that our bill could build and preserve more than 1.25 million homes, including more than 850,000 for the lowest-income households.
We can’t wait for the private market alone to solve the housing crisis. This is the federal government’s chance to invest in social housing and give millions of Americans a safe, comfortable and affordable place to call home — with the sense of security and dignity that come with it.

# Lifelong Democrat Endorses Dr Garcia in new Ad on the Fentanyl Crisis
---
|
## _Laura Lynch Lost Her Daughter to Fentanyl_
---
| Laura Lynch is a lifelong Democrat who comes from a family of Democrats.
But far more important than party politics is the tragedy that struck in 2021 when her beautiful 18-year-old daughter, Brillion, died from taking a pill that — unbeknownst to her — was laced with a fatal amount of fentanyl.
Laura now advocates for fentanyl education & awareness, and for laws that protect our communities from fentanyl dealers. She met Raul earlier this year, and they forged a bond over their shared passion for fighting and overcoming this killer drug.
**We are so honored and grateful that Laura agreed to share her story, and her support for Dr Garcia, in a new ad — which you can watch by clicking below. Please**[**share this video**](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=10f9bbbb8a&e=3ed3552a03)**with your friends — on social media, or by text & email!**
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=6efe58b840&e=3ed3552a03)
| Here is the transcript of the ad:
---
| “My name is Laura Lynch. I lost my daughter, Brillion, to fentanyl poisoning. She had taken half of a pill. They said she had enough fentanyl in her system to kill over three dozen people.
“I wrote to Maria Cantwell, and I got a canned response. That's why I'm supporting the first Republican candidate that anyone in my family has ever voted for, Raul Garcia. He sees it every day at the ER, and he's cried with me. He’s one of these rare people that really cares.”
_“_ -I'm Raul Garcia and I approve this message._”_

Earlier this year, IOF whisteblowers exposed the use of [Israel's Lavender program in creating AI- generated "kill lists,"](https://open.substack.com/pub/rebekahjones/p/ai-generated-kill-lists-are-here?utm_source=share&utm_medium=android&r=gc2sd) resulting in the deaths of thousands of innocent men, women and children.
While security experts pressed US officials on a deeply flawed target list generated without verification of targets as hostiles, the US, as it has repeatedly down when the victims are Arab or Muslim, ignored them.
Now, after Israel carried out two terrorist attacks against Lebanon, a US ally, killing dozens and injuring thousands, the United States is again faced with a reckoning over its continued support of the rogue nation's abuse of technology to commit war crimes, genocide and acts of terror.
### THE ATTACK
Like something from a dystopic movie, Israel implanted explosives in a range of electronic devices and detonated them in several areas of southern Lebanon.
Explosive experts investigating the attacks have estimated that 1-2 ounces of explosives were placed inside various electronics during the manufacturing process - devices then shipped all over the world (including the United States).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8263533e-caf0-4ea7-87ba-0fc2716a1078?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Israel then remotely and simultaneously detonated thousands of devices in two separate terrorist attacks in southern Lebanon on Tuesday and Wednesday, killing children, injuring thousands and crippling telecommunications in Lebanon.
American media's coverage of the attack has largely been colored by Israeli propaganda, parroting unsubstantiated claims that the attack was targeted against Hezbollah, another militant group that Israel has designated as an "enemy."
Israel has provided no evidence to support their contention that the attacks were targeted. According to media in Lebanon, only 10 members of Hezbollah were killed or critically injured, whereas more than 500 people have required surgery as a result of the attack. Several children were killed.
The tampered devices belonged to doctors, journalists, and citizens with no discernable connections to any militant group. One American journalist with ABC was [caught](https://substack.com/redirect/27027e7a-7f44-448e-bc5e-9cd2ced3b5a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the explosions, capturing graphic video during the aftermath which has been shared widely across social media.
ABC reported that, in a second attack, panic at a Lebanese airport temporarily halted flights as airport security use the same types of walkie-talkies that had been detonated in the area.
The detonated walkie-talkies were being used by police, firefighters, ambulances and other first responders.
### A GLOBAL ACT OF TERRORISM ON MULTIPLE FRONTS
International security experts have referred to Israel's actions as global attacks on supply chains in numerous foreign countries - including Taiwan and Hungary.
"The scale suggests a complex supply-chain attack, rather than a scenario in which devices were intercepted and modified in transit," said N.R. Jenzen-Jones, director of Armament Research Services, a technical intelligence consulting firm.
The CEO of the company whose products Israel turned into explosive devices has been devastated by Israel's attack.
Hsu Ching-kuang of Gold Apollo said he also felt he had been victimized and was considering filing a lawsuit.
"I am a businessman," he said. "How did I get involved in this attack?"
The Lebanese Foreign Ministry condemned what it called an "Israeli cyber attack," saying that it would lodge a complaint with the United Nations Security Council.
One of the fatalities was the son of a member of the Lebanon parliament, the equivalent of a member of US Congress. It's hard to imagine that our own country would refrain from retaliating against, say, Russia, if a child of a sitting congressman was killed in a major terrorist attack carried out by Russia on US soil.
While the United States has tried to distance itself from the attack, claiming no prior knowledge, the Washington Post and [others](https://substack.com/redirect/8d4f3375-250b-4a2c-b13b-21fc102f5b26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have reported that most of the devices produced at the facility where Israel implanted bombs were sent to the United States and Europe.
There has been no direction by US officials as to how Americans can be sure their devices have not been similarly equipped with explosives, or what actions the United States plans to take in response to the attack.
Israel also waged attacks on Syria on Tuesday, with Israel's aggression this year now including attacks in Palestine, Lebanon, Jordan, Iran and Syria. Israel's continued instigation of so many foreign nations is now being referred to as "acts of global terrorism."
Earlier this week, the United Nations passed a resolution demanding an end to Israeli occupation of all Palestinian land and an end to the terror it has inflicted upon Palestinians for more than half a century.
The United States joined 13 small island nations in voting against the measure, while allies including France joined the 124 countries who passed the resolution.

name: Sarah Kline
subject: Fwd: Save the Date for OLCV's Virtual Town Hall on the Environment with Senator Jeff Merkley
body:
Hi Peter,

Add it to your calendars! We now have a time set for OLCV's Virtual Town Hall on the Environment with Senator Jeff Merkley. [https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2]

WHEN: Tuesday, October 8th at 3:30pm PT
WHERE: Zoom webinar (link will be shared a few days before the town hall)

RSVP now and don't forget to add your question: https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2

Sincerely,
Sarah Kline
OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator

Dear Peter,
Climate chaos is hitting our planet hard, and the consequences can be seen everywhere. Places across the country reached record-breaking high temperatures–some even breaking multiple records just this summer alone–and Oregon was no exception. These extreme temperatures are threatening not just keystone species like native bees, but also our forests, farms, and fisheries, putting lives and livelihoods at risk.
We’re taking bold steps to address the devastating effects of climate impacts at the state level, but it won’t be enough unless the entire country is in this together. That’s why it’s so important to support new opportunities for clean energy, jobs, justice, and nature conservation that are currently moving at the national level. Learn more about the ongoing fight for climate action and environmental protections in D.C. at our upcoming virtual town hall with Senator Jeff Merkley.
Save the date for OLCV's Virtual Town Hall on the Environment with Senator Jeff Merkley! [https://secure.everyaction.com/9ZdEKKdehECfx0NYWScfHQ2?contactdata=f8V/rpU2lh0zH9QBpVgeYtYrODO7cOTbkNVRm69DHQYVIke4bZMOkKi3JH06FsZ8ro0SgeKlz7EKCIfGlyYv5sD4S3lxE0ihs5d2mtwgdYfDsJR7KffHq7pMbLF+SPwf&quick=true]
WHEN: Tuesday, October 8th, exact time TBD. Mark your calendars today!
WHERE: Zoom webinar (link will be shared a few days before the town hall)
Senator Merkley is a climate and environmental champion. He strongly supported and worked to pass the 2021 Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and Inflation Reduction Act, which made historic investments to help address the climate crisis and make progress on environmental justice. Last year, he introduced the Pollinator Power Act to help reverse the decline in pollinator populations.
On October 8, Senator Merkley will update us on what he is working on now, talk to us about how the climate investments of the IRA will benefit Oregon, and answer selected audience questions
Hope to see you there,
Lindsey Scholten
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Lindsey%20Scholte%20signature-page-001%20%281%29.jpg]

name: Nick Jordan
subject: You've been lied to
body:
Listen. You’re receiving this message for a reason.

There is a solution, the water crisis is solvable and HAS been solvable. You've just been fed this lie...

Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.Americans consistently rate Congress as one of the most unpopular branches of our government.

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmkl65lu5pq28faitctl3fr4ol5mh7g7ck19nd7g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjm9or4cjh2bs)
---
| |
Listen. You’re receiving this message for a reason.
It's Nick Jordan and this email is going to be a little different. I'm upset.
I'm upset because we've been lied to.
_You’ve_ been lied to.
You’ve been made to feel like the water crisis isn’t solvable. That it’s an issue far out of our control, but most importantly it doesn’t impact you...
What if I told you **it _is_ solvable**, and it begins with you? With us.
The truth is, the water crisis is solvable. We have _the opportunity, resources, and knowledge_ to solve this crisis.
But it starts with an understanding...
An understanding that we move away from the narrative that there is a water shortage —an unsolvable problem—**[to realizing that there is only a shortage of systems to make water usable, something that Wells of Life has committed to solving.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zf4qvh62i9q8h91mev0ifaec6g8c4sahm4ei4irg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjm9or4cjh2bs)**

---
| | **Elon Musk** emphasized this at the 10th World Water Forum held this year, where he shared several key facts:
* Earth is 70% percent water. There's more than enough water.
* Solutions are available, some just need implementation.
* Most importantly, this isn't a problem that only impacts developing countries, it's a global issue.

---
| [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ztdh2gu9p1bcgrme634phd9uasm8m45iiqf9q3so_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjm9or4cjh2bs)
---
| | You may be wondering, if the water crisis has been solvable- **why hasn't anything been done**?
Because most people feel like they can't make an impact.
We've been fed the narrative that this is an 'unsolvable issue' when in reality it's a matter of taking action.
**The systems are there, they're just waiting to be implemented. They just need the support and resources to make it happen.**
By choosing to support Wells of Life, you choose make the solution possible rather than becoming part of a narrative that perpetuates the notion that the crisis is unsolvable.
Are you ready to be part of the change, or will you settle for a narrative made to keep us unaccountable?
[Will you give generously today to our _**Project to Drill new water wells, Restore broken ones, and Save young lives**_ from preventable waterborne diseases with clean water?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrliq18sgjij0fh1ntdvm2s75t8p99jl2277utuo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjm9or4cjh2bs)
Best regards,

Nick Jordan
Founder, Wells of Life

P.S. Every 21 seconds, a child dies from a water-related illness. But together, we can change that. Wells of Life is committed to bringing clean water to rural Uganda, and we need your help to do so! Please consider making a life-saving, tax-deductible donation today through this secure link. **[LINK](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs11212crc1u2tgb5mrpitp0l6pp9eq98ls803m0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3ctjm9or4cjh2bs)**.
Thank you again for saving young people with clean water for life.

---

Your America
---

Bernie Moreno is exactly the kind of fresh, bold voice we desperately need in Washington right now.

**While his opponent, Sherrod Brown, is a career politician with a 50-year record of championing radical Democrat policies, Bernie brings a new perspective as a political outsider who is committed to advancing a conservative agenda.**

[**Right now, the Ohio Senate race is a TOSS UP and one of our best opportunities of flipping a Democrat-held seat in 2024.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=f13dd54bdff74d479605d2b288f34ca9&_e=T1IaVwLCiFhPOdci-8K6XcT9JePrA4BhUqNndc9bkC8kLd5-c6MBmeJZC8XbPeTiPodlXMDjAUn-kEXRB8tooQYdSrJDXEjpnTfO49RldBukOXXsWsO4B-H1rN9FMhWFCnrrxRE3BRQNHtZDlj87L6SuuI_3rYT7H2_aRt_PbfpmpMwZx3pGYlorhTnnWZ-hd1RxOGDEK9elMvdaEV7nF3fVBbuVI9q6zAWj9cSEC3eM_nwFdWFZsSVouVVbR5fc5uN_159mO8766DDKzfPESjAuA2h4_p8uTJw0TjO91iPXxyNCidAVQPI2mR653wpTCvJLEUD-lYbeaYO9lJHbKuZ9MquyBWgfsuHVZ07xXUMCtrMZjgmqRAMdFmVcw4yEXdzcze367D1mVPjzHZ2a7BmuzW_kEHEoDWTSr9rsZHE%3D)

Bernie Moreno is the exact opposite of his liberal Democrat opponent. He knows what it's like to build a successful business and he has lived the American dream. Now, he's running to protect it for future generations.

It’s time to fire Martin Heinrich.

# _🐾 Paco’s Piece 🐾_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | **The Dog Days of Summer** Summer is wrapping up as September marches on. I made a new friend in Wagon Mound, where T-Bone joined me for the Bean Day parade.
Nobody gave us any beans, though.
The very next week we barked around again at the State Fair Parade! That was a long one! So long that T-Bone rode on the float while I huffed it!
I love parades. Still no beans, and despite my new friend’s name, we didn’t get any steak, either.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Police find remains of SUV driver involved in Deer Park pipeline fire,"** Houston Chronicle's**Peter Warren** and**Octavia Johnson** -- "Deer Park city officials confirmed human remains were found in the vehicle involved in the [pipeline fire near Deer Park and La Porte](https://substack.com/redirect/013197e2-c25a-4ff9-b547-808caf97ff68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after it was towed by authorities Thursday morning following the days-long incident that [led to the evacuation of nearby homes](https://substack.com/redirect/40eba716-496f-44d3-8f06-f9cd7e2d8f18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The situation has developed into a criminal investigation, and officials said no further information will be released until the investigation concludes.

Deer Park OEM spokesperson **Kaitlyn Bluejacket** said the Deer Park Police Department and Harris County Medical Examiner are preparing to begin the next steps of the investigation into how the emergency transpired at the Energy Transfer property off Spencer Highway.

Authorities have not provided any other information about the driver. As of around 11 a.m. Thursday, no one from the medical examiner's office had been called to the scene, spokesman **Shane Hughes** said.

There was a large police presence in the area Thursday morning. Deer Park police equipment was at the scene and a blue tent was erected over the burned SUV.

The pipeline fire shrank significantly on Wednesday but was expected to keep burning Thursday, with officials previously stating [they hope to complete repairs by 6 p.m](https://substack.com/redirect/40eba716-496f-44d3-8f06-f9cd7e2d8f18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Located on the border of Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena, the fire has been burning since Monday. It may have sparked when the SUV hit an above-ground pipeline valve. Energy Transfer owns the natural gas pipeline.

Deer Park OEM officials said in a Thursday statement that Energy Transfer is working with third-party contractors to contain the fire through the installation of appropriate infrastructure.

Deer Park officials lifted the evacuation order for areas surrounding the fire Wednesday at 6 p.m. Spencer Highway between Luella Avenue and East/Canada Boulevard remains closed. The Walmart on Spencer Highway reopened at 10 a.m. Thursday. Air monitoring will continue at nearby schools, including Heritage Elementary and College Park Elementary as of Thursday morning." The situation has developed into a criminal investigation, and officials said no further information will be released until the investigation concludes. Authorities have not provided any other information about the driver. Deer Park police equipment was at the scene and a blue tent was erected over the burned SUV. The pipeline fire shrank significantly on Wednesday but was expected to keep burning Thursday, with officials previously stating . Located on the border of Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena, the fire has been burning since Monday. It may have sparked when the SUV hit an above-ground pipeline valve. Energy Transfer owns the natural gas pipeline. Deer Park OEM officials said in a Thursday statement that Energy Transfer is working with third-party contractors to contain the fire through the installation of appropriate infrastructure. Deer Park officials lifted the evacuation order for areas surrounding the fire Wednesday at 6 p.m. Spencer Highway between Luella Avenue and East/Canada Boulevard remains closed. The Walmart on Spencer Highway reopened at 10 a.m. Thursday. Air monitoring will continue at nearby schools, including Heritage Elementary and College Park Elementary as of Thursday morning." | | | Speaker Mike Johnson and House Republicans are sending us straight toward a government shutdown unless they get their act together and pass a spending bill within the next few days. But Johnson is trying to do it with only Republicans, and he is failing miserably, given that his razor-thin majority means a handful of GOP extremists can block any bill – and they are hellbent on doing just that. The sensible thing to do would be to work with Democrats on a compromise bill, and tell the extremists to take a hike. But Johnson hasn't done it. A shutdown would cause chaos in the lives of millions of Americans, and we can't let it happen. [**Demand Mike Johnson and House Republicans do their jobs and work with Democrats to keep the government open >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3881964e-a71d-49cc-9b60-a6b44aa4adc3/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**" Police find remains of SUV driver involved in Deer Park pipeline fire,"** Houston Chronicle's**Peter Warren** and**Octavia Johnson** -- "Deer Park city officials confirmed human remains were found in the vehicle involved in the [pipeline fire near Deer Park and La Porte](https://substack.com/redirect/0584fe04-6c63-4f4c-a84a-499015e95de1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after it was towed by authorities Thursday morning following the days-long incident that [led to the evacuation of nearby homes](https://substack.com/redirect/2d257edb-01e1-42e6-b05b-5c19b9aa1034?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The situation has developed into a criminal investigation, and officials said no further information will be released until the investigation concludes.

Deer Park OEM spokesperson **Kaitlyn Bluejacket** said the Deer Park Police Department and Harris County Medical Examiner are preparing to begin the next steps of the investigation into how the emergency transpired at the Energy Transfer property off Spencer Highway.

Authorities have not provided any other information about the driver. As of around 11 a.m. Thursday, no one from the medical examiner's office had been called to the scene, spokesman **Shane Hughes** said.

There was a large police presence in the area Thursday morning. Deer Park police equipment was at the scene and a blue tent was erected over the burned SUV.

The pipeline fire shrank significantly on Wednesday but was expected to keep burning Thursday, with officials previously stating [they hope to complete repairs by 6 p.m](https://substack.com/redirect/2d257edb-01e1-42e6-b05b-5c19b9aa1034?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Located on the border of Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena, the fire has been burning since Monday. It may have sparked when the SUV hit an above-ground pipeline valve. Energy Transfer owns the natural gas pipeline.

Deer Park OEM officials said in a Thursday statement that Energy Transfer is working with third-party contractors to contain the fire through the installation of appropriate infrastructure.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

clean_body: Heinrich and the Democrats NEVER thought they would be in danger in this seat, but they also never saw us coming. | Peter, Something exciting is happening out West that I need you to know about. In the presumed safe-blue state of New Mexico, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate Nella Domenici has the Democrats on their heels. Polling has her within single digits of a 15-year career left-wing politician, with 21% of voters undecided! Nella outraised Heinrich in her first quarter, and she’s unexpectedly put New Mexico in play as a seat Republicans could flip. It’s exciting to think I could have another Republican woman from the West joining me in the Senate. But most importantly, she’ll be joining us as a new vote on critical fights to secure our borders, restore economic stability, promote domestic energy production and independence, and ensure safer communities. Nella Domenici has my full support, and she’s on the brink of taking the lead in a race Democrats never thought they would have to fight. All she needs is support from us to keep this seat in play. For America, Cynthia Lummis | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
Baugh, Who Has Refused To Condemn Domestic Violence In Marriages, Now Advocates Physical Abuse of Children | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3c18bf69e1cd/leaked-audio-scott-baugh-condones-beating-children-18228918?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** September 19, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**LEAKED AUDIO — SCOTT BAUGH CONDONES BEATING CHILDREN**
_Baugh, Who Has Refused To Condemn Domestic Violence In Marriages,
Now Advocates Physical Abuse of Children_
**IRVINE, CA** — In yet another strange turn of events, Republican nominee for CA-47 Scott Baugh recently advocated for the use of corporal punishment — comparing physical punishment inflicted on children who misbehave as an example of what should be done to convicts. Baugh made the comments at the end of August at the Laguna Beach GOP Annual Membership Meeting.
[Listen To The Audio Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c778a78c83&e=7017cc100e)
While discussing Proposition 47, and Democrats’ supposed coddling of criminals, Baugh makes a bizarre analogy between parents and government. **“What happens when your children misbehave?”** he asks the crowd. **“You whip ‘em!”**

These comments are the latest in a string of remarks endorsing, or at least refusing to condemn, violence in the household. The [LA Times](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=1005ec83be&e=7017cc100e) and [Orange County Register](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=09c3ef613a&e=7017cc100e) is reported that **comments VP Nominee JD Vance made, about women staying in violent marriages, were made at an event at Pacific Christian, a charter school founded by CA-47’s Republican nominee Scott Baugh – who refused to address Vance’s disgusting comments.**

A [spokesperson](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=33eb614ab3&e=7017cc100e) for the school described the evening as “wonderful,” and that Vance and his comments were “well-received,” while [Baugh](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bcb5d8fabe&e=7017cc100e) refused to condemn Vance’s harmful insinuation or explain if he still supported the Vice Presidential pick in light of recent developments.

State Senator Dave Min, who is the Democratic candidate running against Scott Baugh, had much more direct commentary. **“Scott Baugh’s comments mainstreaming the physical abuse of children are despicable, and reflect his extreme views which place him squarely in the Trump/Vance MAGA wing of the Republican Party,” said Senator Min. “These radical views are out of step with the values of Orange County and they are dangerous to our families.”**

Baugh’s recent remarks surrounding corporal punishment are just one more proof point showing an obvious trend: Scott Baugh has little to no concern for the health and safety of Orange County’s women and families. His emphatic support of the Trump / Vance ticket is out of step with voters in Orange County. ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=dac6c68ac8&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=8e0b9a6b7e&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Tuesday may have been National Voter Registration Day, **but there’s still plenty of time to register or check your status before Election Day!**

This election is critical. Reproductive rights, Social Security, Medicare, and our environment are all on the line. If you’re not registered yet, you can do it in just a few minutes here: [**https://www.sos.mo.gov/elections/goVoteMissouri/register**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93151284/499529685/1422668303?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjgxMDY2Y2EtYWM3Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=T7V57uchV5PWaO93ufZkp6n0ShyhtuAwkkAkoBZHszs=&emci=e9fb6f8a-ec75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=281066ca-ac76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=1020964)

Your vote is powerful — make sure you're ready to use it.

– Bell HQ

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Wesley Bell for Congress
Date: Sep 17, 2024
Subject: Do you have a plan for Election Day? Team,

Today is National Voter Registration Day, and with the November election fast approaching, **now is the time to ensure you’re registered to vote and ready to make your voice heard.**

The stakes this November couldn’t be higher. This isn’t just another election – _it’s about shaping the future of our country for generations to come._ As Americans, we have a responsibility to exercise our constitutional right to use our voices not just for ourselves – **but also to protect our friends, loved ones, and neighbors.**

Here are three things you can do today to ensure you’re prepared for November:

1\. **Check your voter registration status.** Even if you think you’re registered, it doesn’t hurt to double-check. You can do that [**here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93151285/499529686/553517634?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjgxMDY2Y2EtYWM3Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=T7V57uchV5PWaO93ufZkp6n0ShyhtuAwkkAkoBZHszs=&emci=e9fb6f8a-ec75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=281066ca-ac76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=1020964) The deadline to register to vote in Missouri is October 9, 2024 – so don’t wait!

2\. **Register to vote or update your registration.** If it’s your first time voting or if you’ve moved, you can register to vote [**here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93151286/499529687/1422668303?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMjgxMDY2Y2EtYWM3Ni1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=T7V57uchV5PWaO93ufZkp6n0ShyhtuAwkkAkoBZHszs=&emci=e9fb6f8a-ec75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=281066ca-ac76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=1020964) It only takes a few minutes.

3\. **Forward this email to three friends.** Too many people miss their chance to vote because they didn’t register in time. Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen this year.

Let’s be clear: The decisions we make this November will shape our future. Women's rights, action on climate change, and programs like Social Security and Medicare are all on the line. Extremists are hell-bent on taking us backward to the dark ages, **and we need to fight back.**

So, if you haven’t registered yet, now’s the time. It takes just a few minutes to get ready to vote in November. | | As the lead Democrat on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I have seen firsthand how investing in infrastructure builds our economy. The latest T&I news comes out of Tulalip. **In the summer, I helped secure $4.9 million for Tulalip Tribes' road safety projects.** The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) awarded the funding to the Tulalip Tribes to plan, design, and construct improvements to the 4th Street and 88th Street NE crossings of I-5. These two interchanges regularly experience congestion and mobility challenges for cars, trucks, pedestrians, and transit users. **DOT awarded the funding through the Rebuilding American Infrastructure with Sustainability and Equity (RAISE) Discretionary Grant Program** , which enables communities of all sizes to carry out road, rail, transit, and other surface transportation projects with significant local or regional impact. **Since 2021, I have secured over $80 million in RAISE grants for Northwest Washington**. In our state, transportation means jobs. You cannot have a big league economy with little league infrastructure. I will continue to bring home federal funding to build a better future for our communities. Peter,

Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

This proposal is nothing more than a blatant voter suppression tactic aimed at disenfranchising vulnerable communities , particularly minorities and low-income voters, who may struggle to produce the necessary documentation. clean_body: what I told Andrea Mitchell: | | | Hi, friend — did you see me on MSNBC just now? = A LOT has happened this month: Vice President Kamala Harris went head-to-head with Donald Trump in their first debate, showing us yet again that she's more than ready to serve as our next president. Meanwhile, Rick Scott is running scared as he continues to ignore invitations to meet me on the debate stage — flat out refusing to answer questions about facing off in a debate. The tides are turning, friend — and the polls are showing it! A recent poll shows me just ONE point behind Rick Scott. And friend, with the help of this grassroots team, I know we can pull ahead and defeat him. With just 47 days left until Election Day, my team and I are doing everything we can, from launching my 75-stop tour across Florida to connect with voters, to launching brand new TV ads — in English and Spanish — so we can fight back against Rick Scott's attack ads. That's why I was so glad to discuss these major updates on MSNBC to spread the word nationwide about how high the stakes are in Florida's elections. Listen: Rick Scott co-sponsored a nationwide ban on abortions, he wrote the plan to end Medicare and Social Security, and he wants to raise taxes on the middle class. This is a guy whose agenda is too extreme for even Mitch McConnell — and now he’s running to take McConnell’s place as the next Senate Republican leader. Friend, we absolutely cannot let him become the Senate majority leader this November. Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of the worst things to ever happen to the Senate. It will take years for our country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption, cronyism, extremism, and obstruction. But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse. He's already spent over $4 MILLION running attack ads, and he can keep writing checks from his massive fortune of almost a quarter-billion dollars. Last time around, he spent $64 million of his own fortune to buy his seat. I'm not just up against an extremist, friend — I'm up against a multimillionaire extremist. | | “According to Marcus Greene, Philadelphia regional organizing director at the[ New Pennsylvania Project](https://u44255144.ct.sendgrid.net/ls/click?upn=u001.ekJ0nzuGxxKMd6ADw0n9Yhfw4GwcAy1ZO0FpWQelFo4-2FlGyvFD-2FmbqCZ07IbqZwcjE6FwGHj69XXIcpFiXp-2BdQ-3D-3DrUX2_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVAKmTIthZAqug-2BBe3TY9jweA5gYJTWBMeK2mbEu1GsUAWbMxqbbanoccXqIiueqpc6DIzHn4ElffI7A3Y14vKdCNksTNdqpcPsZ-2Fywu-2FMuXA4y3CGiU9X4tiAddJTMlizHBV3fCrFnIJPehcpV1HfrYov83Ub9ZvDr7bmYaPEzDi3O3nDQgZq9MYZIKnWuWtw46x3VeoJ4mafD8AAoj48IZQIVXrUtBuofqc4OA9GtzcMk8KwjGa9VtJt-2FIvVyGSzvTbcJfn3k7auAtMvO8ukF91VDGG7n3Id1seoeF6otpfV5IcXofuprDvozVdCBpX9V9V53YF3vSETN7r3xctB5j), a nonpartisan voting rights organization, more than 2 million Pennsylvania residents who are eligible to vote are not registered.

clean_body: | | | | | Hi Friend , Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, upcoming events, and exciting career opportunities. The election has started. Today and every day until Tuesday, November 5th, is Election Day.We will continue to provide key election updates and highlight the issues that shape Pennsylvania's future. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress in helping eliminate barriers to the ballot box. Now and in every election, we invite you to join us in our mission to mobilize voters to the polls, and to make change in our communities.#WhenWeVoteWeWin | | | | | | | | Opening the Prison Cage: Unerasing Women Behind Bars Thursday, September 19, 2024 5:30PM-8:30PM Parkway Central Library 1901 Vine St, Philadelphia, PA 19103 The evening will begin with a screening of the film "Kemba," which tells the harrowing yet inspiring story of Kemba Smith's journey from a college student to a federal prisoner, and her eventual pardon. The screening will be followed by a talk-back with Kemba Smith and Kadida Kenner. | | | Let the People Vote - Berks Town Hall Saturday, September 21st, 2024 12:00-1:30pm Southeast Reading Library 1426 Perkiomen Ave, Reading, PA 19602 Kadida Kenner will be the keynote speaker at an ACLU Town Hall focused on holding county commissioners accountable for passing pro-voter policies. The event will cover the importance of the upcoming elections, how the lack of these policies has historically harmed communities, and why elected officials must prioritize voting rights. | | | | | | | | | | | | “According to Marcus Greene, Philadelphia regional organizing director at the, a nonpartisan voting rights organization, more than 2 million Pennsylvania residents who are eligible to vote are not registered. Greene, who canvassed with volunteers Saturday, said an in-person conversation, as opposed to other forms of voter outreach, “really gets people engaged.” “It’s really a lack of understanding, a lack of education on what to do, what the process is,” he said. “How can I really effectively make my vote count by being educated on the people that are running, the issues that are going on in our community? So it’s really that educational piece that’s vital to get them out.” | | | | | “Several Allentown activists joined a voting rights organization on Voter Registration Day to highlight environmental justice and the two major presidential candidates’ “different visions.”New Pennsylvania Project led a short news conference with Allentown's Soldiers and Sailors Monument as its backdrop Tuesday, seven weeks from Election Day. Dave Heayn-Menendez, the organization’s chief strategy and organizing officer, called for Lehigh Valley voters to prioritize the environment this fall.” | | | Gabriela Huerta, director of strategic communications On Univision’s live 6pm newscast of September 17th, our director of strategic communications explained, in Spanish, that elected officials closer to you are the ones that influence what happens in your communities, so it is very important to show up on election day to vote on down ballot races.The network celebrated National Voter Registration Day with a special broadcast urging the Latino community to register to vote and to check their registration status. | | | The 2024 general election has started in Pennsylvania Pennsylvanians in 2024 can vote in-person at a polling place, with a mail-in-ballot, or with an absentee ballot. When they can vote depends on one’s particular county. | | “Early voting” is not technically possible in Pennsylvania, but once a county’s ballots are finalized and printed, a registered voter can apply for their mail-in ballot in person at their county election office, complete it, and then submit it all in one visit. Montgomery County received its first ballot on September 17th, National Voting Registration Day. (as of the time of writing only one county did). In our last newsletter, we celebrated an August 30th ruling by the Commonwealth Court that protected mail-in-ballots with minor dating errors, ensuring cast votes were counted in Pennsylvania.An appeal ruling on Friday by the state Supreme Court overturned the lower court ruling by a 4-3 vote that stated the Commonwealth Court did not have the authority to rule on the case. To learn more see our Why Courts Matter section below. | | | The new ruling means voters completing mail-in or absentee ballots should be very mindful when doing so, making sure they, accurately and completely, fill out all the required information. | | | Tuesday, October 29 is the last day to request a mail-in-ballot, and a county election office must receive the ballot by 8 pm on Tuesday, November 5 for it to be counted. However, mail-in-ballots can and should be cast as early as possible. This could allow enough time to ensure your vote is not thrown out due to inconsequential errors. | | | This lawsuit could strip voters’ voices across the state.If successful, those who make mistakes on their mail-in ballot, like not dating it correctly, forgetting to sign it, or not putting it in the outer envelope, could lose their opportunity to vote in the upcoming election. | | | | | NPP ON THE GROUND National Voter Registration Day | | | | | National Voter Registration Day drive in Bethlehem, PA on September 17, 2024 Our teams on the ground are going strong as we continue the national momentum towards registering eligible voters! There are still 2.1 million eligible voters in Pennsylvania who are either not yet registered to vote, or at risk of their status being dropped. Our mission is to help change that. | Diversifying the electorate | | | | | Good vibes and inspiration at Fairhill neighborhood in Philadelphia, PA on September 14, 2024 as speakers discuss a needed call-to-action for more Latin American votes. The People for Puerto Rico organized this event with the Labor Council for Latin American Advancement, the New Pennsylvania Project, and local community leaders. Philadelphia has second largest Puerto Rican population in the country with 140,000 Puerto Rican residents. That's about 15% of the total population of the city, and 40% of the whole state's Puerto Rican population. | College student voter education | | | | | Our initiatives for college student voter education continues! The biggest obstacle for college student voters--who are generally the least experienced voters-- is a lack of understanding around the voting process. Our teams make sure to share knowledge and resources to help bridge the gap. Pictured above: Our team on the ground at Cedar Crest College. | RECENT EVENTS September 17, 2024 National Voter Registration Day | | | | | On National Voter Registration Day, New Pennsylvania Project and Climate Power hosted a press conference in Allentown to highlight how Pennsylvania is facing increasingly severe weather due to climate change and what elected officials can and should be doing to protect our future. Communities of color disproportionately bear the weight of extreme weather. We encouraged Pennsylvanians to register to vote, show up on Tuesday, November 5th, and vote with the future of our families, communities, and planet in mind. | | | “The Republican National Committee (RNC) a petition in the Pennsylvania Supreme Court on Wednesday arguing that voters who make mistakes on mail-in ballots shouldn’t be allowed to cure their ballots or vote using a provisional ballot on Election Day. Currently in Pennsylvania, individual counties have created procedures to notify voters if their mail-in ballot cannot be counted and provide them the opportunity to cure that ballot or instead cast a provisional ballot at a polling place on Election Day.” “Pennsylvanians who vote by mail must write a proper date on their ballot envelopes for their votes to be counted, under from the state Supreme Court that could affect thousands of voters this November.The decision voids an that enforcing the requirement on ballot dating violated voters’ rights under the state constitution." “Pennsylvania's Supreme Court on Friday sided with lower court decisions to block two third-party presidential candidates from the battleground state's ballot in November's election. The decisions hand a win apiece to each major party, as Democratic and Republican party loyalists work to fend off third-party candidates for fear of siphoning votes away from their parties' presidential nominees in a state critical to winning the White House.” “A court decided Thursday that voters in the presidential battleground of Pennsylvania can cast provisional ballots in place of mail-in ballots that are rejected for a garden-variety mistake they made when they returned it.” | “Luzerne County Manager Romilda Crocamo on Wednesday scuttled the use of ballot during the upcoming November election because of staffing shortages. In a notice to county election officials, Crocamo cited security concerns and financial risk as reasons for not deploying drop boxes.” “Voters in the key battleground of Pennsylvania may notice their ballots look different this year, as the state prepares to deploy a new design in the general election for the first time this year that aims to reduce the number of rejected votes.” “The Allegheny County Board of Elections voted 2-1 Monday to add satellite voting centers. “You can do it really quickly. Just a few couple hundred yards away at Soldiers and Sailors. It’s amazing to see between classes or on the way to or from campus,” Pitt student Ben Wainwright told Channel 11.Wainwright spent his afternoon at the county courthouse, speaking on behalf of the Pitt students he’s discussed the voting process with.” “Montgomery County government has doubled the number of voter offices and increased the ballot drop off boxes ahead of the general election in November.It's part of a larger effort to bolster the county's voting related services and election security, and make the county a national leader in voter turnout.” “Vice President Kamala Harris has a narrow lead over former President Donald Trump in Pennsylvania’s presidential race, an edge fueled by a rebound in support among young voters and voters of color that is particularly potent in the Democratic stronghold of Philadelphia. A Philadelphia Inquirer/New York Times/Siena College poll taken shortly after the debate showed Harris with a nearly 4-point lead, within the survey’s margin of error.” “Despite a bump following Joe Biden’s exit from the presidential race, Democrats in Pennsylvania are entering the home stretch of the 2024 election with their weakest voter registration advantage compared with Republicans in recent decades. The party’s raw registration numbers began to rise after Biden dropped out in late July, and that trend is continuing. But simultaneously, the number of Republicans has increased even more quickly.” “The state treasurer is one of three elected row officers in the commonwealth, and plays a crucial role in managing state dollars. They can serve a maximum of two four-year terms.State revenue is deposited into the Treasury, and the office uses the money to pay bills for things like contracts and workers. The treasurer also invests state savings, and sits on the boards of Pennsylvania’s two massive public sector pension funds.” “Nine years after Donald Trump’s rise in American politics, the stakes on immigration may seem clear enough. Trump wants a harsh crackdown on illegal immigration, with a border wall and mass deportations. Kamala Harris wants an approach that balances border security with human rights considerations.” “Pennsylvanians like Gov. Josh Shapiro more than both Harris and Trump. ELECTION INTEGRITY ALERT!
WE NEED YOUR HELP!
THIS IS AN IMPORTANT "ASK"!
PLEASE READ THIS & TAKE ACTION!**
---
|
Dear GFI Network Member,

Ohio election systems and processes are vulnerable to voter registration and absentee ballot fraud based on evidence of alleged bulk fraudulent submissions from canvassers employed by [Black Fork Strategies](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=3da83ffc7f&e=5c740fa3e2). The basis for Ohio election vulnerabilities to voter records is reliance upon the “honor-system,” and rules put in place by Ohio Secretary of State LaRose that direct Boards of Elections to treat unvetted (non-validated) records as fully qualified eligible electors authorized to sign petitions and vote absentee.

With tens of thousands of newly arrived non-citizens in Ohio ([like Haitians](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=cfd80b6709&e=5c740fa3e2)) and over 250,000 records in question, Ohio’s elected officials must mitigate risk of exploitation and susceptibility to fraud in the election system by bad actors before early voting!

This call to action asks Secretary of State Frank LaRose to take additional lawful measures under direction of law and authority granted to his office to expand protections over ballot access by requiring mismatched and out-of-state voter records to vote a provisional ballot. A Provisional Ballot protects against denial and dilution of the vote by requiring a non-fully verified voter record to only vote in person and reconcile the missing and invalid information in the record BEFORE that vote counts. This is common sense and will deter and reduce voter fraud in the upcoming 2024 Nov election.

Thank you to the House Representatives who have already displayed bold leadership in support of [**this letter**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f4899e3aec&e=5c740fa3e2) to SOS LaRose agreeing that election integrity legislation is a priority in the House and asking the SOS to take all measures within his authority to help secure the 2024 election before early voting starts:

Rep. Jennifer Gross
Rep. Brett Hillyer
Rep. DJ Swearingen
Rep. Beth Lear
Rep. Bernard Willis
Rep. Tim Barhorst
Rep. Angie King
Rep. Jay Edwards
Rep. Bob Peterson
Rep. Thad Claggett
Rep. Adam Matthews
Rep. Bill Dean
Rep. Monica Blasdel
Rep. Tex Fischer
Rep. Adam C. Bird
Rep. Gary Click
Rep. Rodney Creech

**CALL TO ACTION:**

Contact those who have signed [this letter](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c41fde873a&e=5c740fa3e2) to thank them for supporting clean voter rolls. (Save the link to the letter as a bookmark so that you can occasionally check to see who has signed it).

Please click [here](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=303766008a&e=5c740fa3e2) for contact info for all House Republicans. EMAIL all the Republicans who have not yet signed the letter using the following email template... (Note, to do this quickly and easily, just copy all the Reps. Emails at once and then paste all of them into the BCC field and hit send – one email vs. many).

“Dear Representative,

I implore you to join your colleagues in taking a lead on protecting the integrity of the 2024 election by signing on to the House of Representatives letter to Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose which implores him to adhere to O.R.C [3501.05](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=bf7670517a&e=5c740fa3e2) which states that he SHALL either eliminate or “mark” (as provisional) any registration which does not match records or is from an out of state voter. Read the letter [here](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=d3d370c9a3&e=5c740fa3e2).

Considering the significant concerns regarding citizenship verification, and the potential that illegals could be voting in our election, we ask that you please sign onto this letter so that the SOS will sense the urgency for him to make the 2024 election as safe, fair and honest as humanly possible. Please email [jjones@clevelandrighttolife.org](mailto:jjones@clevelandrighttolife.org) to have your name added to the list.

Thank you.

Sincerely, Your name”

THANK YOU! from the Election Integrity Collaboration!
