**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
This is an email about why we do the work we do here at EMILYs List. |
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93157406/499550177/-784138815?refcode=WTENEU52_20240918_ProPublica_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1054904&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODFlZTJlYy1iNTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YKvOQiWswqVAKYS2M3iZb1VZEzR3pRS9dZ_XPmydzKU=&emci=c51ee2ec-b576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c81ee2ec-b576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=5177934) This week, _ProPublica_ published an article about Amber Nicole Thurman, a 28-year-old woman in Georgia who died as a result of her state's abortion ban. She is one of two women so far _that we know_ died as a result of the Georgia ban — but there are likely many unreported stories just like theirs, in Georgia and across the country.

**Peter, this is not a fundraising email. This is an email about why we do the work we do here at EMILYs List.**

Amber Thurman died of a treatable infection after sitting in a hospital bed, in pain, for 20 hours. She desperately needed a surgical abortion to address the infection, but her doctors were afraid to treat her and potentially face a decade in prison because of Georgia's abortion ban. By the time they operated, the infection had spread and it was too late. She left behind a six-year-old son.

This fight we are in is not about weeks or exceptions. It's about who gets to make choices about what happens to our bodies. It's about whether patients will get life-saving care when they need it. Amber's death is not just a horrible, heartbreaking tragedy that could have been prevented, but as Vice President Kamala Harris said: it's a direct result of the Georgia ban and the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , which happened because Donald Trump hand-picked anti-choice extremist Supreme Court justices.

Anti-choice Republican politicians will not be swayed by stories about women bleeding out in hospital parking lots, becoming septic, developing long-term health complications — or dying in front of doctors who risk prison time for treating them. The dangers of these laws are evident, but GOP legislators still refuse to amend abortion bans to protect women's lives. **For Republicans, cruelty is the point.** The _only_ way to protect women is to keep the GOP out of power at every level of government. Period.

Since 1985, EMILYs List has been fighting to elect Democratic pro-choice women and defeat anti-choice Republicans. **This year, with our reproductive care in a national state of emergency,_there will be a Democratic pro-choice woman and an anti-choice Republican man at the top of every ballot in America_.** **So our ask for you is this: Please make a plan to vote on November 5 — or sooner.** | [I WILL VOTE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93157407/499550178/-1612268846?refcode=WTENEU52_20240918_ProPublica_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1054904&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODFlZTJlYy1iNTc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YKvOQiWswqVAKYS2M3iZb1VZEzR3pRS9dZ_XPmydzKU=&emci=c51ee2ec-b576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c81ee2ec-b576-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=5177934)
---
Thank you for being a part of this fight. May Amber Nicole Thurman rest in peace, and may her memory be a force for change.

Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers)

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: September 19th, 2024
body:
Let's talk about Georgia.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! We're excited to introduce _Across the Country_ , a brand-new email series from No Dem Left Behind that will dive into the stories shaping the most pivotal battleground states as we approach the 2024 election. These stories could be game-changers, and we believe it's crucial to keep you informed on how they could impact the election. My name is Daniela Rodriguez, a proud first-generation American with Latin roots. With experience spanning humanitarian assistance, politics, education, public service, and journalism/speechwriting, I am thrilled to be part of this historic election cycle! Twice a week, myself and my colleague, Sabrina Niazi, will bring you in-depth analysis, polling data, and trends so you can get the full picture of what’s happening on the ground. From key issues to shifting voter sentiments, _Across the Country_ will provide a front-row seat to the stories that matter most. We hope you enjoy this journey with us as we march toward November 5th! -Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **Georgia**
---
|
---
The tragic death of Amber Thurman in Georgia, who passed away after suffering complications after taking an abortion pill. Due to restrictive state laws, Amber was given inadequate help. VP Harris rightly pointed out that **this loss was preventable.** There were laws in place to protect women’s reproductive rights, but the current abortion bans are endangering lives and driving maternal mortality rates higher each day. In Georgia alone, **at least two women have died after being denied essential medical care;** this is the dangerous reality created by Trump-appointed justices who overturned Roe V. Wade. There is a very real fight for women’s health and autonomy across the nation. Abortion is a key issue for many Georgia voters, despite the state's constitution blocking ballot initiatives like those seen nationwide. Georgia’s six-week ban can only be overturned through federal legislation or a new state law,**but the fight remains front and center.** Vice President Kamala Harris’s campaign has been heavily focused on reproductive rights, including multiple stops in Georgia as part of her “Fighting for Reproductive Freedom” bus tour. Georgia state Rep. Shea Roberts noted, **"Every event since Harris has been on the ticket has featured abortion discussions."** Recent ProPublica reporting highlighted the deadly consequences of Georgia's ban, with Harris warning, **"This is exactly what we feared when Roe was struck down."** Despite the obstacles, a coalition of advocates continues to press for change, keeping the issue alive in the Peach State. The message is clear: Georgia voters may not have a ballot initiative, **but they have a voice—and abortion is on the ballot.** As we approach November’s election, abortion is also a key issue nationally. A new poll reveals a growing consensus among Americans: **a solid majority opposes a federal abortion ban** and supports access to abortions for any reason. **6 in 10 Americans** now believe their state should allow a person to obtain a legal abortion if they don’t want to be pregnant—an increase from just a few years ago. This is a powerful signal that **abortion rights are more important than ever** in this election. Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, Republican-controlled states have imposed strict bans that deny women the right to make their own healthcare decisions. These draconian laws, which have gone into effect in **14 GOP-led states** , are opposed by a vast majority of Americans. **8 in 10 believe abortion should remain legal in extreme cases** —such as when the pregnancy endangers the mother's life or results from rape or incest. Yet, many Americans worry that a national abortion ban could still be pursued. Despite **Donald Trump’s reluctance to fully endorse a nationwide ban** , his appointment of the justices responsible for overturning Roe has led us down this dangerous path. With **Trump and Republicans still courting anti-abortion voters** , the threat is real. We’ve already seen the tragic consequences in states like Georgia, where restrictive laws led to the preventable death of Amber Thurman. **Women’s lives are at risk under these cruel bans** , and we must act now to stop it. **Join us next week with Sabrina for the latest updates on nationwide breaking news. Stay informed with NDLB!**
---
|
---
-Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | |
---

**As your Secretary of State, I am deeply concerned about the harm this could do to public trust in our elections.** Minnesota’s election system is one of the most secure and transparent in the country, and I’m committed to ensuring it stays that way.

DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
Mitch McConnell is flooding in millions of dollars to smear my record and boost his handpicked candidate. Unfortunately, these attacks are working: The latest polls have this race wide open.
Look, I’ve never been your typical politician. I’m a farmer. I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I still farm the land my parents homesteaded 100 years ago. (Sharla and I are harvesting as we speak.)
I try every day to do right by the people of Montana. That means standing up to anybody—including Mitch McConnell and his special interests—to improve health care for veterans, lower prescription drug costs, and protect Medicare and Social Security.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Trump did in Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kristen for Michigan
body:
On Tuesday, Donald Trump held a town hall in Flint. A few hours earlier, J.D. Vance spoke in West Michigan at a rally in Kent County. These should have been opportunities to bring people together, or offer a plan for our state and our country. Instead, Trump did what has become typical for his events: he ranted about crowd size at his rallies, bragged about his relationships with Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, and repeated the lie that the 2020 election was unfair. Vance was no better, suggesting that Kamala Harris was leading us all on a “path to slavery.” This is Trump’s 10th visit to Michigan since he launched his 2024 presidential campaign. And it won’t be the last time we see him here. Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the race is tight. At the top of the ticket, and for my race for Senate. And everyone knows it will come down to the wire. Trump’s visit is part of a clear strategy to throw their resources at Michigan. If you watch even a few minutes of TV here you’ll see millions of dollars of attack ads on a non-stop loop. The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a “pure toss up” but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election. But we are not powerless. We can impact the outcome of the races in this state. [_**Want to help? body:
Look, Trump’s attacked me a few times now. Every time he comes down to Arizona he singles me out, and this last visit was no different.
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22099%2E4449941%2Ee4sXDo)
---
Team —

Look, Trump’s attacked me a few times now. Every time he comes down to Arizona he singles me out, and this last visit was no different.

He called me weak, and Kari Lake strong. And... honestly, from Trump himself, I was expecting the material to be a bit better. That’s all you got, Donald?

I guess Trump’s idea of strength is supporters who call for political violence on his behalf. Who tell their followers they need to “strap on a glock” to go to vote. Apparently strength is having court case after court case thrown out because there isn’t a shred of evidence behind your election lies.

My idea of strength is my mom, raising me and my three sisters on a secretary's salary. It’s my teachers, spending their time helping a kid with no money and no connections get into Harvard. It’s the guys I went out on patrol with in al Anbar, Iraq.

Strength, to me, is taking a stand to defend our democracy. Like you have. It means a lot to have you on this team.

One of the most important votes this November is the vote of the youth as this election is really about their future and their freedom. _**The choices we make in November will determine their futures over the next decade or longer and many of them are too young to vote and have a say in their future.**_
[ Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/437921af-3fae-48f5-ae99-1628e416f1d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I have been speaking with college-age voters and their parents. Regardless of their religious background, October 7th has changed how high-school students and their parents are looking at the college admission process.
Since October 7th, our college campuses have been under attack. According to a 2023 Gallup poll, about three in four Americans said they identify with a specific religious faith and most of them believe in Judeo-Christian principles.

**This election is also about Making America Safe Again on our campuses, in our schools and on our streets.**
_**This is our future and I am doing everything I can to restore safety and security to this nation so our children can have the education that many of us received, free from fear of attacks by radicals while respecting the First Amendment.**_
Below is a story that a high school student sent me that expresses the sentiment of our college-age children. While this student happens to be Jewish, these are views expressed by many students for their general safety and respect for a healthy expression of diversity of ideas.
The big takeaway from this student and from parents across our district is that _**you are voting for voices that cannot vote**_. As this student states "**Many of us aren 't old enough to vote, and we're counting on you to consider our physical and emotional safety when you go to the polls this November. Your vote is not just a political statement; it's a stand against hate." **
Take that sentiment to the polls this November.
_The Impact of October 7th on the College Decision Process:_
The tragedy of October 7th and the American response has affected the lives of American Jewry in countless ways. As a high school senior, it's ravaged the one place where I should feel safe: my home for the next 4 years-college.
Before October 7th, the list of colleges I was most excited about looked like this: Columbia, Harvard, UPenn, Cornell, Yale. Now almost a year after the atrocities, all but one has been crossed off the list of schools I am applying to entirely.
According to the ADL, the U.S. has seen a 400% increase in the number of antisemitic incidents post-October 7th. Perhaps even more compelling is that before October 7th, two-thirds of Jewish college students reported feeling "very" or "extremely" physically safe on campus. Today, that number has fallen below one-half.
In May 2024, the U.S. House of Representatives passed a bill designed to combat anti-Semitism. Only 21 Republicans voted against the measure, compared with 70 Democrats.
Democrats hide behind the First Amendment. But their commitment to supposed "free speech" is a thinly veiled excuse to continue allowing pro-Palestinian protestors to terrorize Jewish students and wreak havoc on college campuses across the nation. I am a major proponent of free speech. But free speech is different from hate speech.
Jewish students deserve lawmakers who recognize the difference between the two, and will advocate for our protection in Congress.
**Many of us aren 't old enough to vote, and we're counting on you to consider our physical and emotional safety when you go to the polls this November. Your vote is not just a political statement; it's a stand against hate.**
Vote Goldstein for Safety this November. If you can support my campaign so we can continue to get the word out, we would greatly appreciate it.

| Hi Friend,
I think we all agree: Texans should never face bankruptcy over medical bills.
But every day here in TX-31, someone living here is faced with an impossible choice: paying for their prescriptions or paying their mortgage.
Someone else is skimping on groceries so they can afford life-saving insulin. Other families are having to choose between gassing up their car or cooling down their house.
Hardworking Texas families have been hit hard by inflation, and we're no exception here in TX-31.
Prices on necessities -- things that Texas families have to buy -- have risen to all time highs in the past year or two. And, we're all feeling the pinch (well, maybe not independently wealthy members of Congress, but that's a story for another day...)
I'm hearing countless stories on the campaign trail about the tough economic choices that Texas families are facing right now.
...And worse, no one's been able to reach our current Congressman to talk about it. I'm making lowering costs a top priority of this campaign -- because no Texan should have to choose between groceries or gas. And I've said from day one that I'll always be a leader who listens to you.
Making sure every Texans has the opportunity to get ahead, that was a big motivator behind why I decided to run for Congress.
And that's no big surprise, given my track record here in the district. Years before I'd ever even thought about running for Congress, I helped start the award-winning job training program, "Capital Idea," and then brought it to Williamson County. I've proudly helped thousands of TX-31 residents get a jumpstart on their careers.
To stay ahead, we need a new generation of leaders in Congress, folks who can legislate pragmatically.
It's time for a new day here in Texas 31.
After 22 years in Congress, my opponent is just out of step with the rest of us. And he seems to have forgotten that we can't fix our affordability crisis by posting inflammatory nonsense on social media -- it's going to take real legislative action to bring costs down for everyday Texans.
Friend, ballots are being sent out to Texas voters in just a few weeks -- it's now or never for our campaign.
We've done everything we can to get this race as close as it is -- our latest polling has us TIED with John Carter. [Now, we've got to keep our momentum up and win this. But unlike my opponent, who is almost entirely focused on tearing apart who I am and what I stand for, we are focused on sharing our vision for a stronger Montana with voters around our state. Unfortunately for us, Jon Tester has a knack for hanging on. While Montana has become increasingly Republican since Tester was first elected in 2006, he’s been able to win in 2012 and 2018 by lying through his teeth about who he is and what policies he supports. Peter, I’m running against a chameleon. From now through November 5th, it’s critical that we’re able to hold his feet to the flames and expose his true colors. We’re the one race everyone is watching. Make a generous contribution to flip the Senate today. ## Why Is Everyone So Upset About a Baseball Field?
Hi Neighbor, We’ve been hearing the same question a lot recently: Why is everyone so upset about a baseball field? ⚾ It’s a valid question, and one that deserves some clarification. The recent sale of Bill Evans Baseball Field has sparked concern across our community—not just from those who use the field, but from residents who care about the future of our city’s recreational spaces. Many have asked, “What’s the big deal?” So let’s clear the air and share some facts that might help. **It’s not just the baseball field we are losing!** 🚨 The sale also includes the Badgett Stadium Practice Field, a grassy space that’s used daily by kids and adults for soccer, football, cheerleading, and more. Contrary to what’s been stated, this field is not covered in Kudzu or used only three months a year—it’s a vital recreational space for our community. 🌳🏈

|
---
|
---
| _The section in red is the area the city is attempting to sell_
---
|
---
But the questions don’t stop there:
* **Why sell prime downtown real estate at below-market value?** 💸 Millions of dollars below market value, to be exact. Multiple vacant tracts of land in the city could accommodate this project without taking anything away from our residents. 🏙️
* **Was the Open Meetings Act violated?** 📜 The sale wasn’t announced publicly, and there was no opportunity for resident input. It’s unusual—almost unheard of—for a city to sell off recreational spaces without involving its citizens.
* **Why does Councilwoman Jamelle McKenzie continue to mislead residents?** 🧐 At a recent town hall, she claimed she voted to deed the land to BIDA, and that they then decided to sell it. As a former BIDA chair, Councilwoman McKenzie is fully aware that BIDA operates at the direction of the City Council that appointed them.
* **What about the joint Morehouse/Marquis Grissom Baseball Association proposal?** 📄 They proposed to renovate Bill Evans Field by adding dugouts and a batting cage, aiming to make the field the home for Morehouse’s baseball team and host activities for the Marquis Grissom organization, along with regional and national tournaments. Despite Councilwoman McKenzie’s claims of not seeing this proposal, emails show otherwise.

These are just a few of the questions we’re asking, and we’re sure you have more. To help shed light on the situation, we’re putting together a **Fact Sheet** that will give you more details on Bill Evans Field, its history, and what’s at stake. Keep an eye on your inbox 📧 for more information. We understand that this is an emotional and complicated issue. But together, by staying informed and involved, we can make sure that the voices of our community are heard. 💬 Thank you for your continued support and passion for our city, United College Park _Paid for by United College Park_

It’s unusual—almost unheard of—for a city to sell off recreational spaces without involving its citizens. Why does Councilwoman Jamelle McKenzie continue to mislead residents? 🧐 At a recent town hall, she claimed she voted to deed the land to BIDA, and that they then decided to sell it. As a former BIDA chair, Councilwoman McKenzie is fully aware that BIDA operates at the direction of the City Council that appointed them. What about the joint Morehouse/Marquis Grissom Baseball Association proposal? 📄 They proposed to renovate Bill Evans Field by adding dugouts and a batting cage, aiming to make the field the home for Morehouse’s baseball team and host activities for the Marquis Grissom organization, along with regional and national tournaments. Despite Councilwoman McKenzie’s claims of not seeing this proposal, emails show otherwise. These are just a few of the questions we’re asking, and we’re sure you have more. To help shed light on the situation, we’re putting together a Fact Sheet that will give you more details on Bill Evans Field, its history, and what’s at stake. Keep an eye on your inbox 📧 for more information. We understand that this is an emotional and complicated issue. But together, by staying informed and involved, we can make sure that the voices of our community are heard. 💬 Thank you for your continued support and passion for our city, United College Park Paid for by United College Park | | | | | | | Special Thanks to Our Brunch Attendees! | | | UCP Member James Walker prepping his meal _We had a great time at our UCP brunch fundraiser. Israel’s dangerous escalation in Lebanon

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter,
The news out of Lebanon has been horrifying. Over the course of two days, ordinary electronic devices like pagers and walkie-talkies that Israel rigged into explosive devices have killed dozens and injured thousands more. Among the dead are 9 year-old Fatima Abdullah and 11 year-old Bilal Kanj, two more precious children snatched away by the murderous rampage of Israel’s rogue, genocidal regime. The media headlines all referred to “explosions” but none dare call it by its real name – **_terrorism_****.** Just imagine if the tables had been turned and Israelis - or Americans - were turned into unwitting bombers with everyday electronic devices being detonated in crowded civilian areas; we’d be overwhelmed with hand-wringing over such a bloodthirsty attack with vows to seek vengeance upon the terrorists responsible for the carnage. But as always, the U.S. media is running cover for Israel’s war crimes. Beyond the wanton killing and maiming of innocents, the implications of this operation are truly chilling. As NSA whistleblower Edward Snowden said on X: “ _If it were iPhones that were leaving the factory with explosives inside, the media would be a hell of a lot faster to cotton on to what a horrific precedent has been set today. Nothing can justify this. It's a crime. A crime. And everyone in the world is less safe for it.”_ Kamala Harris has repeatedly said that she is “working tirelessly for a ceasefire” but her words ring hollow as Israel keeps escalating and dragging us closer every day to a regional war in the Middle East that could turn into WWIII. [_**Peter, Jill and Butch will end this horror on day one of their administration by cutting off all aid to Israel until they end the occupation, the genocide, and the non-stop violence that they’re spreading all across the region. We have less than 50 days to get the word out and make an impact. name: John Goodman
subject: Lucas Kunce and I learned family values the same way
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=6&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu) Friend — born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.

**In a moment, I’ll ask you to** [join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in the critical U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year and the Voter Protection Project.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=7&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu) **But first, I think we need to talk about family values.** | [CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=8&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
---
I learned what family values meant while growing up in Missouri, the most beautiful state in the union.
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=9&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
I also learned what that didn’t mean.
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=10&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
Family values didn’t mean cruelty. It didn’t mean fake patriotism. It didn’t mean telling people how to live, or family profits. It didn’t mean making life harder for hardworking people. And it sure as hell didn’t mean robbing people of their rights or tax dollars.

**None of that is family values... that’s something else.**
[CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=11&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
---
Growing up in working class neighborhoods in Missouri, Lucas and I both learned what it meant for a family to live paycheck to paycheck.

We also learned the real meaning of family values — but not from rich politicians and self-help authors like Josh Hawley.
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=12&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
**We’re the Show Me State. People showed us.**
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=13&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
[CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=14&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
---
People like the neighbors and church friends that helped Lucas’ family get by when his parents were bankrupted by medical bills. People like the Scout master, track coach, and public school teachers who mentored and supported Lucas growing up. People like the veterans at Lucas’ local Marine Corps league in mid-Missouri, who taught him that he could honor and protect everyone who took care of him by serving like they did.

Lucas and I both learned that family values are really about people taking care of each other and doing the right thing. Through good times, and tough times.

**All that other noise from the politicians...**
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=15&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
**That’s something else.**

In Missouri this November, there’s a real choice in the Senate race. Josh Hawley only won his last race with 51% of the vote — and that was before he helped overturn Roe, enacted a total abortion ban, voted against IVF and birth control, stalled healthcare for veterans, and cost taxpayers $250,000 by breaking transparency laws to help his own campaign.

Lucas Kunce is the Marine veteran who can beat him. It won’t be easy, but it will be worth it.

**So I’m asking:** [Will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race and the Voter Protection Project by splitting a donation of any amount today? Lucas is committed to building his campaign the right way, without a dollar from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists, so anything you can give really will make a big impact.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=16&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Lucas Kunce and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78882?t=17&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78883?t=18&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78884?t=19&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78885?t=20&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78881?t=21&akid=16973%2E878179%2EX12BXu)
Thanks for listening,

John Goodman

It's about water AND electrolytes.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAQQL_G3oLOh7Hx4KELW7p2RIY7B6sGIjil6d9XrTpnfk9Peh_X8ZpKLdvtPa0c5Zn3kZjKnIRphHAx4YJ2tJriBBSM5mg8Ot8D9KiX2GGHLXlPNs05s2HTYZcCOxOSd2HSJSKghWCCCdbZtiHkdrJg2n5mD5mUBaYi-9HIwsLPdOb6vT_4aOZ91TUuIvdTtW8KB4UDHWX7rOsmv1Th8O_qI9L9q9RaTueVhduaSv0LyIunR8SfAAAA__9A9FA_) It makes sense--you lose both water and sodium when you sweat. Both need to be replaced to prevent muscle cramps, headaches, and energy dips that result from:
1. Dehydration (less common)
2. Low electrolytes (more common)

Most people only replace the water. Why? Because since the 1940s, we've been told to drink 8 glasses of water per day, thirsty or not. [Drinking beyond thirst isn't a good idea.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAQQL_G3oLOh7Hx4KELW7p2RIY7B6sGIjil6d9XrTpnfk9Peh_X8ZpKLdvtPa0c5Zn3kZjKnIRphHAx4YJ2tJriBBSM5mg8Ot8D9KiX2GGHLXlPNs05s2HTYZcCOxOSd2HSJSKghWCCCdbZtiHkdrJg2n5mD5mUBaYi-9HIwsLPdOb6vT_4aOZ91TUuIvdTtW8KB4UDHWX7rOsmv1Th8O_qI9L9q9RaTueVhduaSv0LyIunR8SfAAAA__9A9FA_) Thirst is the way our bodies regulate blood volume and fluid balance. When you need more fluids, you get thirsty. And when you drink plain water beyond thirst, it dilutes blood electrolyte levels (especially sodium levels) and leads to nasty consequences. These consequences include headaches, low energy, cramps, confusion, and worse. Unfortunately, since low-sodium symptoms mimic dehydration symptoms, people often get confused and drink more water. This only exacerbates the problem. When blood sodium levels are diluted like this, it's called hyponatremia. Hyponatremia is common in endurance athletes. Sometimes, it's fatal. So, we have a hydration problem on our hands. The solution isn't to stop drinking water though. It's to drink water _plus_ electrolytes. Enter [LMNT.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAQQL_G3oLOh7Hx4KELW7p2RIY7B6sGIjil6d9XrTpnfk9Peh_X8ZpKLdvtPa0c5Zn3kZjKnIRphHAx4YJ2tJriBBSM5mg8Ot8D9KiX2GGHLXlPNs05s2HTYZcCOxOSd2HSJSKghWCCCdbZtiHkdrJg2n5mD5mUBaYi-9HIwsLPdOb6vT_4aOZ91TUuIvdTtW8KB4UDHWX7rOsmv1Th8O_qI9L9q9RaTueVhduaSv0LyIunR8SfAAAA__9A9FA_) [](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAQQL_G3oLOh7Hx4KELW7p2RIY7B6sGIjil6d9XrTpnfk9Peh_X8ZpKLdvtPa0c5Zn3kZjKnIRphHAx4YJ2tJriBBSM5mg8Ot8D9KiX2GGHLXlPNs05s2HTYZcCOxOSd2HSJSKghWCCCdbZtiHkdrJg2n5mD5mUBaYi-9HIwsLPdOb6vT_4aOZ91TUuIvdTtW8KB4UDHWX7rOsmv1Th8O_qI9L9q9RaTueVhduaSv0LyIunR8SfAAAA__9A9FA_) Created by former research biochemist Robb Wolf and ketogains founder Luis Villaseñor, LMNT has enough sodium, potassium, and magnesium to get you feeling and performing your best. Plus it has ZERO sugar, artificial colors, or other dodgy ingredients to hold you back. Let's get specific about hydration needs now and why LMNT's science-backed electrolyte ratio makes a difference. We already covered how to get enough fluids: oftentimes, we can simply drink to thirst. But how many electrolytes do we need? The evidence suggests that we should shoot for 4000-6000 mg sodium, 3500-5000 mg potassium, and 400-600 mg magnesium per day from diet and supplements. If that sounds like a lot of sodium, consider that athletes can lose up to 7 grams of sodium per day through sweat! Most people fall short on electrolytes. Sodium restriction, for instance, is celebrated as "heart healthy." In reality, restricting sodium to fewer than 2.3 grams per day (in line with government recommendations) has been linked to higher rates of heart attack and stroke in heart disease patients. Five grams per day was the sweet spot for optimal health outcomes. [LMNT has your electrolyte needs covered.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx8j7FugzAQQL_G3oLOh7Hx4KELW7p2RIY7B6sGIjil6d9XrTpnfk9Peh_X8ZpKLdvtPa0c5Zn3kZjKnIRphHAx4YJ2tJriBBSM5mg8Ot8D9KiX2GGHLXlPNs05s2HTYZcCOxOSd2HSJSKghWCCCdbZtiHkdrJg2n5mD5mUBaYi-9HIwsLPdOb6vT_4aOZ91TUuIvdTtW8KB4UDHWX7rOsmv1Th8O_qI9L9q9RaTueVhduaSv0LyIunR8SfAAAA__9A9FA_) With 1,000 mg of sodium, 200 mg of potassium, and 60 mg of magnesium, it contains enough electrolytes to move the needle towards each of these electrolyte goals. You're also guaranteed to find an LMNT flavor you love. Try fan-favorites Citrus Salt or Raspberry Salt, get spicy with Mango Chili, or mix Chocolate Salt into your morning coffee for a mean mocha. And if you find it doesn't work for you, LMNT has a no questions asked refund policy- you don't even have to send it back. LMNT came up with a fantastic offer for us. Today, I have a special message from one of our long-time partners, I love it when we get to share products that I've personally benefited from, and I'm happy to report that LMNT helped me power through a landscaping project this summer. Can't recommend it enough! The Flyover wouldn't exist without its advertising partners, and this is a great one. Thanks for reading! -Cole, CEO P.S. Orange is the best flavor. Just one man's opinion. * It makes sense--you lose both water and sodium when you sweat. Both need to be replaced to prevent muscle cramps, headaches, and energy dips that result from: 1. Dehydration (less common) 2. Low electrolytes (more common) Most people only replace the water. Why? Because since the 1940s, we've been told to drink 8 glasses of water per day, thirsty or not. Thirst is the way our bodies regulate blood volume and fluid balance. When you need more fluids, you get thirsty. And when you drink plain water beyond thirst, it dilutes blood electrolyte levels (especially sodium levels) and leads to nasty consequences. These consequences include headaches, low energy, cramps, confusion, and worse. Unfortunately, since low-sodium symptoms mimic dehydration symptoms, people often get confused and drink more water. This only exacerbates the problem. When blood sodium levels are diluted like this, it's called hyponatremia. Hyponatremia is common in endurance athletes. Sometimes, it's fatal. So, we have a hydration problem on our hands. The solution isn't to stop drinking water though. It's to drink water plus electrolytes. Enter Created by former research biochemist Robb Wolf and ketogains founder Luis Villaseñor, LMNT has enough sodium, potassium, and magnesium to get you feeling and performing your best. In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here – Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons – but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**

body:
I won’t ever trick you because your trust matters to me.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39117%2E3422442%2ECoMO39)
Derek,
**_You matter_** —which is why I never demand your help with scammy language that scares or coerces you into donating. **It’s not my style.** My background is in consumer protection, so I make it a priority when asking you to donate that my messages are clear, honest, and informative.
Too many candidates and organizations use language like “Donate $5 today and it will be triple-matched,” “Warning: Payment incomplete,” or “We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” These tactics range from misleading to downright false, and they will _never_ be used by my team.
In Congress, I’ve led efforts to crack down on scam PACs, which can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures—coming from Americans who think they’re chipping in for real causes—go solely to “consultants” who pocket the money. It’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
**My style is to be frank with you**. We have less than 2 months until November. I need your help for Truth to Power to elect candidates who refuse to be swayed by corporate interests.
**[Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! Can you make a contribution today ahead of our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240919?refcode=em20240919-39117&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39117_3422442_CoMO39&akid=39117%2E3422442%2ECoMO39)**

Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting Truth to Power today.
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240919-39117&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39117_3422442_CoMO39&akid=39117%2E3422442%2ECoMO39)**

Far-right candidate Mark Robinson, the GOP’s nominee for NC governor is dead-set on upholding the GOP’s supermajority and passing an extreme agenda that would irreversibly harm the state. Robinson is a darling of QAnon forums, a Holocaust denier, and downplayed the Jan 6th insurrection as a “minor little thing” – and that’s not all.
* He’s called the LGBTQ+ community "filth."
* He’s posted comments in online forums so vile _we can’t even put them in this email._
* He threatened to use his AR-15 against the government if it _"gets too big for its britches."_
* He wants to outlaw all abortion and return to a time when women couldn’t vote.

**This cycle, dismantling Republican supermajorities isn’t just a political strategy – it’s a crucial fight to protect people in states like North Carolina against right-wing candidates like Robinson and unchecked GOP power.** [Without your support, extremists could impose a far-right agenda in places like North Carolina that could ripple across the entire country. Hi, I wanted to take a moment to share with you one of the main reasons why I'm in this race, and it's just one word: **Family.** I'm a husband, a dad, an uncle, and a grandfather. I want to impact my family in a positive way, just as mine did for me when I was growing up.
I want to tell you more about my family and how I was raised, but first I have to ask: [**Can you chip in to help us bring common sense and decency back to the Utah Governor's office this November? >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/zJupnKWL16Jn)
---
| [ ](https://king4ut.us/l/RgXXcPCEiSMo)
---
Growing up, I learned a lot about how we should respect differing opinions and how we can disagree while still being productive. My grandfather was a sheep and cattle rancher in Wayne and Garfield counties. My father was a sharp and astute attorney. My mother was a feminist who engaged in the PTA and the Women's State Legislative Council. At the dinner table, we would often have **engaging discussions** that were neither adversarial nor personal, where we learned more about each other and grew closer together. **I will always remember that time, and I hope to have an impact on my family as strong as that.** Politically, I've been able to advocate for my family and families like yours by serving as a Representative for 16 years. While I'm proud of the work that I've done, **_the monopoly on our state's politics that the Republican supermajority has and Gov. Cox's inability to make a principled stance against extremism continues to lead Utah down the wrong path._** I'm in this race because we need to address the housing crisis, climate change, and ensure that every Utahn has the right to make decisions about their bodies free from government overreach. **For all our families' sake.** [**In less than 50 days, we'll be heading to the polls to vote. This year, we have a choice between a Trump-endorsing governor and a leader who will fight for you like they would their own family. The choice is simple. Can you make a grassroots contribution to our campaign today and help us get back out on the campaign trail to spread our message and win this election?**](https://king4ut.us/l/Vyfvw8RZWrxy)
---

---
For the better, Brian King

---
| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/Z4S1h4Cjy9wX)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

**Brian for Utah**
P.O. Box 581557
Salt Lake City, UT 84158

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Trump claimed he was a leader on this. His party begs to differ.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Actions speak louder than words, Donald.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2347%2E4032634%2Ezbkwrk)
---
Donald Trump and Republicans _love_ to say they're going to protect IVF. Trump even claimed during the debate earlier this month that he was a “leader” on IVF. But Senate Republicans have blocked IVF protections from passing through Congress not once, but TWICE now — the latest time happening just this week. All that talk about being the party of family values. All that talk about leading on this issue. But when it’s time to put their vote where their mouth is...nothing. You would think Trump, the “leader” on this issue, would be calling Republican members and urging them to vote yes. Look, women are not stupid. We’re not buying this. We know that this has always been about conservatives controlling women's bodies. And we're fighting back. [**I’m going to keep calling out their hypocrisy and making their record clear to voters. Because so much is on the line in this election. Abortion rights, birth control, IVF treatments, everything. If you’re able, will you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to fight back and power our campaign for reproductive freedom?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2695?amount=28&t=8&akid=2347%2E4032634%2Ezbkwrk)

Republican opposition to IVF is terrifying. But it should not surprise us. Trump set the stage for this when he stacked the Supreme Court with justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Since then, Republicans have been doing everything they can to control our bodies, and put doctors and IVF clinics in legal jeopardy if they provide care. Who is affected by these decisions on IVF access? Families who have been wanting and praying to start a family. Women who have been injecting themselves for weeks, months, or years to try to have a baby. Parents who have spent an entire life’s savings to become pregnant. LGBTQ families who have spent years breaking down every obstacle in front of them are a family. People who are on their last hope. **The American people want reproductive freedom. We want to support parents, and we want to support people’s decision on if and when they want to become a parent. It’s their choice to decide, not the government’s.** [**I won’t stop fighting for everyone’s right to make that choice. And I won’t stop fighting to secure the Congress we need to pass legislation that will protect reproductive freedom across the country. If you believe in this fight, please pitch in $28 or anything you can to make this work possible.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2695?amount=28&t=14&akid=2347%2E4032634%2Ezbkwrk) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Who is affected by these decisions on IVF access? Families who have been wanting and praying to start a family. Women who have been injecting themselves for weeks, months, or years to try to have a baby. Parents who have spent an entire life’s savings to become pregnant. LGBTQ families who have spent years breaking down every obstacle in front of them are a family. People who are on their last hope. The American people want reproductive freedom. We want to support parents, and we want to support people’s decision on if and when they want to become a parent. It’s their choice to decide, not the government’s. | Peter,

Is this why she's lying?

My opponent is apparently following the plan of the national Democrat party - Lying.

This CNN article spells it out: https://www.cnn.com/2024/09/14/politics/fact-check-harris-campaign-social-media/index.html

It is disappointing and frustrating. I'm proud of my record - I work to solve problems and to help people. Wild, out-of-context claims and flat-out lying - It's pretty upsetting that **_anyone_** would lie in the way that my opponent is lying about me, if I'm being honest.
[](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=12286b3f30&e=5a45ee1154)

I need to raise $8,500 by next Tuesday to keep my first commercial on the air. Could you help at all with that? Any amount will help!

| Our Congressional race, District 6, is one of the most competitive in the entire country, according to Fox News: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/balance-power-5-races-could-decide-control-house-november The most recent independent polls have us winning by 2 points.

Democrats are now focused on us.

That's why special interest groups and ultra rich, out-of-state donors are lining up behind April Delaney. That's why the Democrats will be spending BIG on her campaign. And that's on top of her spending over $2 Million so far.

And...She doesn't bother with actually LIVING in the district she wants to represent. She doesn't have any history of serving the people of our district. **But she does have money, and money can buy plenty of lies. Money can even buy a congressional seat. Unless we step up NOW.**

We need to raise money RIGHT NOW to counter Delaney's lies. She's sending out mail and airing radio ads all over the district, lying about my record and distorting my positions. Since she has no accomplishments of her own, lies are all she has.

**What's going to power my campaign to victory is grassroots support from voters just like you.****I'm personally asking you to step up for common-sense issues like a secure border and an end to unlimited illegal immigration.**

[_**I'm personally asking you to donate to my campaign NOW so we can restore fiscal sanity to Washington and deliver a growing economy that lowers the cost of living for working families.**_](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=6dfe7ce35d&e=5a45ee1154)_** Could you help me to raise $8,500 by next Tuesday?**_

---
| April Delaney worked in the Biden administration's Commerce Department. That department is supposed to be responsible for economic growth...which didn't happen. And she'll be nothing in Congress but a vote for the same failed policy catastrophes that marked the Biden-Harris administration.

If we lose our freedoms and opportunities in this election we may never get them back. You and I both know that the stakes could not be higher.

[_**_This Congressional race will be so close. I need you to stand with me and contribute ANYTHING you can to this fight._**_](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=9211d825b2&e=5a45ee1154)

Thank you, and I hope to talk with you soon.

For Our Country,
Neil Parrott

The US Government is scheduled to shut down on October 1, unless a new funding bill is passed. And already the GOP led house [has voted against its own funding bill](https://substack.com/redirect/3ecbfb39-c894-4634-9cf9-565969ba8178?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But the funding bill failed not because of a funding dispute, but because what should be a simple continuing resolution (CR) is instead a trojan horse to shut down American democracy. Republicans want to pass something called the "SAVE Act," which they needlessly attached to the CR. While they claim this is a bill to "protect election integrity," in truth, this is a Donald Trump crafted fascist piece of legislation that will decimate voting rights in America. Rep Landsmen [wrote an excellent short thread](https://substack.com/redirect/16569e56-c4c1-4341-a38e-22ff3d9d9c9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on this bill. I provide here a detailed overview because without voting rights, we do not have a functioning republic. Here are five of the most terrifying aspects of the Trump crafted SAVE Act. **Let 's Address This.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KWbtc11HnpcFt-LK_4pk4cIYM5XdtNgU4g50JjRQGzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149113936)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eb83163b-7448-4b56-8c08-40532ebf00f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## 1\. Proof of Citizenship Requirement
Republicans have long and falsely claimed non-citizens vote in our elections. [There is no actual evidence of this](https://substack.com/redirect/d715a6f9-0a19-44a2-8453-64a2b7f7db46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Accordingly, Republicans want the SAVE Act to impose a wholly unnecessary proof of citizenship for voter registration. This means that millions of Americans who currently use their driver's licenses or state IDs to register wouldn't be able to.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ee70f582-3ac0-41ec-9002-94fabb927097?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We've used these same documents for decades to vote, but under this bill, they're suddenly not good enough. This change disproportionately impacts already marginalized groups and creates yet another barrier to the ballot box. Who pays for the additional documentation? What if someone cannot afford it, or get travel or time off work to go to a government office to procure it? The SAVE Act doesn't care.
## 2\. Targeting Women
Would it surprise you that the SAVE Act is also anti-women? Imagine you're a married woman, and like many married women, you change your last name. If your driver's license doesn't match your birth certificate, you could be blocked from voting. Ditto if you get divorced and change your name back to your maiden name. The SAVE Act would force women who have changed their names to jump through extra hoops just to exercise their basic right to vote. This doesn't protect our vote, it suffocates the democratic process.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KWbtc11HnpcFt-LK_4pk4cIYM5XdtNgU4g50JjRQGzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149113936)
## 3\. Disrespecting Veterans and Indigenous Communities
Not content with attacking women, the SAVE Act also attacks other groups who cannot immediately prove citizenship. For example, Tribal IDs, Veteran IDs, and Military IDs will all become useless if they don't explicitly prove citizenship. This is in addition to the [systemic voter suppression already imposed upon Native Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/85a5bc8e-b001-4213-adb0-ad960ffe28c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In short, the very people we _should_ be honoring, will instead be forced to jump through more hurdles for the right to vote.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8bda92f-100b-4e76-aa8e-3dbdc45e8221?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## 4\. Punishing Deployed Military Members
The SAVE Act continues to punish servicemembers by forcing those deployed abroad to come home just to register to vote _in person_. That's right. Republicans want soldiers stationed overseas to abandon their posts just to jump through bureaucratic hoops to reregister to do what they're already registered to do securely. Obviously, Republicans know that the hundreds of thousands of American troops stationed overseas will have no ability to return home just to update their voter registration, and thus will not be able to vote. This is once again de facto voter suppression.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..KWbtc11HnpcFt-LK_4pk4cIYM5XdtNgU4g50JjRQGzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149113936)
## 5\. A Solution in Search of a Problem
The SAVE Act criminalizes noncitizen voting, an act that is _already_ criminal. Let's be clear--noncitizen voting is already illegal. There are already strong protections in place to prevent it, and no evidence exists to indicate any form of breach. A Washington Post and AP study found [over the last 50 years no examples of systemic voter fraud, and no examples of voter fraud that could have even remotely overturned any State or Federal election](https://substack.com/redirect/9d16a86e-145a-4889-8ddc-7f1fca07a7ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e50b767-9976-4aa4-b8e6-58feba8e8682?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In fact, Donald Trump shut down his own commission to "find" voter or election fraud because they found no such evidence. Trump then set up a second commission to "find" voter fraud, [but then also shut it down after it found no such fraud](https://substack.com/redirect/14f1dcd8-1801-489e-81c3-d3f205a520f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). So why is the GOP pushing this bill? Because it's not about protecting elections--it's about suppressing votes.
## Conclusion
The Republican proposal is frightening as it is stark--let us suppress the voting rights of women, Black, Latino, and Indigenous Americans, Veterans, and active duty servicemembers, or we'll shut down the government. Another reminder of that old saying: _Republicans claim government doesn 't work, then get elected, and prove it._ Republicans have made clear they care about power, not democracy. This is why Republicans on the state level have proposed or passed [more than 100 voter suppression bills](https://substack.com/redirect/22b1755b-82da-4470-af68-9ca12d83723a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), specifically targeting Black and brown and low income voters.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41e719cb-a9d0-474e-9c98-61eda5041648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This, after Republicans gutted the [Voting Rights Act in 2013 in Shelby v. Holder](https://substack.com/redirect/fff42477-2880-460c-826c-dcee74e8c1c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which has resulted in red states [closing more than 10,000 polling location in predominantly Black and Latino neighborhoods](https://substack.com/redirect/4048bb18-16af-4ba2-9c4f-653eb02b33dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The bottom line is this. If your idea of democracy is to decrease citizen access to the ballot box--it isn't democracy you believe in, it's dictatorship. The SAVE Act is the final fascist piece of legislation in the MAGA plan to revive Jim Crow voter suppression in 2024 and establish dictatorship. It is a Donald Trump crafted extension of Project 2025, and we cannot allow it to become law.

Child care can cost more than $15,000 a year. Care at home for aging family members, or loved ones with a disability, can cost anywhere between $60,000 and $288,000 per year.
**But while families struggle desperately to afford care, the 2017 Trump Tax Cuts primarily benefited the wealthy** , offering an average tax cut of over $12,000 to those earning more than $300,000, while direct care and child care workers saw _an average tax cut of only $70!_
The truth is that the tax system is a construct, and next year, with the expiration of these tax cuts, our elected officials will face a choice of whether to make the investments in care we need to stop the care crisis from getting even worse. That’s why we’re going all out:
* **Mobilizing care workers and advocates** to get out the vote for Care Champions, and organizing initiatives like the Care Can’t Wait Bus Tour and the Care Workers Can't Wait Summit to make the reality of the care crisis clear to elected officials.
* **Raising the alarm about the care crisis in the media** through powerful story-telling by care workers and lifting the hard truths about the state of care, like the fact that caregivers contribute more than $1 trillion in _unpaid_ care work annually.
* **Taking the care crisis directly to lawmakers** with powerful advocacy by care workers, backed up by high-profile events like Ai-jen’s testimony yesterday.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 19, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Former Mayor Faulconer Exposes Lawson-Remer's Failed Leadership On Homelessness In New Video**
_**Highlights Absenteeism and Lack of Action Despite Rising Homeless Crisis**_
San Diego, CA – Kevin Faulconer today launched a scathing video on incumbent County Supervisor Terra Lawson-Remer following his decisive debate victory hosted by the Carlsbad, Encinitas and Solana Beach chambers of commerce. During the debate, Faulconer highlighted Lawson-Remer’s failure to show up for the countywide homeless task force she’s supposed to lead, despite homelessness rising to the highest they have ever been during her tenure.
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=db0be5363f&e=784f78234b)
[CLICK HERE TO WATCH: “Missing In Action”](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=214579583d&e=784f78234b)
| _**“Terra Lawson-Remer claims that homelessness is her number one priority, yet under her watch, it has only gotten worse. Worse still, she hasn’t attended a single meeting of the homeless task force she’s supposed to be leading countywide. It’s clear: her words don’t match her actions,” Faulconer said. “When I was Mayor, we reduced homelessness by working together. As Supervisor, I will move the County to act—cleaning up homeless encampments and moving people into the safety of shelters where they can access mental health resources and turn their lives around for the better.”**_
Faulconer, who successfully reduced homelessness as mayor of San Diego by working across the aisle with a Democratic supermajority, promised to bring real change if elected. He’ll move immediately as supervisor to force the County of San Diego to act on homelessness, increasing shelter beds, mental health resources and providing a pathway for those on the streets to turn their lives around.
The contrast between Faulconer’s hands-on approach and Lawson-Remer’s absenteeism has never been more clear. As homelessness continues to rise, voters are looking for a leader who will take action and make San Diego a safer and cleaner environment for everyone. ###
For more information about Faulconer’s campaign, visit [www.kevinfaulconer.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=68d46833c3&e=784f78234b).

After Parkland, many adults said:

“What happened is terrible and it’s amazing you kids are standing up, but
you’ll never change anything because this is Florida.”

But guess what?

Outraged students and parents of victims — like Fred Guttenberg and Manuel
Oliver — said we don’t care; we’re still going to try. We showed up and
protested by the thousands in Tallahassee. And guess what? We actually did
change gun laws. We raised the age to buy guns in Florida to 21 and passed
a red flag law.

Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter that said: “F
with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.”

We used the law we passed after Parkland to disarm the man that threatened
to kill my mother, and since the passage of that law, over 12,000 other
people who were a risk to themselves or others have been disarmed.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240919-1?refcode=em20240919-1-1234&amount=5&refcode2=1234_21716_hAVrrr&akid=1234%2E21716%2EhAVrrr ]If
we didn’t have the audacity to hope – I may have had to bury my own
mother. That’s why I’m still fighting to keep others safe from gun
violence. Can you give $5 to our candidate Sarah McBride to
help her get to Congress and advance our work to create a safer future?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240919-1-1234&refcode2=1234_21716_hAVrrr&akid=1234%2E21716%2EhAVrrr ]Donate $5 »

A few years later, I hired a young guy named Maxwell Frost from my
freshman dorm room in college to be the March for Our Lives National
Organizing Director. In my junior year of college, he called me up and
said he would have to leave March for Our Lives because he wanted to run
for Congress and asked for my help.

Before this, I hadn’t really helped anyone run for office in a major way
because I didn’t trust politicians who only wanted to use me to get
elected and then do nothing about gun violence.

But I didn’t see Maxwell as a politician – I saw him as a friend, so I did
everything I could to help him run.

Once again, I heard the same thing from professors and “experts”:

“He’s too young.”

“He doesn’t have the political or donor connections to win.”

“How is he going to win against two former members of Congress?”

I didn’t care and decided to keep supporting him because I knew what an
incredible leader he could be, and I wanted to prove everyone who said it
wasn’t possible wrong. So, I helped Maxwell raise $380,000 in his first
two quarters, which helped him win by a margin of 10% — and he became the
youngest member of Congress.

Once elected, Maxwell’s first bill was to create a Federal Office of Gun
Violence Prevention (something March for Our Lives had been pushing for
over three years) and within 1 year of his election, Maxwell was
introducing the President of the United States, who was announcing the
creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. That office has
overseen a 20% reduction of gun homicides in the first quarter of 2024.

If we listened to the people who said Maxwell couldn’t win, and if he
didn’t bother to try, we wouldn’t have:

* The youngest and first Gen Z member of Congress;
* an Office of Gun Violence Prevention;
* the first member of March for Our Lives in Congress.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240919-1?refcode=em20240919-1-1234&amount=5&refcode2=1234_21716_hAVrrr&akid=1234%2E21716%2EhAVrrr ]We’re changing the status quo and getting
more young leaders elected to office. Can you donate $5 to
Sarah McBride — who’s taken on the NRA and won the most significant gun
safety package in Delaware history? Every donation will help her get to
Congress.

We are in a vicious cycle of cynicism and hopelessness that will destroy
us if we don’t break it. Hopelessness is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If we
never think things can get better, they never will.

That’s why – with Maxwell’s campaign manager, Kevin Lata – we created
Leaders We Deserve. An organization dedicated to funding and advising the
best Democrats of our generation to get them elected, so we can have
leaders in office that will inspire young people to vote.

This year, we endorsed Sarah McBride, a millennial who will become the
FIRST out trans member of Congress if she wins her election in November.
Like all of our candidates Sarah is pro-gun reform, pro-choice, and
pro-environment. She also doesn't take money from large corporations and
neither does Leaders We Deserve.

Just recently, we spent $300,000 supporting Molly Cook, who won by just 62
votes, and is now the youngest member of the Texas Senate.

CHANGE IS POSSIBLE! And we’re making it happen.

Join
the thousands of people supporting a better, more progressive future. We
rely on grassroots support to get young progressives elected to office,
and with November 5 getting closer, we need a big surge of donations to
get across the finish line. [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240919-1?refcode=em20240919-1-1234&amount=5&refcode2=1234_21716_hAVrrr&akid=1234%2E21716%2EhAVrrr ]Can we count on you to donate
$5 to Sarah McBride to help her get to Congress and build a
better future for the next generation?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240919-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240919-1-1234&refcode2=1234_21716_hAVrrr&akid=1234%2E21716%2EhAVrrr ]Donate $5 »

We’re in this fight together.

Thank you,

David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

clean_body: She’s obsessed. | Y’all, a quick scroll through Marsha Blackburn’s Twitter account makes things very clear. Her target audience isn’t Tennesseans — it’s just Donald Trump. = (Seriously. Get a life, Marsha.) If she were less of a flunkey and more of a representative, maybe she’d focus more of her communications on the real issues facing our state — child hunger, rural health care access, gun violence. If she were less obsessed with political demagogues and more concerned with her constituents, maybe she’d be able to work across the aisle to actually pass legislation that makes a difference. But Marsha’s been in Washington for two decades. She’s shown us who she is. It’s time to believe her. Look, Tennesseans are sick and tired of a senator who cares only about her powerful political allies, and not about us. We’re ready for change. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Let’s do this, Team Gloria | = Gloria Johnson is running for the U.S. Senate because Tennesseans deserve leaders who care. The only people they’ve championed are their donors. [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d41e3f227ec04856953231084d4c540d&_e=QAiRnc6KfFk1_ThC0WNocSLh3hkjMARP6aZz3CiPN2zbVHFC1-y14CLWfcZMhHaVawHdYWOT-Agw-v0Uuo68bG86Uk6AKcmx75nORj9NDTlwSy-NxSOKod-jLxd7WAcvayzCRK5B7xGdLgNoeyKGeAhTst-5KudUAhxuB2qPqtY2FYA5RPr9yqvupD42R0t_Fl1zKwYSWDeCb531_JlIiMSGvqN_o3cN7YBS0o_cK8ee7p5Ad04CiD1eHSzGYvxF7sgqh96CW-MUOTpkujgOXcSHUMjnq-_hpfow1ZH7aywutPo8LDz1zMVDKibXCaRd5tIOYX_Zk-6T_m3yoNdlbLLfEpO2b8Kl0gWymjROpyugOwwLoidHC5kqwIssi9ilRgGIktmUSsEkR3kEX71QVA%3D%3D)

_**“Montana Senator Jon Tester has been a political unicorn for nearly two decades, but in a presidential year with an even more polarized electorate, he is now the underdog heading into the race's final stretch.”**_

Peter,

_**This is HUGE NEWS.**_

We have momentum and opportunity on our side. By moving my Montana U.S. Senate race from “tossup” to “lean Republican,” political handicapper _**Cook Political Report**_ is signaling to the country that not only is my race the ONLY one where a Democrat incumbent has become the underdog, but that this race, in fact, will be the race that decides whether we control the Senate in November.

_**This isn’t conjecture. This isn’t bluster. This is the real deal.**_

** Every Tool in the GOTV Toolbox
------------------------------------------------------------

This includes absentee voting. While many Republicans are skeptical about voting by mail, we should dislike something even more: missing the opportunity to cast our vote!

Life happens, and there are valid reasons why some may need to vote by mail—whether due to travel, illness, or unforeseen circumstances. It’s time to put those concerns aside and embrace every possible method to maximize Republican turnout, ensuring a solid Republican voice, ‘Trump,’ any hesitation about how the vote is cast (see what I did there?).

Let’s approach this election with a “no voter left behind” mentality. Every Republican vote matters, and we need to use every tool at our disposal—whether in-person early voting, absentee ballots, or Election Day turnout—to ensure our collective voice is heard loud and clear. The stakes are too high to leave any stone unturned or any vote on the table.

So let’s unite in our commitment to victory, put aside any personal hesitations, and ensure that every Republican gets their vote in—no matter how it’s cast. It’s about participation, about standing up for our values, and making sure the future we envision is built on the strength of every Republican voter.

# Cornel West for President

Dear Peter, Exciting news—**Cornel West 2024 merch** is now available! Starting today, you can visit our **campaign store** at [https://www.CornelWest2024.com/shop](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/shop?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lead_with_love_merch2&n=2) to access exclusive gear and support our movement for **truth, justice, and love**. Your purchase makes a difference: every **Lead with Love T-Shirt** and **Sweatshirt** you buy will be directly donated to **members of the houseless community in Los Angeles****,** as part of a special collaboration with **The Row LA "The Church Without Walls"** and **Public Statement Apparel**. Your contributions help amplify our mission of empowering those who are most in need, especially in California, which has the largest houseless population in the country. Our full range of merchandise includes:
* **Cornel West 2024 T-Shirts**
* **West/Abdullah T-Shirts**
* **Lead with Love (donation) T-Shirts**
* **Lead with Love (donation) Sweatshirts**

Every item is a chance to wear your support and spread the message of our campaign—leading with love and standing for justice.

**Pastor Cue** , the leader of the **The Row LA "The Church Without Walls,"** has spent years advocating for and serving the most vulnerable members of the Los Angeles community, offering spiritual guidance and essential services to those experiencing houselessness. He reminds us of the importance of addressing the root causes of this crisis:
_"Since our houseless problem is due to housing unaffordability and unavailability, we could have solved our homelessness problem a long time ago. It's not that we cannot solve the problem; it's that we refuse to solve it."_ **Erik Hardeman** , founder of **Public Statement Apparel** , a Los Angeles-based small business, uses his brand to promote social justice and community empowerment. Collaborating with independent artists and organizations, Erik ensures every piece of merch makes a meaningful impact. He adds:
_"This isn’t just a moment—it’s a movement fueled by awareness and action. By supporting this campaign, you're joining us on the journey toward change, one statement at a time."_

subject: They came for Roe. Now they’re coming for more
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Republicans spent 50 years telling us they were coming for Roe v. Wade . Two years ago they finally made good on that threat.
But they’re not stopping there.
Justice Clarence Thomas made that clear in his concurring opinion in the Dobbs decision – the constitutional argument that underpinned Roe applies to many landmark civil rights cases, and all of them are under threat now.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240919_they_told_us_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240919_they_told_us_image]
They want to roll back decades of progress and dismantle the very rights so many of us have fought for.
In his opinion, Thomas listed several cases that he believes the Supreme Court should overturn, including Griswold , which legalized contraception and guaranteed medical privacy, and Obergefell , which legalized same-sex marriage.
Notice how he left out Loving v. Virginia , though. And we know why. That case famously legalized interracial marriages like the one Thomas enjoys.
But now with Project 2025 and ULTRA-MAGA minions like Jim Jordan pushing every far-right fever dream you can imagine, ALL of our hard-fought progress can wind up on the chopping block.
It’s easy to forget how fragile our democratic norms and liberties can be. Marriage equality is barely a decade old. My parents, as an interracial couple, couldn’t even find a church that would marry them in the 1970s. And today’s ULTRA-MAGA Republicans are even calling women’s right to vote into question!
The bottom line is that if Clarence Thomas and the rest of the far-right justices on the Supreme Court don’t manage to take our rights away, then Jim Jordan will happily do it for them.
If we hit our $1M monthly fundraising goal, we can ensure every voter in our district knows just how much is at stake. Chip in now, and together, we’ll hold the line on our rights and freedoms. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240919_they_told_us_link1]
Like all abusers and their enablers, the only thing they want is to control us. Jordan and his allies will stop at nothing to impose their dangerous agenda on every single one of us.
This year is the BEST opportunity we’ve ever had to kick Jim Jordan out of Congress. We’re closing in on $2M raised and we’re polling in a statistical tie.
That makes this the most important congressional race in the country , and with your support, we can stop these extremists in their tracks.
We’ve seen what happens when we ignore their threats. Let’s not make that mistake again. Contribute today, and let’s protect our rights before they take even more away. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240919_they_told_us_link2]
