clean_body: [] Friends, Republicans spent 50 years telling us they were coming for Roe v. Wade . Two years ago they finally made good on that threat. But they’re not stopping there. Justice Clarence Thomas made that clear in his concurring opinion in the Dobbs decision – the constitutional argument that underpinned Roe applies to many landmark civil rights cases, and all of them are under threat now. [] They want to roll back decades of progress and dismantle the very rights so many of us have fought for. In his opinion, Thomas listed several cases that he believes the Supreme Court should overturn, including Griswold , which legalized contraception and guaranteed medical privacy, and Obergefell , which legalized same-sex marriage. Notice how he left out Loving v. Virginia , though. And we know why. That case famously legalized interracial marriages like the one Thomas enjoys. But now with Project 2025 and ULTRA-MAGA minions like Jim Jordan pushing every far-right fever dream you can imagine, ALL of our hard-fought progress can wind up on the chopping block. It’s easy to forget how fragile our democratic norms and liberties can be. Marriage equality is barely a decade old. My parents, as an interracial couple, couldn’t even find a church that would marry them in the 1970s. And today’s ULTRA-MAGA Republicans are even calling women’s right to vote into question! The bottom line is that if Clarence Thomas and the rest of the far-right justices on the Supreme Court don’t manage to take our rights away, then Jim Jordan will happily do it for them. If we hit our $1M monthly fundraising goal, we can ensure every voter in our district knows just how much is at stake. Chip in now, and together, we’ll hold the line on our rights and freedoms. [] Like all abusers and their enablers, the only thing they want is to control us. Jordan and his allies will stop at nothing to impose their dangerous agenda on every single one of us. This year is the BEST opportunity we’ve ever had to kick Jim Jordan out of Congress. We’re closing in on $2M raised and we’re polling in a statistical tie. That makes this the most important congressional race in the country , and with your support, we can stop these extremists in their tracks. We’ve seen what happens when we ignore their threats. Let’s not make that mistake again. Contribute today, and let’s protect our rights before they take even more away. ---
| | This list is an important one. Not just because it sends a clear message to voters on where these candidates stand — _**but because each of the Dirty Dozen candidates**_ _**is**_ _**running in a race where the environmental movement has a serious chance to decide the outcome.**_
---
| | I’m reaching out today because our field operations in many of these races are still underfunded. I’m asking for your help today _**because each and every one of these races is winnable if the environmental movement turns out enough voters. This includes defeating Trump, who we previously named — and who remains — “the Dirtiest of All Time”.**_
---
| | [**_Right now, a major partner has agreed to match every dollar we spend on the presidential race. That means your donation will DOUBLE in impact if you give $5 or more today. Rush a_** _**_Dirty Dozen_**_** _gift to LCV Victory Fund today >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/-)
---
| | LCV Victory Fund has a track record of taking on corporate polluters’ favorite candidates — _and going all in to defeat them at the ballot box_.
---
| | In 2022, our movement went big to turn out voters in key races. Our work helped defeat an anticipated ‘red wave’ and instead, elect a green wave of 130 federal and 975 state-level candidates, including 13 pro-climate, pro-democracy governors.
---
| | **Importantly, we defeated 10 out of 12 of our Dirty Dozen targets last cycle.** I’m hoping we can do even better this time around — because this year’s list has some dangerously extreme candidates:
---
| |
## **LCV Victory Fund’s 2024** _**Dirty Dozen**_**List of the Worst Anti-environment Candidates**
[**RUSH A GIFT OF $5 OR MORE TO STOP THEM NOW >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| |
#### **President: Donald Trump**
Trump was already the most anti-environmental president in history, having rolled back 100 environmental protections, suppressed science, appointed anti-environmental officials and judges, and continued to call climate change a hoax while in office. Since then, his views have gotten even more extreme, and the Project 2025 playbook that would guide his second term would have devastating consequences for people and the planet. On the campaign trail, he has vowed to be a dictator in order to expand oil drilling and will eliminate support for wind power on day one. He frequently says that climate change is “not our problem.”
---
| |
#### **AZ-SEN: Kari Lake**
Kari Lake is a fringe climate change denier whose failed 2022 campaign was backed by Arizona’s utility companies and the oil and gas industry. Lake has positioned herself as a mouthpiece for the climate denial and misinformation of the extreme MAGA right wing with statements such as, “don’t tell me that we’re in some sort of a weird heating trend, I don’t believe that for a minute”, and “I’m not going to be afraid of the weather.” While Arizonans were facing devastating record heat last year, Kari Lake dismissed concerns about heat deaths as “mass hysteria.” Likewise, she continues to deny the reality of Donald Trump’s 2020 election loss, and her own loss in 2022.
---
| |
#### **MT-SEN: Tim Sheehy**
Tim Sheehy is part of the growing number of out-of-state millionaires moving to Montana, buying up lands and driving up costs. Sheehy joined the board of right-wing think tank the Property and Environment Research Center (PERC), but quietly failed to disclose his role with the group, in violation of ethics rules. PERC advocates for policies that would make it easier for billionaires to wield even more control over land in Montana, including advocating for privatizing public lands.
---
| |
#### **NV-SEN: Sam Brown**
Sam Brown is a MAGA extremist who is out of step with Nevada. His support for opening Yucca Mountain to dangerous nuclear waste because it would be a source of revenue speaks to a record of putting profits and polluters over the health and safety of Nevada communities. Brown said he would eliminate the U.S. Departments of Energy, Education, Transportation, and federal “environmental departments and agencies.”
---
| |
#### **OH-SEN: Bernardo Moreno**
Bernie Moreno is a multi-millionaire former luxury car dealer who ran as an extreme-right candidate against JD Vance in the 2022 Senate primary. This time around, with Donald Trump’s endorsement, Moreno has made it clear that he is fully on board with Trump’s dirty energy agenda. At a candidate forum in February, Moreno made his priorities clear when he said, “We should be unleashing American energy and being an energy-dominant country. Instead, we have this move towards windmills, solar panels. _**We need coal, we need natural gas, we need oil.**_ ”
---
| |
#### **PA-SEN: Dave McCormick**
Dave McCormick is a mega-millionaire former CEO of the world’s largest hedge fund whose answer to a question about energy policy at a campaign stop involved mentioning that his wife, Dina Powell McCormick, is on the board of Exxon. It is no surprise that Dave McCormick’s energy policy plan literally starts and ends with oil and gas. McCormick says, “we need to get back to the energy policies under President Trump.”
---
| |
#### **WI-SEN: Eric Hovde**
Eric Hovde is a multi-millionaire bank executive who likes to rail against regulations and is being backed by billionaire oil barons who actively oppose any kind of meaningful environmental safeguards. Hovde would join the dirty energy industry’s backers in Congress who want to keep our country dependent on fossil fuels and has said that the push to get to 100% clean energy by 2050 is “delusional.” Hovde supports a pro-polluter agenda, endorsing Donald Trump’s policies in 2019 by saying, “His deregulation program and obviously his tax reform act was very good for businesses.” The Trump tax law ended up giving a $25 billion handout to Big Oil.
---
| |
#### **AZ-06: Juan Ciscomani**
Rep. Juan Ciscomani, is a career right-wing activist trying to hide his extreme MAGA ties. Before going to Congress, Ciscomani served for 14 years on the board of a fringe group called Patriot Academy that hosts extreme right-wing speakers and promotes climate deniers. Now, Ciscomani wants to greenwash his record of voting to kill off clean energy which earned him a paltry 14% lifetime score on LCV’s _National Environmental Scorecard_.
---
| |
#### **CA-41: Ken Calvert**
Rep. Ken Calvert, who was first elected to Congress in 1992, is now trying to hide his abysmal record on environmental issues from voters, along with his 8% lifetime LCV score. Calvert made his allegiances to polluters clear when he sided with extremists on the “Default on America” plan, which threatened to force a national recession if Republicans didn’t get their way on gutting environmental protections.
---
| |
#### **CA-45: Michelle Steel**
Rep. Michelle Steel has earned a dismal 4% lifetime score from LCV for her voting record, even sinking to a resounding 0% in 2023. Her votes include attempts to repeal clean energy investments that are already helping California create good-paying jobs and trying to repeal critical protections for clean air and water. She has even voted against bills to protect the California coastline from offshore drilling and to stop oil price gouging while making up to $50,000 in oil royalties.
---
| |
#### **NM-02: Yvette Herrell**
Yvette Herrell now holds the record for most appearances on the _Dirty Dozen_ list, having lost to LCV Action Fund-endorsed candidates in 2018 and 2022. She has a 0% lifetime LCV score and was one of the top recipients of oil and gas money during her brief time in Congress. Yvette Herrell has taken $735,161 in campaign contributions from the oil and gas industry and voted to protect oil companies from price gouging investigations.
---
| |
#### **NY-04: Anthony D'Esposito**
Rep. Anthony D’Esposito represents a Democratic district that President Biden won by more than 14 points in 2020, yet he continues to ally himself with Trump and extreme MAGA Republicans. D’Esposito has been a vocal opponent of clean energy, voting three times to repeal clean energy tax credits and opposing a major new clean energy infrastructure project in New York. He even cosponsored a measure calling for a halt to offshore wind development along the entire Atlantic coast.
---
| | Peter — the races targeting these _Dirty Dozen_ candidates WILL decide who controls the House, the Senate, and the White House next year.
---
| | But to beat the _Dirty Dozen_ , we need to get _more organizers on the ground and reach more environmental voters_ who are at risk of sitting out this election.
---
| | These last weeks ahead are make-or-break for our efforts to defeat Trump and other extreme MAGA candidates who are in the pocket of Big Oil and other polluters. _**But right now, we’re still far short of our funding goal.** So we’re asking:_
---
| | [**_We need to reach more environmental voters to win critical races — and fast. Please help defeat the_** _**_Dirty Dozen_**_** _. Chip in $5 or more to LCV Victory Fund, while your support goes 2x as far. Rush a gift today >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYf4DqP-)
---
| | Thanks for standing with us, Peter. We’ll be in touch soon with more updates on our campaigns and more ways you can help defeat the _Dirty Dozen_.
---
| | Onward,

Our teams are working around the clock to get it done, but we can’t do it alone — we need folks like you in our corner as we head into this final stretch. Can you split a donation today to help power both of our campaigns, ensure we can keep fighting for our Commonwealths in the Senate, and help retain our critical Democratic majority? ## PRESIDENT TRUMP ENDORSES NICK BEGICH!

Dear Friends,

I’m excited to share some incredible news with you—**President Donald Trump has officially endorsed me for Congress!**

Under President Trump’s leadership, we saw real action to unlock Alaska’s potential, including his historic decision to open the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge (ANWR) for exploration and development—creating opportunities for our state like never before. Now, with **over 66 executive orders from the Harris-Biden administration specifically targeting Alaska’s resource development** , President Trump is committed to reversing these disastrous policies. Together, we will work to rescind these harmful orders, get Alaska back on track, and ensure that our energy and resource industries can thrive once again. Alaska’s future depends on it, and I’m proud to stand with him in this fight.

President Trump and I are already working together on a plan to **reopen Alaska for development** and ensure a **thriving and prosperous future** for our great state. We’re committed to fighting Biden’s disastrous policies that are crippling our economy and standing in the way of Alaska’s potential.

But this campaign is about more than just Alaska—it’s about **joining a nationwide movement** of Republicans who are stepping up to take our country back. From securing the border to defending our freedoms, **Republicans from across the country are rallying behind us** , and now we need your support to keep up the momentum.

With **President Trump’s endorsement** , we have a powerful team to take on the radical left in Washington. But this fight is far from over, and we can’t do it alone. **Your contribution today will help us continue building a campaign strong enough to win on November 5th. Click[here](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=e2ca61a5e1&e=6679001ba0) to help us reclaim Alaska's seat and ensure Alaska's prosperity!**

This is our moment. Together, we can **reopen Alaska, create jobs, and ensure a future where our families thrive**. Can I count on your support today?

**America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Onward to victory,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress

With Election Day just weeks away, the 2024 campaign is hurtling toward a nail-biting finish. The stakes couldn't be higher for Democrats defending the White House and crucial congressional seats in battleground states. Here's what our latest research reveals:
**Presidential Race Tightens**
Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump are locked in a razor-thin battle across key battleground states.
Michigan, Pennsylvania, and Georgia are pivotal, with Harris gaining momentum in some areas but struggling in others. In Michigan, Trump narrowly leads, with voters divided on who can best manage the economy and foreign affairs. However, Harris holds a slight edge in Pennsylvania, where voter concerns over affordability remain front and center.
Georgia is emerging as another hotly contested state, with Harris making inroads among Black voters but still trailing Trump.
**House Races on a Knife's Edge**
Key congressional races could determine the future control of the House.
In Arizona’s 6th District, Democrat Kristen Engel is in a dead heat with Republican Rep. Juan Ciscomani. Likewise, Rep. David Valadao (R-CA), one of the last Republicans who voted to impeach Trump, faces a fierce challenge from Democrat Rudy Salas in California’s 22nd District. These districts are flush with outside spending, making every dollar crucial.

As Trump remains a dominant force in Republican politics, Democrats are working to capitalize on his polarizing presence. Congressional ads have begun featuring clips of Trump’s controversial comments, linking GOP candidates to his brand of politics. Hello, it’s Barbra Streisand, and I want to share with you why I’m fully behind Jacky Rosen in Nevada’s must-win Senate race. [**_If you’re with me, will you consider making a donation to her campaign right now?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93173694/499604370/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4876-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTg4NTNjOC1kZjc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5NSp6-a4zVNb5bLuWBs2QuneO7Ca0lyUr2QcTpaeNkw=)
Like Jacky, I have always been moved by the Jewish tradition of ‘Tikkun Olam,’ which means to leave the world better than how we found it. I truly believe that Jacky’s voice is the one we need in the Senate to better our country and our world.
Right now, experts are predicting that Jacky’s race will likely decide Senate control. That means that the outcome of her election could decide whether someone in this country can have a safe abortion, get affordable prescription drugs, access the ballot box – or even whether we will have free and fair elections going forward.
**But the last Senate race in Nevada was decided by just 7,928 votes – a margin of just 1% and the thinnest in the country. Now, polls show that this year’s election will be just as close. I know Jacky has what it takes to fight all the way down to the wire and win – but she can only do it if she has the resources she needs to fight back against the GOP.**
[**_That’s why I’m asking you: Will you please join me in supporting Jacky Rosen now by pitching in $5 or more to help her win in Nevada and continue fighting for a better world?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93173695/499604371/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4876-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTg4NTNjOC1kZjc2LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5NSp6-a4zVNb5bLuWBs2QuneO7Ca0lyUr2QcTpaeNkw=)

# Volunteer Newsletter Issue #2
September 19th, 2024
---
|
---
|
Hello Team Suozzi!
The past week was absolutely electric, as we had an amazing turnout for our office openings, canvassing, and phone banking. We can’t express to you how important your contribution is to this election!
This past weekend, we opened offices in **Glen Cove, Great Neck, and Plainview** , and have started to canvass out of all 3. We’ve already seen how impactful your efforts can be, so keep up the amazing work!
This upcoming weekend, we are opening**two new offices** , in **Port Washington and Queens (please note the time changes)**! RSVP links can be found below for the office openings. Thank you for all your help, and I’ll see you in the offices!
Best,Sara Castelli
---
|
---
|
# Office Openings : Note the Time Changes
---
| We’re thrilled to announce the opening of our campaign offices and would love for you to join us! Our team is eager to hit the ground running, and we hope you are too. This race won't be easy, but with your support, we can make a real impact. Come to our office openings, make a difference, and help us get the vote out!
**9/21 @ 10:45AM (TIME CHANGE) Port Washington Office** \- [https://mobilize.us/s/n0K8LM](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=d2bd1765f0&e=2d63ff009b)
**9/22 @ 2PM (TIME CHANGE) Queens Office** \- [https://mobilize.us/s/VowQYf](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=a4dee684e6&e=2d63ff009b)
---
|
---
|
# CAMPAIGN CANVASSING
---
| Since June, our incredible and passionate volunteers have helped us knock on thousands of doors! There are plenty of canvassing opportunities across the district, with various time slots to fit different schedules. We need your support to maintain this momentum. Sign up for a canvassing shift using the Mobilize links below! **Port Washington:** [https://www.mobilize.us/nysdems/event/669816/](https://suozziforcongress2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c0ad4a8bbd8df94a8b1718e5&id=3a48b50034&e=2d63ff009b)

subject: Bernie just introduced a resolution to stop arms sales to Israel

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The Israeli military has killed more than 40,000 people in Gaza since last
October, and the Gaza Ministry of Health just published a new 649-page
document with the identifying information of more than 34,000 of those
deaths. Horrifically, the first 14 pages are filled with the names of
infants under the age of 1 year old, children who were born and killed
during this 11-month genocide.

And this week, the Netanyahu administration carried out multiple
coordinated attacks on thousands of people in Lebanon and Syria,
detonating explosives in handheld pagers and walkie-talkies that killed 37
people and injured thousands more, including civilians and children.

As long as the United States keeps sending billions of dollars in weapons
and bombs to Israel with no conditions or accountability, the Israeli
government will feel emboldened to continue violating international law.
Our government has been responsible for over 65% of Israel’s weapons
imports since 2013, making our government complicit in these crimes
against humanity.

Meanwhile, the American people continue to stand united against the use of
our tax dollars to enable this violence. New polling from The Intercept
shows the majority of voters on all sides oppose sending more weapons to
Israel — that number has only grown over time, from 52% in October 2023 to
61% in June.

Senator Bernie Sanders just introduced a resolution in the Senate
demanding an immediate arms embargo against Israel, and Justice Democrats
like Ilhan Omar couldn’t agree more:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240919_arms_embargo_resolution/?source=em20240919-36005&akid=36005%2E1203867%2ETmN1J_ ]Tweet from Ilhan Omar: Agree. We should not send another dime to fund
the genocide. Netanyahu’s reckless disregard for civilian lives in the
pager attack in Lebanon is yet another example of why we need to cut off
military aid.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240919_arms_embargo_resolution/?source=em20240919-36005&akid=36005%2E1203867%2ETmN1J_ ]Will you add your name to our petition supporting this resolution and
demanding the U.S. stop sending bombs and weapons to Israel now?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240919_arms_embargo_resolution/?source=em20240919-36005&akid=36005%2E1203867%2ETmN1J_ ]Add Your Name

It’s growing clearer by the day: this genocide and violence against
innocent people will not end as long as the U.S. continues to supply
Israel’s military with arms under no conditions. As Ilhan said, we should
not send another dime.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240919-36005-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36005_1203867_TmN1J_&akid=36005%2E1203867%2ETmN1J_

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved.
